examples.en: She turned eleven years old last week and had a big birthday party.
examples.zh: 她上周满十一岁，举办了一个盛大的生日派对。

examples.en: The bus arrives at platform eleven every thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 公交车每三十分钟到达十一号站台。

examples.en: The kitchen reeked of burnt toast after the toaster malfunctioned.
examples.zh: 烤面包机故障后，厨房里弥漫着烤焦面包的臭味。

examples.en: His clothes reeked of cigarette smoke after spending time in the bar.
examples.zh: 在酒吧待了一段时间后，他的衣服散发出香烟的臭味。

examples.en: The old basement reeks of mildew and dampness.
examples.zh: 旧地下室散发着霉味和潮湿的气味。

examples.en: The scandal reeks of corruption and needs to be investigated thoroughly.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻散发着腐败的气息，需要彻底调查。

examples.en: The small business hired a part-time bookkeeper to manage its finances.
examples.zh: 这家小企业雇佣了一名兼职簿记员来管理其财务。

examples.en: As a bookkeeper, her job is to record all transactions accurately in the ledger.
examples.zh: 作为一名簿记员，她的工作是准确记录分类账中的所有交易。

examples.en: The bookkeeper discovered an error in the accounts that saved the company money.
examples.zh: 簿记员发现了一个账户错误，为公司节省了资金。

examples.en: He trained to become a certified bookkeeper to improve his career prospects.
examples.zh: 他接受了培训，成为一名认证簿记员，以提高职业前景。

examples.en: The belligerent nations finally agreed to a ceasefire after years of conflict.
examples.zh: 经过多年的冲突，这些好战的国家终于同意停火。

examples.en: His belligerent attitude made it difficult to have a peaceful discussion.
examples.zh: 他好斗的态度使得和平讨论变得困难。

examples.en: The belligerent crowd outside the stadium caused security concerns.
examples.zh: 体育场外好斗的人群引发了安全担忧。

examples.en: She avoided her belligerent neighbor to prevent unnecessary arguments.
examples.zh: 她避开好斗的邻居，以避免不必要的争吵。

examples.en: The company is hiring new employees for its expansion project.
examples.zh: 公司正在为其扩张项目招聘新员工。

examples.en: Hiring a professional consultant can save time and resources.
examples.zh: 聘请专业顾问可以节省时间和资源。

examples.en: The hiring process includes interviews and background checks.
examples.zh: 招聘过程包括面试和背景调查。

examples.en: They are hiring temporary workers for the holiday season.
examples.zh: 他们正在为假日季节雇佣临时工。

examples.en: Using chopsticks takes practice, but it becomes easy with time.
examples.zh: 使用筷子需要练习，但随着时间的推移会变得容易。

examples.en: She bought a set of wooden chopsticks as a souvenir from Japan.
examples.zh: 她从日本买了一副木筷子作为纪念品。

examples.en: Chopsticks are essential utensils in many Asian cuisines.
examples.zh: 筷子是许多亚洲菜肴中必不可少的餐具。

examples.en: He struggled to pick up the slippery noodles with chopsticks.
examples.zh: 他努力用筷子夹起滑溜的面条。

examples.en: The decision to cut funding will ramify throughout the entire organization.
examples.zh: 削减资金的决定将在整个组织中产生分支影响。

examples.en: The issue began to ramify into multiple complex problems.
examples.zh: 这个问题开始分支成多个复杂的问题。

examples.en: Economic changes can ramify into social and political effects.
examples.zh: 经济变化可以分支成社会和政治影响。

examples.en: The error in the initial design ramified into costly repairs later.
examples.zh: 初始设计中的错误后来分支成了昂贵的维修。

examples.en: I received a confirmation email for my flight booking.
examples.zh: 我收到了航班预订的确认邮件。

examples.en: The test results provided confirmation of the diagnosis.
examples.zh: 测试结果提供了诊断的确认。

examples.en: He nodded in confirmation when asked if he understood.
examples.zh: 当被问及是否理解时，他点头确认。

examples.en: The confirmation of the meeting time is still pending.
examples.zh: 会议时间的确认仍在等待中。

examples.en: She learned the craft of pottery from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她从祖母那里学习了陶艺手艺。

examples.en: The author crafted a compelling story with vivid characters.
examples.zh: 作者精心构思了一个引人入胜的故事，人物形象生动。

examples.en: Traditional craft techniques are being preserved in this workshop.
examples.zh: 传统工艺技术正在这个工作坊中得到保护。

examples.en: He used his craft to build a small boat from scratch.
examples.zh: 他运用手艺从头开始建造了一艘小船。

examples.en: Professional ethic requires honesty and integrity in all dealings.
examples.zh: 职业道德要求在所有的交易中保持诚实和正直。

examples.en: The company has a strong work ethic that values punctuality.
examples.zh: 公司有强烈的工作伦理，重视准时。

examples.en: Ethic considerations are crucial in medical research.
examples.zh: 伦理考虑在医学研究中至关重要。

examples.en: She questioned the ethic of using animals for testing.
examples.zh: 她对使用动物进行测试的伦理提出了质疑。

examples.en: He wears many hats in the company, from manager to advisor.
examples.zh: 他在公司身兼多职，从经理到顾问。

examples.en: The children put on their hats before going out to play in the sun.
examples.zh: 孩子们在出去阳光下玩耍前戴上了帽子。

examples.en: She collects vintage hats from the 1920s.
examples.zh: 她收集20世纪20年代的复古帽子。

examples.en: In formal events, men often wear top hats.
examples.zh: 在正式场合，男士常戴高顶礼帽。

examples.en: The strong perfume seemed to intoxicate everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 强烈的香水似乎让房间里的每个人都陶醉了。

examples.en: Drinking too much alcohol can intoxicate a person quickly.
examples.zh: 喝太多酒会让人迅速醉酒。

examples.en: The beauty of the sunset intoxicated the onlookers.
examples.zh: 日落的美丽让旁观者陶醉。

examples.en: He felt intoxicated by the success of his first novel.
examples.zh: 他因第一部小说的成功而感到陶醉。

examples.en: She wore a colorful poncho to stay warm in the chilly weather.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件色彩鲜艳的披风，在寒冷的天气里保暖。

examples.en: The traditional poncho is often made from wool or alpaca.
examples.zh: 传统披风通常由羊毛或羊驼毛制成。

examples.en: He bought a poncho as a practical souvenir from South America.
examples.zh: 他从南美洲买了一件实用的披风作为纪念品。

examples.en: The poncho provided good protection against the rain during the hike.
examples.zh: 披风在徒步旅行中提供了良好的防雨保护。

examples.en: In Greek mythology, Athena is the goddess of wisdom and warfare.
examples.zh: 在希腊神话中，雅典娜是智慧和战争女神。

examples.en: She was treated like a goddess by her adoring fans.
examples.zh: 她被崇拜她的粉丝们奉为女神。

examples.en: The ancient temple was dedicated to the goddess of fertility.
examples.zh: 这座古庙是献给生育女神的。

examples.en: Many cultures have a goddess representing nature or the earth.
examples.zh: 许多文化都有代表自然或地球的女神。

examples.en: Only a few remnants of the ancient wall still stand today.
examples.zh: 今天只剩下古墙的几处残迹。

examples.en: He kept a remnant of the old fabric as a souvenir.
examples.zh: 他保留了一小块旧布料作为纪念。

examples.en: The remnant of the army retreated to the mountains.
examples.zh: 军队的残余部分撤退到了山区。

examples.en: After the sale, only a small remnant of the stock was left.
examples.zh: 促销后，只剩下少量库存残余。

examples.en: His bombastic speech was full of grandiose but empty promises.
examples.zh: 他那浮夸的演讲充满了华而不实的空洞承诺。

examples.en: The politician's bombastic rhetoric failed to impress the voters.
examples.zh: 那位政客浮夸的言辞未能打动选民。

examples.en: She criticized the author's bombastic writing style as overly dramatic.
examples.zh: 她批评作者浮夸的写作风格过于戏剧化。

examples.en: Avoid using bombastic language in a formal report; clarity is key.
examples.zh: 在正式报告中避免使用浮夸的语言，清晰才是关键。

examples.en: He was praised for his good deed of helping the elderly neighbor.
examples.zh: 他因帮助年迈邻居的善行而受到赞扬。

examples.en: The deed to the property must be signed and notarized.
examples.zh: 房产契约必须签署并公证。

examples.en: Her brave deeds during the rescue earned her a medal.
examples.zh: 她在救援中的英勇行为为她赢得了一枚奖章。

examples.en: The historical deed changed the course of the nation.
examples.zh: 这一历史壮举改变了国家的进程。

examples.en: The government's repression of free speech led to widespread protests.
examples.zh: 政府对言论自由的压制导致了广泛的抗议。

examples.en: He suffered from psychological repression of traumatic memories.
examples.zh: 他遭受了创伤记忆的心理压抑。

examples.en: The regime used repression to maintain control over the population.
examples.zh: 该政权使用镇压手段来维持对民众的控制。

examples.en: Repression of emotions can sometimes lead to mental health issues.
examples.zh: 压抑情绪有时会导致心理健康问题。

examples.en: We're planning a vacation to Hawaii next summer.
examples.zh: 我们计划明年夏天去夏威夷度假。

examples.en: She took a two-week vacation to recharge after a busy year.
examples.zh: 忙碌一年后，她休了两周假来恢复精力。

examples.en: During the school vacation, the children went camping.
examples.zh: 学校假期期间，孩子们去露营了。

examples.en: He saved money all year for a dream vacation in Europe.
examples.zh: 他全年攒钱为了去欧洲度一个梦想假期。

examples.en: Olfaction, or the sense of smell, is crucial for many animals.
examples.zh: 嗅觉，或称嗅觉，对许多动物至关重要。

examples.en: The study of olfaction helps us understand how scents affect behavior.
examples.zh: 嗅觉研究帮助我们理解气味如何影响行为。

examples.en: Humans have a less developed olfaction compared to dogs.
examples.zh: 与狗相比，人类的嗅觉较不发达。

examples.en: Disorders in olfaction can impact taste and quality of life.
examples.zh: 嗅觉障碍会影响味觉和生活质量。

examples.en: The small village is a microcosm of the country's diverse culture.
examples.zh: 这个小村庄是该国多元文化的一个缩影。

examples.en: In biology, a single cell can be seen as a microcosm of life.
examples.zh: 在生物学中，单个细胞可以被视为生命的缩影。

examples.en: The classroom serves as a microcosm of society, teaching social skills.
examples.zh: 教室作为社会的缩影，教授社交技能。

examples.en: This experiment is a microcosm of larger environmental processes.
examples.zh: 这个实验是更大环境过程的缩影。

examples.en: It's unconscionable to charge such high prices for essential medicine.
examples.zh: 对基本药物收取如此高的价格是不道德的。

examples.en: The company's unconscionable labor practices were exposed by the media.
examples.zh: 该公司不道德的劳动实践被媒体曝光了。

examples.en: He found the delay in aid to be unconscionable given the emergency.
examples.zh: 考虑到紧急情况，他认为援助的延迟是不合理的。

examples.en: An unconscionable contract may be voided by a court.
examples.zh: 不合理的合同可能被法院宣告无效。

examples.en: She is allergic to shellfish, so she avoids shrimp and crab.
examples.zh: 她对贝类过敏，所以避免吃虾和蟹。

examples.en: Shellfish like oysters and mussels are popular in seafood dishes.
examples.zh: 像牡蛎和贻贝这样的贝类在海鲜菜肴中很受欢迎。

examples.en: The restaurant specializes in fresh shellfish from the local coast.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅专营来自当地海岸的新鲜贝类。

examples.en: Harvesting shellfish requires careful attention to sustainability.
examples.zh: 捕捞贝类需要密切关注可持续性。

examples.en: Studies show that higher education levels correlate with increased lifetime earnings.
examples.zh: 研究表明，更高的教育水平与终身收入的增加相关。

examples.en: The scientist tried to correlate the data from different experiments to find a pattern.
examples.zh: 这位科学家试图将不同实验的数据关联起来，以寻找规律。

examples.en: There is a strong positive correlation between exercise and improved mental health.
examples.zh: 锻炼与改善心理健康之间存在强烈的正相关关系。

examples.en: The detective correlated the witness statements to build a timeline of events.
examples.zh: 侦探将目击者的陈述联系起来，构建了事件的时间线。

examples.en: The New York Philharmonic performed Beethoven's Ninth Symphony last night.
examples.zh: 纽约爱乐乐团昨晚演奏了贝多芬的第九交响曲。

examples.en: She has been a violinist with the London Philharmonic for over a decade.
examples.zh: 她担任伦敦爱乐乐团的小提琴手已超过十年。

examples.en: The philharmonic society organizes concerts and music education programs in the city.
examples.zh: 这个爱乐协会在城市里组织音乐会和音乐教育项目。

examples.en: Tickets for the philharmonic orchestra's seasonal gala are sold out.
examples.zh: 爱乐乐团季节庆典音乐会的门票已售罄。

examples.en: After the incident, the airline grounded all flights for safety checks.
examples.zh: 事故发生后，航空公司停飞了所有航班进行安全检查。

examples.en: His parents grounded him for a week after he broke curfew.
examples.zh: 他违反宵禁后，父母罚他禁足一周。

examples.en: She is a very grounded person who always keeps a realistic perspective.
examples.zh: 她是一个非常脚踏实地的人，总是保持现实的视角。

examples.en: The theory is grounded in extensive research and empirical evidence.
examples.zh: 这个理论基于广泛的研究和实证证据。

examples.en: Life expectancy in Japan is among the highest in the world.
examples.zh: 日本的预期寿命位居世界前列。

examples.en: The expectancy of a promotion kept him motivated at work.
examples.zh: 对晋升的期望让他在工作中保持动力。

examples.en: There is a general expectancy that the new policy will improve the economy.
examples.zh: 人们普遍预期新政策将改善经济。

examples.en: The expectancy theory in psychology explains how motivation is influenced by anticipated outcomes.
examples.zh: 心理学中的期望理论解释了动机如何受预期结果的影响。

examples.en: The melancholy melody of the song brought tears to her eyes.
examples.zh: 这首歌忧郁的旋律让她热泪盈眶。

examples.en: He felt a deep sense of melancholy after saying goodbye to his friends.
examples.zh: 与朋友们告别后，他感到深深的忧郁。

examples.en: The old photographs evoked a melancholy nostalgia for times past.
examples.zh: 这些旧照片唤起了对往昔时光忧郁的怀旧之情。

examples.en: Her melancholy mood was evident in the somber tone of her writing.
examples.zh: 她写作中阴沉的语调明显流露出忧郁的情绪。

examples.en: My roommate and I share the rent and utilities for our apartment.
examples.zh: 我和室友共同分担公寓的租金和水电费。

examples.en: She found a compatible roommate through an online matching service.
examples.zh: 她通过在线匹配服务找到了一个合得来的室友。

examples.en: His roommate is studying abroad this semester, so he has the room to himself.
examples.zh: 他的室友这学期在国外留学，所以他独享这个房间。

examples.en: They became close friends after living as roommates in college.
examples.zh: 大学时作为室友同住后，他们成了亲密的朋友。

examples.en: She carefully folded each garment before packing it in her suitcase.
examples.zh: 她把每件衣服仔细叠好，然后放进手提箱。

examples.en: The fashion designer unveiled a new line of sustainable garments.
examples.zh: 这位时装设计师推出了一个新的可持续服装系列。

examples.en: This garment is made from high-quality cotton for maximum comfort.
examples.zh: 这件衣服由高品质棉制成，以确保最大的舒适度。

examples.en: He works in a garment factory that produces clothing for international brands.
examples.zh: 他在一家为国际品牌生产服装的制衣厂工作。

examples.en: The politicians bandied accusations back and forth during the debate.
examples.zh: 政客们在辩论中互相指责，你来我往。

examples.en: They bandied ideas around in the brainstorming session.
examples.zh: 他们在头脑风暴会议上互相交流想法。

examples.en: The term 'fake news' has been bandied about a lot in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，“假新闻”这个词被频繁使用。

examples.en: He bandied words with his opponent in a heated argument.
examples.zh: 他在激烈的争论中与对手唇枪舌剑。

examples.en: Initially, I was hesitant to accept the job offer, but I'm glad I did.
examples.zh: 起初，我对接受这份工作邀请犹豫不决，但现在很高兴我接受了。

examples.en: The project was initially scheduled to finish in June, but it got delayed.
examples.zh: 这个项目最初计划在六月完成，但被推迟了。

examples.en: She initially thought the movie would be boring, but ended up loving it.
examples.zh: 她起初以为这部电影会很无聊，但最终却很喜欢。

examples.en: Initially, the company focused on local markets before expanding internationally.
examples.zh: 起初，公司在国际化扩张前专注于本地市场。

examples.en: The customer service representative was very helpful in resolving my issue.
examples.zh: 客服代表在解决我的问题时非常乐于助人。

examples.en: Reading the manual can be helpful when learning how to use a new device.
examples.zh: 学习使用新设备时，阅读说明书会很有帮助。

examples.en: His advice was helpful in making a difficult decision.
examples.zh: 他的建议对做出一个困难的决定很有帮助。

examples.en: She always tries to be helpful by offering assistance to her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她总是通过向同事提供帮助来尽力助人。

examples.en: She slipped on her comfortable slippers before walking to the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她穿上舒适的拖鞋，然后走向厨房。

examples.en: The wet floor caused him to lose his footing and his slipper flew off.
examples.zh: 湿滑的地板让他脚下一滑，拖鞋都飞了出去。

examples.en: In many Asian cultures, it's customary to remove outdoor shoes and wear slippers indoors.
examples.zh: 在许多亚洲文化中，习惯在室内脱掉户外鞋，穿上拖鞋。

examples.en: He found a single slipper under the bed, but its pair was nowhere in sight.
examples.zh: 他在床下找到一只拖鞋，但另一只却不见踪影。

examples.en: She managed to concoct a delicious meal from the few ingredients left in the fridge.
examples.zh: 她用冰箱里仅剩的几种食材，设法烹制出了一顿美味的饭菜。

examples.en: The children loved to concoct imaginative stories about their adventures in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢编造关于他们在后院冒险的富有想象力的故事。

examples.en: He was accused of concocting a false alibi to cover up his involvement in the crime.
examples.zh: 他被指控编造虚假的不在场证明，以掩盖自己参与犯罪的事实。

examples.en: The scientist worked tirelessly to concoct a new formula that could revolutionize the industry.
examples.zh: 这位科学家孜孜不倦地研制一种可能彻底改变行业的新配方。

examples.en: She quickly zipped up her jacket as the cold wind began to blow.
examples.zh: 寒风开始吹起，她迅速拉上了夹克的拉链。

examples.en: The car zipped past us on the highway, going well over the speed limit.
examples.zh: 那辆车在高速公路上从我们身边疾驰而过，速度远超限速。

examples.en: Make sure to zip the file before sending it via email to reduce its size.
examples.zh: 通过电子邮件发送文件前，务必将其压缩以减小文件大小。

examples.en: He felt a sudden zip of excitement when he heard the good news.
examples.zh: 听到这个好消息时，他突然感到一阵兴奋。

examples.en: The police had to use force to subdue the violent protester.
examples.zh: 警方不得不使用武力制服了那名暴力抗议者。

examples.en: She tried to subdue her anger and respond calmly to the criticism.
examples.zh: 她试图抑制住怒火，冷静地回应批评。

examples.en: The dim lighting in the restaurant helped to subdue the noise and create a cozy atmosphere.
examples.zh: 餐厅里昏暗的灯光有助于降低噪音，营造出温馨的氛围。

examples.en: After a long struggle, the firefighters managed to subdue the raging blaze.
examples.zh: 经过长时间的奋战，消防员们终于控制住了熊熊大火。

examples.en: The wilful child refused to eat his vegetables, no matter how much his parents pleaded.
examples.zh: 那个任性的孩子无论如何都不肯吃蔬菜，不管父母怎么恳求。

examples.en: His wilful ignorance of the facts led to a series of poor decisions.
examples.zh: 他故意无视事实，导致了一系列糟糕的决定。

examples.en: The court found him guilty of wilful negligence in the handling of the company's finances.
examples.zh: 法庭认定他在处理公司财务方面存在故意疏忽。

examples.en: Despite the warnings, she made a wilful choice to pursue the risky investment.
examples.zh: 尽管有警告，她还是执意选择了进行这项风险投资。

examples.en: To improve your piano skills, you need to practise for at least an hour every day.
examples.zh: 要提高钢琴技巧，你需要每天至少练习一个小时。

examples.en: It's common practise in this industry to conduct background checks on all new employees.
examples.zh: 在这个行业，对所有新员工进行背景调查是常见的做法。

examples.en: She decided to practise law after graduating from university, specializing in corporate cases.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后，她决定从事法律工作，专攻公司案件。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to practise mindfulness meditation to reduce stress and anxiety.
examples.zh: 医生建议他练习正念冥想，以减轻压力和焦虑。

examples.en: Scientists are closely monitoring the new variant of the virus to assess its transmissibility.
examples.zh: 科学家们正在密切监测这种病毒的新变种，以评估其传播性。

examples.en: This recipe is a variant of the traditional dish, with a few modern twists.
examples.zh: 这个食谱是传统菜肴的一个变体，加入了一些现代元素。

examples.en: The software update includes a variant of the user interface designed for better accessibility.
examples.zh: 软件更新包含了一个用户界面的变体，旨在提高可访问性。

examples.en: In genetics, a single nucleotide polymorphism is a common type of DNA variant.
examples.zh: 在遗传学中，单核苷酸多态性是一种常见的DNA变异类型。

examples.en: His sententious remarks during the meeting annoyed everyone, as they sounded preachy and condescending.
examples.zh: 他在会议上的说教式言论惹恼了所有人，听起来既像说教又显得高高在上。

examples.en: The book is filled with sententious proverbs that offer moral guidance but little practical advice.
examples.zh: 这本书充满了说教式的格言，提供道德指导，但缺乏实用建议。

examples.en: She avoided giving sententious speeches, preferring to communicate in a more straightforward and relatable manner.
examples.zh: 她避免发表说教式的演讲，更喜欢以更直接、更易理解的方式交流。

examples.en: The teacher's sententious tone made the students tune out during the lecture on ethics.
examples.zh: 老师那种说教式的语气让学生们在伦理课上走神了。

examples.en: The sudden silence in the normally bustling city was deeply unsettling.
examples.zh: 这座通常熙熙攘攘的城市突然陷入寂静，令人深感不安。

examples.en: She had an unsettling dream that left her feeling anxious all morning.
examples.zh: 她做了一个令人不安的梦，导致她一整个上午都感到焦虑。

examples.en: The documentary presented unsettling evidence about the environmental impact of plastic waste.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片展示了关于塑料废弃物环境影响的不安证据。

examples.en: His unpredictable behavior became increasingly unsettling to those around him.
examples.zh: 他难以预测的行为让周围人越来越感到不安。

examples.en: In medieval times, the apothecary was responsible for preparing and dispensing medicines.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，药剂师负责配制和分发药物。

examples.en: She visited the old apothecary shop to buy some herbal remedies for her insomnia.
examples.zh: 她去了那家老式药店，购买一些治疗失眠的草药疗法。

examples.en: The apothecary's jars were filled with various dried herbs and mysterious potions.
examples.zh: 药剂师的罐子里装满了各种干草药和神秘的药水。

examples.en: Modern pharmacies have evolved from the traditional apothecaries of the past.
examples.zh: 现代药房是由过去的传统药店演变而来的。

examples.en: The building has three floors, including a basement.
examples.zh: 这栋楼有三层，包括一个地下室。

examples.en: She mopped the floors until they were spotless.
examples.zh: 她把地板拖得一尘不染。

examples.en: The stock market fell several floors after the bad news.
examples.zh: 坏消息传出后，股市下跌了好几层。

examples.en: He floors his opponent with a single punch.
examples.zh: 他一拳就把对手打倒在地。

examples.en: The search results came back nil, so we had to start over.
examples.zh: 搜索结果为零，我们不得不重新开始。

examples.en: In the game, his score was nil, meaning he didn't earn any points.
examples.zh: 在游戏中，他的得分是零，意味着他没有得到任何分数。

examples.en: The contract is void if the payment is nil.
examples.zh: 如果付款为零，合同无效。

examples.en: Her chances of winning are practically nil.
examples.zh: 她获胜的机会几乎为零。

examples.en: New York City is a bustling metropolis with millions of residents.
examples.zh: 纽约市是一个拥有数百万居民的繁华大都市。

examples.en: The metropolis expanded rapidly due to industrialization.
examples.zh: 由于工业化，这个大都市迅速扩张。

examples.en: Life in a metropolis can be both exciting and overwhelming.
examples.zh: 大都市的生活既令人兴奋又让人应接不暇。

examples.en: The film depicts a futuristic metropolis with advanced technology.
examples.zh: 这部电影描绘了一个拥有先进技术的未来大都市。

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's osseous structure for fractures.
examples.zh: 医生检查了患者的骨骼结构是否有骨折。

examples.en: Osseous tissue is crucial for providing support and protection in the body.
examples.zh: 骨组织对于提供身体支撑和保护至关重要。

examples.en: The fossil showed well-preserved osseous remains of a dinosaur.
examples.zh: 化石显示了一具保存完好的恐龙骨骼遗骸。

examples.en: Arthritis can affect the osseous joints, causing pain and stiffness.
examples.zh: 关节炎会影响骨关节，导致疼痛和僵硬。

examples.en: It is your responsibility to complete the project on time.
examples.zh: 按时完成项目是你的责任。

examples.en: Parents have a responsibility to care for their children.
examples.zh: 父母有责任照顾他们的孩子。

examples.en: He took full responsibility for the mistake and apologized.
examples.zh: 他为错误承担了全部责任并道歉。

examples.en: With great power comes great responsibility.
examples.zh: 能力越大，责任越大。

examples.en: She stared at the computer screen for hours, working on the report.
examples.zh: 她盯着电脑屏幕几个小时，忙着写报告。

examples.en: The movie will be screened at the local theater next week.
examples.zh: 这部电影将于下周在本地影院上映。

examples.en: Use a screen to protect the window from insects.
examples.zh: 使用纱窗来防止昆虫进入窗户。

examples.en: The company screens all applicants before hiring them.
examples.zh: 公司在雇佣前会筛选所有申请人。

examples.en: We are having a small gathering of friends at our house tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我们将在家里举办一个小型的朋友聚会。

examples.en: The gathering of data took several months to complete.
examples.zh: 数据收集花了几个月才完成。

examples.en: A large gathering formed in the park to protest the new law.
examples.zh: 一大群人在公园聚集，抗议新法律。

examples.en: The gathering storm clouds indicated that rain was coming soon.
examples.zh: 聚集的乌云表明雨即将来临。

examples.en: The city plans to widen the road to reduce traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 该市计划拓宽道路以减少交通拥堵。

examples.en: Her eyes widened in surprise when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 当她听到这个消息时，她的眼睛因惊讶而睁大了。

examples.en: Reading books can help widen your knowledge and perspective.
examples.zh: 阅读书籍可以帮助拓宽你的知识和视野。

examples.en: The gap between rich and poor continues to widen in many countries.
examples.zh: 在许多国家，贫富差距继续扩大。

examples.en: She is very ticklish and laughs when you touch her feet.
examples.zh: 她非常怕痒，当你碰她的脚时她会笑。

examples.en: The situation is quite ticklish and requires careful handling.
examples.zh: 这个情况相当棘手，需要小心处理。

examples.en: He avoided the ticklish subject during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在会议中避开了这个敏感话题。

examples.en: The baby has a ticklish spot on his back that makes him giggle.
examples.zh: 婴儿背上有一个怕痒的地方，一碰就会咯咯笑。

examples.en: The fractious child refused to listen to his parents.
examples.zh: 这个易怒的孩子拒绝听父母的话。

examples.en: The meeting became fractious as disagreements arose.
examples.zh: 随着分歧的出现，会议变得争吵不休。

examples.en: Managing a fractious team can be challenging for any leader.
examples.zh: 管理一个难以驾驭的团队对任何领导者来说都是一种挑战。

examples.en: The fractious debate lasted for hours without resolution.
examples.zh: 这场激烈的辩论持续了几个小时，没有达成决议。

examples.en: She decorated the cake with a sprig of fresh mint.
examples.zh: 她用一小枝新鲜薄荷装饰了蛋糕。

examples.en: He wore a sprig of holly in his buttonhole for the holiday party.
examples.zh: 他在假日派对上在纽扣孔里别了一小枝冬青。

examples.en: The recipe calls for a sprig of rosemary to infuse flavor into the dish.
examples.zh: 食谱要求用一小枝迷迭香来给菜肴增添风味。

examples.en: A sprig of lavender can help promote relaxation when placed under your pillow.
examples.zh: 一小枝薰衣草放在枕头下有助于促进放松。

examples.en: The doctor administered the antidote immediately after the snake bite.
examples.zh: 医生在蛇咬后立即注射了解毒剂。

examples.en: Laughter is often considered the best antidote to stress.
examples.zh: 笑声常被认为是缓解压力的最佳解药。

examples.en: They developed an antidote to counteract the effects of the poison.
examples.zh: 他们研制出一种解毒剂来抵消毒药的影响。

examples.en: Education is seen as an antidote to ignorance and prejudice.
examples.zh: 教育被视为对抗无知和偏见的良方。

examples.en: After all I've done for him, he turned out to be an ingrate who never said thank you.
examples.zh: 在我为他做了这么多之后，他竟是个从不道谢的忘恩负义之人。

examples.en: She called him an ingrate for not appreciating her help during tough times.
examples.zh: 她称他为忘恩负义之徒，因为他在困难时期不感激她的帮助。

examples.en: It's disheartening to be labeled an ingrate by someone you've supported.
examples.zh: 被你支持过的人贴上忘恩负义的标签令人沮丧。

examples.en: The ingrate refused to acknowledge the sacrifices made on his behalf.
examples.zh: 那个忘恩负义的人拒绝承认别人为他做出的牺牲。

examples.en: The rapid industrialization of the region led to significant economic growth.
examples.zh: 该地区的快速工业化带来了显著的经济增长。

examples.en: Industrialization often brings environmental challenges that need to be addressed.
examples.zh: 工业化常常带来需要解决的环境挑战。

examples.en: The shift from agriculture to industrialization transformed many societies in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 从农业向工业化的转变在19世纪改变了许多社会。

examples.en: Sustainable industrialization is key to balancing development with ecological preservation.
examples.zh: 可持续工业化是平衡发展与生态保护的关键。

examples.en: The artist painted a nude figure in the classical style.
examples.zh: 艺术家以古典风格绘制了一幅裸体人物画。

examples.en: She prefers to sleep in the nude for better comfort.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢裸睡以获得更舒适的体验。

examples.en: The beach has a designated area for nude sunbathing.
examples.zh: 这个海滩有一个指定的区域供裸体日光浴。

examples.en: He was arrested for appearing nude in public as a form of protest.
examples.zh: 他因在公共场合裸体作为抗议形式而被捕。

examples.en: Make sure you know the egress routes in case of an emergency.
examples.zh: 确保你知道紧急情况下的出口路线。

examples.en: The building's egress was blocked by fallen debris after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震后，建筑物的出口被掉落的碎片堵住了。

examples.en: Fire codes require clear egress paths in all public spaces.
examples.zh: 消防法规要求所有公共空间都有清晰的出口通道。

examples.en: They installed additional egress windows in the basement for safety.
examples.zh: 他们在地下室安装了额外的出口窗户以确保安全。

examples.en: The product was recalled due to a faulty wiring system.
examples.zh: 该产品因线路系统有缺陷而被召回。

examples.en: His argument was based on faulty logic and couldn't be sustained.
examples.zh: 他的论点基于错误的逻辑，无法成立。

examples.en: The faulty brake caused the car accident on the highway.
examples.zh: 有缺陷的刹车导致了高速公路上的车祸。

examples.en: We need to replace the faulty equipment to avoid further issues.
examples.zh: 我们需要更换有故障的设备以避免更多问题。

examples.en: He's always in a jolly mood, spreading cheer wherever he goes.
examples.zh: 他总是心情愉快，走到哪里都传播欢乐。

examples.en: We had a jolly time at the party, laughing and dancing all night.
examples.zh: 我们在派对上玩得很开心，整晚都在笑和跳舞。

examples.en: She gave a jolly wave as she boarded the train.
examples.zh: 她登上火车时愉快地挥了挥手。

examples.en: The jolly old man told funny stories to the children.
examples.zh: 那个快乐的老头给孩子们讲有趣的故事。

examples.en: It took hours to disentangle the knots in the fishing line.
examples.zh: 花了几个小时才解开钓鱼线上的结。

examples.en: She tried to disentangle herself from the complicated relationship.
examples.zh: 她试图从这段复杂的关系中解脱出来。

examples.en: The detective worked to disentangle the clues in the mysterious case.
examples.zh: 侦探努力理清这个神秘案件中的线索。

examples.en: We need to disentangle the facts from the rumors to understand the truth.
examples.zh: 我们需要将事实与谣言分开以了解真相。

examples.en: The scabrous surface of the rock made it difficult to climb.
examples.zh: 岩石粗糙的表面使得攀爬变得困难。

examples.en: He avoided discussing the scabrous details of the scandal.
examples.zh: 他避免讨论丑闻中那些粗俗的细节。

examples.en: The old book had a scabrous cover that was falling apart.
examples.zh: 那本旧书的封面粗糙，正在散架。

examples.en: Her scabrous humor offended some members of the audience.
examples.zh: 她粗俗的幽默冒犯了部分观众。

examples.en: There's a big difference between theory and practice.
examples.zh: 理论与实践之间有很大的差别。

examples.en: The main difference lies in their approach to problem-solving.
examples.zh: 主要区别在于他们解决问题的方法。

examples.en: It makes no difference to me whether we go today or tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们今天去还是明天去，对我来说没什么两样。

examples.en: She noticed the subtle difference in his tone.
examples.zh: 她注意到了他语气中的细微差异。

examples.en: He hied himself to the library to study for the exam.
examples.zh: 他急忙赶往图书馆准备考试。

examples.en: The messenger hied to deliver the urgent news.
examples.zh: 信使急忙去传递这个紧急消息。

examples.en: They hied off to the countryside for a weekend getaway.
examples.zh: 他们匆忙赶往乡下度周末。

examples.en: She hied to the store before it closed.
examples.zh: 她在商店关门前急忙赶去。

examples.en: The museum offers many educational programs for children.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆为儿童提供了许多教育项目。

examples.en: Watching that documentary was a highly educational experience.
examples.zh: 观看那部纪录片是一次非常有教育意义的经历。

examples.en: She works in the educational sector as a curriculum developer.
examples.zh: 她在教育部门担任课程开发人员。

examples.en: The trip to the science center was both fun and educational.
examples.zh: 去科学中心的旅行既有趣又有教育意义。

examples.en: She decided to study abroad for a year.
examples.zh: 她决定出国留学一年。

examples.en: Rumors about the scandal quickly spread abroad.
examples.zh: 关于丑闻的谣言迅速传开了。

examples.en: He travels abroad frequently for business.
examples.zh: 他经常因公出国旅行。

examples.en: The company has branches abroad in several countries.
examples.zh: 这家公司在国外几个国家设有分支机构。

examples.en: The ship was assigned a berth at the dock.
examples.zh: 这艘船被分配了一个码头泊位。

examples.en: He booked a lower berth on the overnight train.
examples.zh: 他在夜班火车上预订了一个下铺。

examples.en: The captain gave the other vessel a wide berth.
examples.zh: 船长给了另一艘船一个宽阔的避让距离。

examples.en: The new employee was given a wide berth by her colleagues.
examples.zh: 新员工被同事们敬而远之。

examples.en: I need to finish this report now.
examples.zh: 我现在需要完成这份报告。

examples.en: Now that you mention it, I do remember that incident.
examples.zh: 既然你提到，我确实记得那件事。

examples.en: From now on, we'll follow the new guidelines.
examples.zh: 从现在起，我们将遵循新的指导方针。

examples.en: Right now, the most important thing is to stay calm.
examples.zh: 眼下最重要的事情是保持冷静。

examples.en: They faced insuperable obstacles in their research.
examples.zh: 他们在研究中遇到了无法克服的障碍。

examples.en: The language barrier seemed insuperable at first.
examples.zh: 起初，语言障碍似乎无法逾越。

examples.en: His determination helped him overcome what others saw as insuperable difficulties.
examples.zh: 他的决心帮助他克服了别人认为无法逾越的困难。

examples.en: The financial challenges proved to be insuperable for the small business.
examples.zh: 财务挑战对这家小企业来说被证明是无法克服的。

examples.en: Exercise can help strengthen your muscles.
examples.zh: 锻炼可以帮助增强你的肌肉。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to strengthen their economic ties.
examples.zh: 两国同意加强经济联系。

examples.en: She took a course to strengthen her leadership skills.
examples.zh: 她参加了一个课程来加强她的领导技能。

examples.en: The new evidence will strengthen our case in court.
examples.zh: 新证据将加强我们在法庭上的案件。

examples.en: As an iconoclast, he challenged traditional beliefs in art.
examples.zh: 作为一个反传统者，他挑战了艺术中的传统观念。

examples.en: The scientist was considered an iconoclast for her revolutionary theories.
examples.zh: 这位科学家因其革命性理论而被视为反传统者。

examples.en: Iconoclasts often face resistance from established institutions.
examples.zh: 反传统者常常面临来自既定机构的阻力。

examples.en: His iconoclastic views on education sparked much debate.
examples.zh: 他对教育的反传统观点引发了许多争论。

examples.en: He was accused of trying to pervert the course of justice.
examples.zh: 他被指控试图妨碍司法公正。

examples.en: The film was criticized for perverting historical facts.
examples.zh: 这部电影因歪曲历史事实而受到批评。

examples.en: Some argue that technology can pervert human relationships.
examples.zh: 有些人认为技术会扭曲人际关系。

examples.en: The cult leader perverted the teachings of the religion for his own gain.
examples.zh: 邪教领袖为了自己的利益歪曲了宗教教义。

examples.en: The photosphere is the visible surface of the Sun, emitting most of its light.
examples.zh: 光球层是太阳的可见表面，发出大部分的光。

examples.en: Astronomers study the photosphere to understand solar activity.
examples.zh: 天文学家研究光球层以了解太阳活动。

examples.en: The photosphere appears as a bright disk during a solar eclipse.
examples.zh: 在日食期间，光球层呈现为一个明亮的圆盘。

examples.en: Temperatures in the photosphere can reach thousands of degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 光球层的温度可达数千摄氏度。

examples.en: The acarpous plant failed to produce any fruit this season.
examples.zh: 这棵不结果实的植物这个季节没有结出任何果实。

examples.en: Acarpous trees are often used for ornamental purposes in gardens.
examples.zh: 不结果实的树木常被用于花园的装饰目的。

examples.en: Some acarpous species are valued for their foliage rather than their fruit.
examples.zh: 一些不结果实的物种因其叶子而非果实而受到重视。

examples.en: The acarpous condition can be due to environmental stress or genetic factors.
examples.zh: 不结果实的状况可能是由于环境压力或遗传因素造成的。

examples.en: I drink a cup of coffee every morning to start my day.
examples.zh: 我每天早上喝一杯咖啡来开始我的一天。

examples.en: Coffee shops are popular places for socializing and working.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆是社交和工作的热门场所。

examples.en: The coffee beans are roasted to bring out their rich flavor.
examples.zh: 咖啡豆经过烘焙以带出其浓郁的风味。

examples.en: She prefers her coffee black without any sugar or milk.
examples.zh: 她喜欢黑咖啡，不加任何糖或牛奶。

examples.en: We have occasional meetings to discuss project updates.
examples.zh: 我们偶尔开会讨论项目更新。

examples.en: He enjoys an occasional glass of wine with dinner.
examples.zh: 他喜欢偶尔在晚餐时喝一杯葡萄酒。

examples.en: The occasional rain shower helps keep the garden green.
examples.zh: 偶尔的阵雨有助于保持花园的绿色。

examples.en: She writes occasional articles for the local newspaper.
examples.zh: 她偶尔为当地报纸撰写文章。

examples.en: She felt apprehensive about the upcoming exam.
examples.zh: 她对即将到来的考试感到担忧。

examples.en: He was apprehensive about moving to a new city alone.
examples.zh: 他对独自搬到新城市感到不安。

examples.en: The team was apprehensive about the new manager's strict policies.
examples.zh: 团队对新经理的严格政策感到忧虑。

examples.en: Apprehensive parents often worry about their children's safety.
examples.zh: 担忧的父母常常担心孩子的安全。

examples.en: He has a conservative approach to investing, preferring low-risk options.
examples.zh: 他对投资持保守态度，倾向于低风险选项。

examples.en: The conservative party advocates for traditional values and limited government.
examples.zh: 保守党倡导传统价值观和有限政府。

examples.en: She dresses in a conservative style, avoiding flashy outfits.
examples.zh: 她穿着保守的风格，避免花哨的服装。

examples.en: A conservative estimate suggests the project will take six months.
examples.zh: 保守估计表明该项目将需要六个月。

examples.en: It's strange that he hasn't called back yet.
examples.zh: 奇怪的是他还没有回电话。

examples.en: She heard a strange noise coming from the attic.
examples.zh: 她听到阁楼传来奇怪的声音。

examples.en: The strange behavior of the animals indicated an approaching storm.
examples.zh: 动物的奇怪行为预示着暴风雨即将来临。

examples.en: He had a strange feeling that someone was watching him.
examples.zh: 他有一种奇怪的感觉，觉得有人在看他。

examples.en: The seismic activity in the region has increased recently.
examples.zh: 该地区的地震活动最近有所增加。

examples.en: Seismic waves are used to study the Earth's interior structure.
examples.zh: 地震波被用来研究地球的内部结构。

examples.en: The seismic shift in public opinion led to policy changes.
examples.zh: 公众舆论的地震性转变导致了政策变化。

examples.en: Buildings in earthquake-prone areas are designed to withstand seismic forces.
examples.zh: 地震多发地区的建筑物被设计成能承受地震力。

examples.en: I absolutely agree with your proposal.
examples.zh: 我完全同意你的提议。

examples.en: The food at that restaurant is absolutely delicious.
examples.zh: 那家餐厅的食物绝对美味。

examples.en: She was absolutely certain about her decision.
examples.zh: 她对自己的决定绝对确定。

examples.en: It's absolutely necessary to wear a helmet while biking.
examples.zh: 骑自行车时绝对有必要戴头盔。

examples.en: She beckoned to her friend to come closer.
examples.zh: 她向朋友招手示意靠近。

examples.en: The open road beckoned him to start a new adventure.
examples.zh: 开阔的道路召唤他开始新的冒险。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread beckoned customers into the bakery.
examples.zh: 新鲜面包的香味吸引顾客进入面包店。

examples.en: He felt the sea beckoning him to return to his hometown.
examples.zh: 他感到大海在召唤他回到家乡。

examples.en: The bad weather adversely affected the crop yield.
examples.zh: 恶劣天气对农作物产量产生了不利影响。

examples.en: Smoking can adversely impact your health.
examples.zh: 吸烟会对你的健康产生负面影响。

examples.en: The new policy may adversely influence small businesses.
examples.zh: 新政策可能会对小企业产生不利影响。

examples.en: His comments adversely affected the team's morale.
examples.zh: 他的评论对团队士气产生了负面影响。

examples.en: She has strong managerial skills and leads the team effectively.
examples.zh: 她具备很强的管理技能，能有效领导团队。

examples.en: The company is restructuring its managerial hierarchy.
examples.zh: 公司正在重组其管理层级。

examples.en: He attended a managerial training program last month.
examples.zh: 他上个月参加了一个管理培训项目。

examples.en: Managerial decisions often require careful consideration.
examples.zh: 管理决策通常需要仔细考虑。

examples.en: He has been practicing boxing since he was a teenager.
examples.zh: 他从青少年时期就开始练习拳击。

examples.en: Boxing is a popular sport that requires both strength and strategy.
examples.zh: 拳击是一项需要力量和策略的流行运动。

examples.en: They watched a professional boxing match on TV last night.
examples.zh: 他们昨晚在电视上观看了一场职业拳击比赛。

examples.en: Safety gear is essential in boxing to prevent injuries.
examples.zh: 在拳击中，安全装备对于防止受伤至关重要。

examples.en: His captious criticism made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他吹毛求疵的批评让每个人都感到不舒服。

examples.en: She has a captious attitude towards minor details.
examples.zh: 她对小细节持吹毛求疵的态度。

examples.en: Avoid being captious when giving feedback to colleagues.
examples.zh: 给同事反馈时，避免吹毛求疵。

examples.en: The captious reviewer found fault with every aspect of the book.
examples.zh: 那位吹毛求疵的评论家对这本书的每个方面都挑毛病。

examples.en: The surface of the lake was calm and smooth.
examples.zh: 湖面平静而光滑。

examples.en: Scratches on the surface can be polished out.
examples.zh: 表面的划痕可以被抛光去除。

examples.en: The problem only surfaced after months of investigation.
examples.zh: 这个问题在调查数月后才浮出水面。

examples.en: We need to look beyond the surface to understand the issue.
examples.zh: 我们需要透过表面现象来理解这个问题。

examples.en: His unorthodox teaching methods surprised the students.
examples.zh: 他非传统的教学方法让学生们感到惊讶。

examples.en: She took an unorthodox approach to solving the problem.
examples.zh: 她采用了一种非传统的方法来解决问题。

examples.en: The artist's unorthodox style gained much attention.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家非传统的风格引起了广泛关注。

examples.en: Unorthodox ideas can sometimes lead to innovation.
examples.zh: 非正统的想法有时能带来创新。

examples.en: Mushrooms are a type of edible fungus.
examples.zh: 蘑菇是一种可食用的真菌。

examples.en: The damp conditions encouraged the growth of fungus on the walls.
examples.zh: 潮湿的环境促使墙上长出了真菌。

examples.en: Some types of fungus can cause infections in humans.
examples.zh: 某些类型的真菌会导致人类感染。

examples.en: Scientists study fungus for its potential medical uses.
examples.zh: 科学家研究真菌以探索其潜在的医疗用途。

examples.en: The event was held under the auspices of the local government.
examples.zh: 这次活动是在地方政府的赞助下举办的。

examples.en: The research project operates under the auspices of a university.
examples.zh: 这个研究项目在一所大学的赞助下运作。

examples.en: With the auspices of several sponsors, the charity succeeded.
examples.zh: 在几位赞助人的支持下，慈善活动取得了成功。

examples.en: The festival is organized under the auspices of a cultural association.
examples.zh: 这个节日是在一个文化协会的赞助下组织的。

examples.en: The sky was a clear blue on a sunny day.
examples.zh: 晴朗的日子里，天空是清澈的蓝色。

examples.en: She felt blue after hearing the sad news.
examples.zh: 听到这个悲伤的消息后，她感到忧郁。

examples.en: He wore a blue shirt to the interview.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件蓝色衬衫去面试。

examples.en: The team's blue uniforms are easily recognizable.
examples.zh: 这个团队的蓝色制服很容易辨认。

examples.en: The restaurant caters to a variety of dietary preferences.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅迎合各种饮食偏好。

examples.en: We need to cater to the needs of our customers.
examples.zh: 我们需要满足客户的需求。

examples.en: The event planner will cater for 100 guests.
examples.zh: 活动策划者将为100位客人提供餐饮服务。

examples.en: The school program caters to students of all abilities.
examples.zh: 这个学校项目面向所有能力水平的学生。

examples.en: In mathematics, an exponent indicates how many times a number is multiplied by itself.
examples.zh: 在数学中，指数表示一个数乘以自身的次数。

examples.en: She is a leading exponent of modern dance in the country.
examples.zh: 她是该国现代舞的主要代表人物。

examples.en: The exponent of this scientific theory has published several influential papers.
examples.zh: 这一科学理论的倡导者已发表多篇有影响力的论文。

examples.en: The exponent in the equation determines the rate of growth.
examples.zh: 方程中的指数决定了增长率。

examples.en: I can assure you that the project will be completed on time.
examples.zh: 我可以向你保证，项目会按时完成。

examples.en: The company took steps to assure the safety of its employees.
examples.zh: 公司采取措施确保员工的安全。

examples.en: He assured his parents that he would study hard for the exam.
examples.zh: 他向父母保证会为考试努力学习。

examples.en: To assure quality, each product undergoes rigorous testing.
examples.zh: 为确保质量，每个产品都经过严格测试。

examples.en: In British slang, a fag is a cigarette.
examples.zh: 在英国俚语中，fag 指香烟。

examples.en: He felt like a fag after running the marathon.
examples.zh: 跑完马拉松后，他感到筋疲力尽。

examples.en: The term 'fag' is considered offensive when used as a slur against gay people.
examples.zh: 当用作对同性恋者的侮辱时，'fag' 一词被视为冒犯性用语。

examples.en: In some schools, younger students were forced to fag for older ones.
examples.zh: 在一些学校里，低年级学生被迫为高年级学生跑腿。

examples.en: The country is ruled by a gerontocracy, with most leaders over 70 years old.
examples.zh: 这个国家由老人统治，大多数领导人超过70岁。

examples.en: Critics argue that the gerontocracy stifles innovation and new ideas.
examples.zh: 批评者认为老人统治扼杀了创新和新思想。

examples.en: In a gerontocracy, power is concentrated in the hands of the elderly.
examples.zh: 在老人统治中，权力集中在老年人手中。

examples.en: The political system has been described as a gerontocracy due to its aging leadership.
examples.zh: 由于其老龄化的领导层，该政治体系被描述为老人统治。

examples.en: He is an inveterate gambler who has lost a fortune over the years.
examples.zh: 他是个积习难改的赌徒，多年来输掉了一大笔钱。

examples.en: She has an inveterate habit of biting her nails when nervous.
examples.zh: 她有一个根深蒂固的习惯，紧张时会咬指甲。

examples.en: The inveterate smoker found it hard to quit despite health warnings.
examples.zh: 尽管有健康警告，这个烟瘾很深的人发现戒烟很难。

examples.en: His inveterate optimism helped him through many difficult times.
examples.zh: 他根深蒂固的乐观主义帮助他度过了许多困难时期。

examples.en: Kerosene is commonly used as fuel for lamps and heaters in rural areas.
examples.zh: 煤油在农村地区常用作灯和加热器的燃料。

examples.en: The smell of kerosene filled the air after the spill.
examples.zh: 泄漏后，空气中弥漫着煤油的气味。

examples.en: Many aircraft use kerosene-based jet fuel for propulsion.
examples.zh: 许多飞机使用煤油基喷气燃料推进。

examples.en: She lit the kerosene stove to cook dinner.
examples.zh: 她点燃煤油炉做晚饭。

examples.en: The relevance of this research to current environmental issues is significant.
examples.zh: 这项研究对当前环境问题的相关性很重要。

examples.en: He questioned the relevance of the old data to the new study.
examples.zh: 他质疑旧数据对新研究的相关性。

examples.en: In the digital age, maintaining the relevance of traditional media is a challenge.
examples.zh: 在数字时代，保持传统媒体的相关性是一个挑战。

examples.en: The teacher emphasized the relevance of history lessons to modern life.
examples.zh: 老师强调了历史课对现代生活的相关性。

examples.en: The decision was influenced by political considerations rather than practical ones.
examples.zh: 这个决定受政治考虑而非实际考虑影响。

examples.en: She has a keen interest in political science and current affairs.
examples.zh: 她对政治科学和时事有浓厚的兴趣。

examples.en: The company avoided making political statements to maintain neutrality.
examples.zh: 公司避免发表政治声明以保持中立。

examples.en: Political stability is crucial for economic growth in the region.
examples.zh: 政治稳定对该地区的经济增长至关重要。

examples.en: The mountains stretch beyond the horizon.
examples.zh: 山脉延伸到地平线之外。

examples.en: His skills go beyond what is required for the job.
examples.zh: 他的技能超出了这份工作的要求。

examples.en: The problem is beyond my ability to solve.
examples.zh: 这个问题超出了我的解决能力。

examples.en: They discussed issues beyond the scope of the meeting.
examples.zh: 他们讨论了超出会议范围的问题。

examples.en: The cell membrane controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell.
examples.zh: 细胞膜控制物质进出细胞。

examples.en: A thin membrane covers the surface of the pond.
examples.zh: 一层薄膜覆盖在池塘表面。

examples.en: The eardrum is a delicate membrane in the ear.
examples.zh: 鼓膜是耳朵中一层脆弱的薄膜。

examples.en: Scientists are studying artificial membranes for water filtration.
examples.zh: 科学家正在研究用于水过滤的人工膜。

examples.en: I'll go to the party with my friends.
examples.zh: 我会和朋友们一起去参加派对。

examples.en: She cut the paper with a pair of scissors.
examples.zh: 她用剪刀剪纸。

examples.en: He agreed with the proposal after careful consideration.
examples.zh: 经过仔细考虑后，他同意了这项提议。

examples.en: With all due respect, I must disagree with your opinion.
examples.zh: 恕我直言，我必须不同意你的观点。

examples.en: His egoism made it difficult for him to work in a team.
examples.zh: 他的利己主义使他很难在团队中工作。

examples.en: The philosopher criticized the egoism prevalent in modern society.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家批评了现代社会中普遍存在的利己主义。

examples.en: Her egoism led her to prioritize her own needs over others'.
examples.zh: 她的利己主义使她优先考虑自己的需求而非他人的。

examples.en: The company's culture discourages egoism and promotes collaboration.
examples.zh: 公司的文化不鼓励利己主义，而是提倡合作。

examples.en: The patient made a full recovery after the surgery.
examples.zh: 手术后，病人完全康复了。

examples.en: The economy is showing signs of recovery after the recession.
examples.zh: 经济在衰退后显示出复苏的迹象。

examples.en: Data recovery from the damaged hard drive was successful.
examples.zh: 从损坏的硬盘中恢复数据成功了。

examples.en: He is in recovery from his addiction and attending support meetings.
examples.zh: 他正在从成瘾中恢复，并参加支持会议。

examples.en: The comedian was heckled by an audience member during the show.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员在表演期间被一名观众起哄。

examples.en: Politicians often face heckling during public speeches.
examples.zh: 政治家在公开演讲时经常面临起哄。

examples.en: She ignored the hecklers and continued with her presentation.
examples.zh: 她无视起哄者，继续她的演讲。

examples.en: The heckling disrupted the peaceful atmosphere of the event.
examples.zh: 起哄破坏了活动的和平氛围。

examples.en: The country enjoyed a period of great prosperity in the 1990s.
examples.zh: 该国在20世纪90年代经历了一段繁荣时期。

examples.en: Economic prosperity often leads to improved living standards.
examples.zh: 经济繁荣通常带来生活水平的提高。

examples.en: They wished for peace and prosperity in the new year.
examples.zh: 他们祝愿新年和平与繁荣。

examples.en: The business contributed to the local prosperity by creating jobs.
examples.zh: 这家企业通过创造就业机会促进了当地的繁荣。

examples.en: She received numerous accolades for her outstanding performance.
examples.zh: 她因出色的表演获得了许多赞誉。

examples.en: The film won the highest accolade at the international festival.
examples.zh: 这部电影在国际电影节上获得了最高荣誉。

examples.en: His work earned him accolades from critics and peers alike.
examples.zh: 他的作品赢得了评论家和同行的一致赞誉。

examples.en: The accolade was a testament to his years of hard work and dedication.
examples.zh: 这一荣誉证明了他多年的辛勤工作和奉献。

examples.en: The teacher chided the student for being late to class.
examples.zh: 老师责备学生上课迟到。

examples.en: She chided her friend for forgetting her birthday.
examples.zh: 她责备朋友忘记了她的生日。

examples.en: He was chided by his boss for making a careless mistake.
examples.zh: 他因犯了一个粗心的错误而被老板责备。

examples.en: Parents often chide their children to teach them right from wrong.
examples.zh: 父母经常责备孩子以教导他们分辨是非。

examples.en: The agreement is provisory and subject to further negotiation.
examples.zh: 这项协议是临时的，有待进一步谈判。

examples.en: They offered a provisory solution until a permanent one could be found.
examples.zh: 他们提供了一个临时解决方案，直到找到永久性的办法。

examples.en: The provisory measures were put in place to address the immediate crisis.
examples.zh: 临时措施已到位以应对眼前的危机。

examples.en: His appointment was provisory, pending approval from the board.
examples.zh: 他的任命是临时的，等待董事会的批准。

examples.en: He made a proposal to improve the company's efficiency.
examples.zh: 他提出了一项提高公司效率的建议。

examples.en: The government is considering a new proposal for tax reform.
examples.zh: 政府正在考虑一项新的税收改革提案。

examples.en: She accepted his marriage proposal with joy.
examples.zh: 她高兴地接受了他的求婚。

examples.en: The proposal was rejected due to lack of funding.
examples.zh: 这项提案因缺乏资金而被拒绝。

examples.en: The dress required some alterations to ensure a perfect fitting.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙需要一些修改以确保合身。

examples.en: It is fitting that we celebrate this achievement together.
examples.zh: 我们一起庆祝这一成就是合适的。

examples.en: The fitting for the new suit will take place next week.
examples.zh: 新西装的试衣将在下周进行。

examples.en: His response was fitting for the solemn occasion.
examples.zh: 他的回应适合这个庄重的场合。

examples.en: I submitted a formal request for additional funding to complete the project.
examples.zh: 我提交了一份正式申请，要求追加资金以完成项目。

examples.en: The customer's request for a refund was promptly handled by the support team.
examples.zh: 客户提出的退款请求得到了客服团队的及时处理。

examples.en: At his request, the meeting was rescheduled to next week.
examples.zh: 应他的要求，会议被改期到了下周。

examples.en: She made a special request for a window seat on the flight.
examples.zh: 她特别要求在航班上安排一个靠窗的座位。

examples.en: His natural gregariousness made him popular at social gatherings.
examples.zh: 他天生的合群性格使他在社交聚会上很受欢迎。

examples.en: The gregariousness of dolphins is evident in their playful group behaviors.
examples.zh: 海豚的群居性在它们嬉戏的群体行为中显而易见。

examples.en: Her gregariousness helped her build a wide network of professional contacts.
examples.zh: 她的善于交际帮助她建立了一个广泛的职业人脉网络。

examples.en: In contrast to his brother's shyness, John's gregariousness stood out.
examples.zh: 与他兄弟的害羞相反，约翰的合群性格显得格外突出。

examples.en: She changed the bedclothes every week to keep the bedroom fresh and clean.
examples.zh: 她每周更换床上用品，以保持卧室的清新整洁。

examples.en: The hotel provided luxurious bedclothes, including silk sheets and a down comforter.
examples.zh: 酒店提供了豪华的床上用品，包括丝绸床单和羽绒被。

examples.en: He tossed and turned, tangling the bedclothes in his restless sleep.
examples.zh: 他辗转反侧，在不安的睡眠中把床单被褥弄得一团糟。

examples.en: After washing, she hung the bedclothes out in the sun to dry naturally.
examples.zh: 洗完后，她把床上用品挂在阳光下自然晾干。

examples.en: I wanted to go for a walk, but it started raining heavily.
examples.zh: 我想去散步，但开始下大雨了。

examples.en: She is very talented, but she lacks confidence in her abilities.
examples.zh: 她很有才华，但对自己的能力缺乏信心。

examples.en: The plan seemed perfect, but unforeseen complications arose.
examples.zh: 这个计划看似完美，但出现了意想不到的复杂情况。

examples.en: He apologized for the mistake, but the damage had already been done.
examples.zh: 他为错误道了歉，但损害已经造成了。

examples.en: The company ensures a steady supply of raw materials to meet production demands.
examples.zh: 公司确保原材料的稳定供应，以满足生产需求。

examples.en: During the crisis, the government worked to supply essential goods to affected areas.
examples.zh: 在危机期间，政府努力向受影响地区供应必需品。

examples.en: The water supply in the region is threatened by prolonged drought.
examples.zh: 该地区的供水因长期干旱而受到威胁。

examples.en: We need to check our inventory to see if we have enough supply for the upcoming order.
examples.zh: 我们需要检查库存，看看是否有足够的供应来应对即将到来的订单。

examples.en: The property underwent a professional valuation before being put on the market.
examples.zh: 这处房产在上市前经过了专业的估值。

examples.en: The company's valuation increased significantly after the successful product launch.
examples.zh: 在产品成功推出后，公司的估值大幅上升。

examples.en: He disagreed with the bank's valuation of his antique collection.
examples.zh: 他不同意银行对他古董收藏的估值。

examples.en: Accurate valuation is crucial for making informed investment decisions.
examples.zh: 准确的估值对于做出明智的投资决策至关重要。

examples.en: An autopsy was performed to determine the exact cause of death.
examples.zh: 进行了尸检以确定确切的死因。

examples.en: The autopsy report revealed that the victim had been poisoned.
examples.zh: 尸检报告显示受害者是被毒死的。

examples.en: Forensic experts conducted an autopsy as part of the criminal investigation.
examples.zh: 法医专家进行了尸检，作为刑事调查的一部分。

examples.en: The family requested an autopsy to clarify any doubts about the circumstances.
examples.zh: 家属要求进行尸检，以澄清对情况的任何疑虑。

examples.en: The pest control company was hired to exterminate the termite infestation.
examples.zh: 聘请了害虫防治公司来消灭白蚁侵扰。

examples.en: Efforts to exterminate invasive species have been ongoing for years.
examples.zh: 多年来一直在努力消灭入侵物种。

examples.en: They used chemical sprays to exterminate the cockroaches in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 他们使用化学喷雾来消灭厨房里的蟑螂。

examples.en: The goal of the campaign is to completely exterminate the disease from the region.
examples.zh: 该运动的目标是从该地区彻底根除这种疾病。

examples.en: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence and machine learning.
examples.zh: 他是人工智能和机器学习领域的专家。

examples.en: The website's domain name was registered for a period of ten years.
examples.zh: 该网站的域名注册了十年。

examples.en: This issue falls outside my domain of responsibility, so I cannot address it.
examples.zh: 这个问题超出了我的职责范围，因此我无法处理。

examples.en: The castle and its surrounding lands were once the private domain of the nobility.
examples.zh: 这座城堡及其周边土地曾经是贵族的私人领地。

examples.en: She wrapped a warm woolen shawl around her shoulders to ward off the chill.
examples.zh: 她在肩上披了一条温暖的羊毛披肩以抵御寒冷。

examples.en: The antique shawl, passed down through generations, was a family heirloom.
examples.zh: 这条代代相传的古董披肩是一件家族传家宝。

examples.en: He bought a colorful silk shawl as a souvenir from his trip to India.
examples.zh: 他从印度旅行回来时买了一条色彩鲜艳的丝绸披肩作为纪念品。

examples.en: The dancer's shawl flowed gracefully with her movements during the performance.
examples.zh: 在表演中，舞者的披肩随着她的动作优雅地飘动。

examples.en: He used a digital synthesizer to create futuristic sound effects for the film.
examples.zh: 他使用数字合成器为电影创作了未来感十足的音效。

examples.en: The new software acts as a speech synthesizer that can mimic human voices.
examples.zh: 这款新软件充当语音合成器，能够模仿人类声音。

examples.en: In chemistry class, we learned how to use a synthesizer to produce organic compounds.
examples.zh: 在化学课上，我们学习了如何使用合成器来生产有机化合物。

examples.en: The band's signature sound comes from their vintage analog synthesizer.
examples.zh: 这支乐队的标志性音色源自他们老式的模拟合成器。

examples.en: The dentist explained that the wisdom tooth was beginning to occlude the adjacent molar.
examples.zh: 牙医解释说智齿开始遮挡相邻的臼齿。

examples.en: During the eclipse, the moon will completely occlude the sun for a few minutes.
examples.zh: 日食期间，月亮将完全遮挡太阳几分钟。

examples.en: In meteorology, a warm front can occlude a cold front, creating complex weather patterns.
examples.zh: 在气象学中，暖锋可以遮挡冷锋，形成复杂的天气模式。

examples.en: The surgeon had to carefully avoid letting any tissue occlude the blood vessels during the operation.
examples.zh: 外科医生在手术中必须小心避免任何组织遮挡血管。

examples.en: Saturn is famous for its spectacular ring system, visible through a telescope.
examples.zh: 土星以其壮观的环系而闻名，通过望远镜即可看到。

examples.en: In Roman mythology, Saturn was the god of agriculture and time.
examples.zh: 在罗马神话中，萨图尔努斯是农业和时间之神。

examples.en: The Cassini spacecraft provided stunning images of Saturn and its moons.
examples.zh: 卡西尼号航天器提供了土星及其卫星的惊人图像。

examples.en: Astronomers have discovered many new moons orbiting Saturn in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，天文学家发现了许多围绕土星运行的新卫星。

examples.en: The DJ played a sample from an old funk record in his new track.
examples.zh: DJ在他的新曲中采样了一段老放克唱片。

examples.en: Researchers collected water samples from the river to test for pollution.
examples.zh: 研究人员从河中采集水样以检测污染情况。

examples.en: The survey was conducted using a random sample of 1,000 participants.
examples.zh: 这项调查采用了1000名参与者的随机样本进行。

examples.en: Before buying the fabric, she asked for a small sample to check the color and texture.
examples.zh: 购买布料前，她要求一小块样品来检查颜色和质地。

examples.en: We walked along the beach, enjoying the sunset and the sound of the waves.
examples.zh: 我们沿着海滩散步，欣赏日落和海浪声。

examples.en: Bring your friends along to the party; everyone is welcome.
examples.zh: 带上你的朋友们一起来参加派对，欢迎所有人。

examples.en: The new policy is expected to bring improvements along with some challenges.
examples.zh: 新政策预计会带来改进，同时也伴随着一些挑战。

examples.en: She sang along to her favorite song on the radio during the drive.
examples.zh: 开车时，她跟着收音机里最喜欢的歌曲一起唱。

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed him with pathological anxiety that required medical treatment.
examples.zh: 医生诊断他患有需要医疗干预的病理性焦虑。

examples.en: Her pathological lying made it difficult for others to trust her.
examples.zh: 她的病态说谎使他人难以信任她。

examples.en: The pathologist examined the tissue for any pathological changes indicative of disease.
examples.zh: 病理学家检查了组织是否有表明疾病的病理变化。

examples.en: He had a pathological fear of heights that prevented him from climbing even a ladder.
examples.zh: 他对高度有病态的恐惧，甚至阻止他爬梯子。

examples.en: The benefits of regular exercise far outweigh the temporary discomfort.
examples.zh: 定期锻炼的好处远远超过暂时的不适。

examples.en: In this case, the risks of the surgery outweigh the potential benefits.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，手术的风险超过了潜在的好处。

examples.en: The advantages of living in the city outweigh the disadvantages for many young professionals.
examples.zh: 对许多年轻专业人士来说，住在城市的优点超过了缺点。

examples.en: Environmental concerns should outweigh economic gains when making policy decisions.
examples.zh: 在制定政策决策时，环境问题应超过经济利益。

examples.en: Rising sea levels due to climate change threaten coastal communities worldwide.
examples.zh: 气候变化导致的海平面上升威胁着全球沿海社区。

examples.en: She is a rising star in the tech industry, known for her innovative ideas.
examples.zh: 她是科技行业的一颗新星，以其创新想法而闻名。

examples.en: The rising cost of living has become a major concern for many families.
examples.zh: 生活成本的上涨已成为许多家庭的主要关切。

examples.en: We watched the sun rising over the mountains, painting the sky in hues of orange and pink.
examples.zh: 我们看着太阳从山上升起，将天空染成橙色和粉红色。

examples.en: The novel is a sharp satire of modern politics and media culture.
examples.zh: 这部小说是对现代政治和媒体文化的尖锐讽刺。

examples.en: The TV show uses satire to humorously critique social norms and behaviors.
examples.zh: 这个电视节目使用讽刺来幽默地批判社会规范和行为。

examples.en: Jonathan Swift's 'A Modest Proposal' is a classic example of political satire.
examples.zh: 乔纳森·斯威夫特的《一个小小的建议》是政治讽刺的经典例子。

examples.en: Her stand-up comedy is filled with satire aimed at everyday absurdities.
examples.zh: 她的单口喜剧充满了针对日常荒谬现象的讽刺。

examples.en: The company plans to manufacture electric vehicles in its new factory.
examples.zh: 该公司计划在其新工厂制造电动汽车。

examples.en: They were accused of manufacturing evidence to support their false claims.
examples.zh: 他们被指控制造证据以支持其虚假主张。

examples.en: This region is known for the manufacture of high-quality textiles.
examples.zh: 这个地区以生产高质量纺织品而闻名。

examples.en: The process to manufacture this medication involves several complex chemical steps.
examples.zh: 制造这种药物的过程涉及几个复杂的化学步骤。

examples.en: Be careful not to scald yourself with the boiling water.
examples.zh: 小心别被开水烫伤。

examples.en: The hot coffee scalded his tongue.
examples.zh: 热咖啡烫到了他的舌头。

examples.en: She scalded the milk before making the custard.
examples.zh: 她做蛋奶冻前先把牛奶加热到接近沸腾。

examples.en: The sun's rays can scald delicate skin.
examples.zh: 阳光会灼伤娇嫩的皮肤。

examples.en: The new buildings encroach on the park's boundaries.
examples.zh: 新建筑侵占了公园的边界。

examples.en: We must not let work encroach on our family time.
examples.zh: 我们绝不能让工作侵占家庭时间。

examples.en: The sea is gradually encroaching on the coastline.
examples.zh: 海水正逐渐侵蚀海岸线。

examples.en: His questions began to encroach on my privacy.
examples.zh: 他的问题开始侵犯我的隐私。

examples.en: She gave him her unreserved support for the project.
examples.zh: 她对这个项目给予了毫无保留的支持。

examples.en: His apology was sincere and unreserved.
examples.zh: 他的道歉真诚而毫无保留。

examples.en: The restaurant requires unreserved tables to be booked in advance.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅要求未预订的桌子需提前预约。

examples.en: They expressed unreserved admiration for her achievements.
examples.zh: 他们对她的成就表达了毫无保留的钦佩。

examples.en: I prefer using a cordless drill for DIY projects.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢用无绳电钻做DIY项目。

examples.en: The cordless phone allows me to move around while talking.
examples.zh: 无绳电话让我可以边通话边走动。

examples.en: Modern vacuum cleaners are often cordless for convenience.
examples.zh: 现代吸尘器通常是无线的，使用方便。

examples.en: He bought a cordless keyboard to reduce desk clutter.
examples.zh: 他买了个无线键盘以减少桌面杂乱。

examples.en: She was chary of lending money to friends.
examples.zh: 她对借钱给朋友很谨慎。

examples.en: He's chary about making promises he can't keep.
examples.zh: 他对做出无法兑现的承诺很谨慎。

examples.en: Investors are chary of putting money into risky ventures.
examples.zh: 投资者对投资风险项目很谨慎。

examples.en: She's chary of strangers offering help.
examples.zh: 她对主动提供帮助的陌生人很警惕。

examples.en: The nurse found a vein to draw blood from.
examples.zh: 护士找到了抽血的静脉。

examples.en: There's a rich vein of gold in these mountains.
examples.zh: 这些山脉中有丰富的金矿脉。

examples.en: He spoke in a humorous vein throughout the speech.
examples.zh: 他在整个演讲中以幽默的口吻说话。

examples.en: The marble has beautiful veins running through it.
examples.zh: 这块大理石有美丽的纹理贯穿其中。

examples.en: The children enjoyed molding figures out of clay.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢用黏土捏塑人像。

examples.en: This region has soil rich in red clay.
examples.zh: 这个地区的土壤富含红黏土。

examples.en: The potter shaped the clay on the wheel.
examples.zh: 陶工在转轮上塑造黏土。

examples.en: Clay tablets were used for writing in ancient times.
examples.zh: 古代用泥板来书写。

examples.en: As a greenhorn in the industry, he had much to learn.
examples.zh: 作为行业新手，他有很多东西要学。

examples.en: The experienced hikers teased the greenhorn about his heavy backpack.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的徒步者取笑那个新手背包太重。

examples.en: She felt like a greenhorn on her first day at the new job.
examples.zh: 在新工作的第一天，她觉得自己像个生手。

examples.en: Don't be too hard on the greenhorn; everyone starts somewhere.
examples.zh: 别对新手太苛刻；每个人都是从某处开始的。

examples.en: She has mastered the technique of oil painting.
examples.zh: 她掌握了油画技巧。

examples.en: This new surgical technique reduces recovery time.
examples.zh: 这种新的外科技术缩短了恢复时间。

examples.en: He developed a unique technique for solving math problems.
examples.zh: 他开发了一种独特的解决数学问题的方法。

examples.en: Proper breathing technique is important in swimming.
examples.zh: 正确的呼吸技巧在游泳中很重要。

examples.en: The roller coaster ride exhilarated the children.
examples.zh: 过山车之旅让孩子们兴奋不已。

examples.en: She felt exhilarated after completing the marathon.
examples.zh: 完成马拉松后，她感到精神振奋。

examples.en: The fresh mountain air exhilarated his senses.
examples.zh: 清新的山间空气让他神清气爽。

examples.en: Winning the championship exhilarated the entire team.
examples.zh: 赢得冠军让整个团队欢欣鼓舞。

examples.en: He's a diehard fan of the team and never misses a game.
examples.zh: 他是这支球队的铁杆粉丝，从未错过任何一场比赛。

examples.en: The diehard conservatives resisted all changes to the policy.
examples.zh: 顽固的保守派抵制对该政策的所有修改。

examples.en: Despite the rain, diehard supporters stayed until the end of the concert.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨，铁杆支持者还是坚持到音乐会结束。

examples.en: She's a diehard optimist who always sees the bright side.
examples.zh: 她是个坚定的乐观主义者，总是看到事情好的一面。

examples.en: He holds liberal views on social issues like immigration and education.
examples.zh: 他在移民和教育等社会问题上持有开明的观点。

examples.en: The government applied a liberal interpretation of the law to allow the project.
examples.zh: 政府对法律进行了宽松的解释，以允许该项目进行。

examples.en: She used a liberal amount of spices in the recipe to enhance the flavor.
examples.zh: 她在食谱中使用了大量的香料来提升风味。

examples.en: Liberal arts education emphasizes critical thinking and broad knowledge.
examples.zh: 文科教育强调批判性思维和广泛的知识。

examples.en: Silica is a key component in the production of glass and ceramics.
examples.zh: 二氧化硅是玻璃和陶瓷生产中的关键成分。

examples.en: Workers in mines may be exposed to silica dust, which can cause lung diseases.
examples.zh: 矿工可能接触到二氧化硅粉尘，这可能导致肺部疾病。

examples.en: The desert sand contains high levels of silica, making it ideal for certain industrial uses.
examples.zh: 沙漠沙子含有高浓度的二氧化硅，使其适合某些工业用途。

examples.en: Silica gel packets are often placed in packaging to absorb moisture and prevent mold.
examples.zh: 硅胶包常被放在包装中以吸收水分并防止霉菌。

examples.en: Be careful not to tread on the flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 小心别踩到花园里的花。

examples.en: The car's tires have deep treads for better traction on wet roads.
examples.zh: 这辆车的轮胎有深花纹，在湿滑路面上有更好的抓地力。

examples.en: He tread lightly around the topic to avoid offending anyone.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地谈论这个话题，以免冒犯任何人。

examples.en: The hikers had to tread carefully along the narrow mountain path.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者不得不小心翼翼地沿着狭窄的山路行走。

examples.en: Minimalist design is in vogue this year among interior decorators.
examples.zh: 今年，极简主义设计在室内装饰师中很流行。

examples.en: The fashion magazine features the latest vogue trends from Paris.
examples.zh: 这本时尚杂志展示了来自巴黎的最新流行趋势。

examples.en: That hairstyle was in vogue in the 1980s but is now considered outdated.
examples.zh: 那种发型在20世纪80年代很流行，但现在被认为过时了。

examples.en: Sustainable living has come into vogue as environmental awareness increases.
examples.zh: 随着环保意识的提高，可持续生活方式变得流行起来。

examples.en: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal and went on to win the match.
examples.zh: 球队在打进第一个球后获得了势头，并最终赢得了比赛。

examples.en: The political campaign is building momentum with more supporters joining every day.
examples.zh: 政治竞选活动势头正劲，每天都有更多支持者加入。

examples.en: In physics, momentum is calculated as mass times velocity.
examples.zh: 在物理学中，动量被计算为质量乘以速度。

examples.en: The company's new product launch has lost momentum due to poor marketing.
examples.zh: 公司的新产品发布由于营销不力而失去了势头。

examples.en: Instant noodles are a quick and convenient meal option for busy people.
examples.zh: 方便面是忙碌人群快速便捷的餐饮选择。

examples.en: She felt an instant connection with him when they first met.
examples.zh: 他们第一次见面时，她立刻感到与他有了一种联系。

examples.en: The camera provides instant feedback with its digital display.
examples.zh: 这款相机通过其数字显示屏提供即时反馈。

examples.en: His success was not instant; it took years of hard work and dedication.
examples.zh: 他的成功并非一蹴而就，而是经过多年的努力和奉献。

examples.en: It's unlikely that it will rain today, according to the weather forecast.
examples.zh: 根据天气预报，今天不太可能下雨。

examples.en: She is an unlikely candidate for the job due to her lack of experience.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏经验，她不太可能是这份工作的候选人。

examples.en: The two teams formed an unlikely alliance to tackle the common problem.
examples.zh: 这两支队伍结成了一个不太可能的联盟来应对共同的问题。

examples.en: It's highly unlikely that he will change his mind after making such a firm decision.
examples.zh: 在他做出如此坚定的决定后，他极不可能改变主意。

examples.en: They arrived at the wedding in a luxurious black limousine.
examples.zh: 他们乘坐一辆豪华的黑色豪华轿车抵达婚礼现场。

examples.en: The company hired a limousine to transport VIP guests from the airport.
examples.zh: 公司租用了一辆豪华轿车从机场接送贵宾。

examples.en: Stretch limousines are often used for prom nights and special events.
examples.zh: 加长豪华轿车常用于毕业舞会和特殊活动。

examples.en: He felt like a celebrity riding in the limousine with tinted windows.
examples.zh: 他坐在带有有色车窗的豪华轿车里，感觉像是个名人。

examples.en: She grew up in a sheltered environment and was unprepared for the challenges of city life.
examples.zh: 她在受庇护的环境中长大，对城市生活的挑战毫无准备。

examples.en: The plants were kept in a sheltered spot to protect them from strong winds.
examples.zh: 这些植物被放在一个避风的地方，以保护它们免受强风的侵袭。

examples.en: His sheltered upbringing made him naive about the realities of the world.
examples.zh: 他受庇护的成长经历使他对世界的现实情况很天真。

examples.en: The harbor provides a sheltered anchorage for boats during storms.
examples.zh: 这个港口在暴风雨期间为船只提供了一个避风的锚地。

examples.en: I check my mailbox every morning for letters and packages.
examples.zh: 我每天早上检查邮箱，看看有没有信件和包裹。

examples.en: The mailbox at the corner of the street is painted bright red.
examples.zh: 街角的邮箱被漆成了鲜红色。

examples.en: She dropped the postcard into the mailbox before leaving for her trip.
examples.zh: 她在出发旅行前把明信片投进了邮箱。

examples.en: Our digital mailbox is full of spam emails that need to be filtered.
examples.zh: 我们的电子邮箱里满是需要过滤的垃圾邮件。

examples.en: He achieved mastery of the piano after years of dedicated practice.
examples.zh: 经过多年的专注练习，他掌握了钢琴的精髓。

examples.en: Her mastery of multiple languages impressed everyone at the conference.
examples.zh: 她对多种语言的精通给会议上的每个人留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The chef's mastery of French cuisine is evident in every dish he prepares.
examples.zh: 这位厨师对法式烹饪的精通在他准备的每一道菜中都显而易见。

examples.en: True mastery in any field requires both talent and perseverance.
examples.zh: 在任何领域，真正的精通都需要天赋和毅力。

examples.en: Please keep your desk orderly to improve productivity.
examples.zh: 请保持桌面整洁有序，以提高工作效率。

examples.en: The protest was conducted in an orderly manner, with no incidents reported.
examples.zh: 抗议活动进行得井然有序，没有发生任何事件。

examples.en: He served as an orderly in the hospital, assisting nurses with daily tasks.
examples.zh: 他在医院担任护理员，协助护士完成日常工作。

examples.en: The books on the shelf are arranged in an orderly fashion by genre.
examples.zh: 书架上的书按类型整齐地排列着。

examples.en: This job requires at least five years of experience in the field.
examples.zh: 这份工作要求至少五年相关领域的工作经验。

examples.en: The recipe requires fresh ingredients for the best flavor.
examples.zh: 这个食谱要求使用新鲜的食材以获得最佳风味。

examples.en: Students are required to submit their assignments by Friday.
examples.zh: 学生们被要求在周五前提交作业。

examples.en: The situation requires immediate attention to prevent further damage.
examples.zh: 这种情况需要立即关注，以防止进一步的损害。

examples.en: The dress is made from a soft, breathable material.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙是用柔软透气的材料制成的。

examples.en: We need to gather all the material for the research project.
examples.zh: 我们需要收集研究项目所需的所有材料。

examples.en: His success is not just material; it also brings him great happiness.
examples.zh: 他的成功不仅仅是物质上的，还给他带来了巨大的快乐。

examples.en: The teacher provided supplementary material to help students understand the topic.
examples.zh: 老师提供了补充材料，以帮助学生理解这个主题。

examples.en: He is such a narcissist that he talks about himself all the time.
examples.zh: 他是个十足的自恋狂，总是谈论自己。

examples.en: Working with a narcissist can be challenging due to their lack of empathy.
examples.zh: 与自恋者共事可能很有挑战性，因为他们缺乏同理心。

examples.en: She was diagnosed as a narcissist after displaying extreme self-centered behavior.
examples.zh: 在表现出极度以自我为中心的行为后，她被诊断为自恋者。

examples.en: The narcissist in the group always seeks admiration and validation from others.
examples.zh: 团体中的自恋者总是寻求他人的钦佩和认可。

examples.en: I have always been good at maths, especially algebra and geometry.
examples.zh: 我一直擅长数学，尤其是代数和几何。

examples.en: The maths problem was so difficult that it took me hours to solve.
examples.zh: 这道数学题太难了，我花了几个小时才解出来。

examples.en: She is studying advanced maths at university to become an engineer.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习高等数学，想成为一名工程师。

examples.en: Basic maths skills are essential for everyday tasks like budgeting.
examples.zh: 基本的数学技能对于预算等日常任务至关重要。

examples.en: The climb up the mountain was arduous, but the view from the top was worth it.
examples.zh: 爬山的过程很艰苦，但山顶的景色让这一切都值得。

examples.en: Completing the marathon was an arduous task that required months of training.
examples.zh: 完成马拉松是一项艰巨的任务，需要数月的训练。

examples.en: The arduous journey through the desert tested their endurance to the limit.
examples.zh: 穿越沙漠的艰苦旅程将他们的耐力推向了极限。

examples.en: She faced an arduous decision between two equally appealing job offers.
examples.zh: 她在两个同样诱人的工作机会之间面临着一个艰难的决定。

examples.en: We set up camp by the lake for a weekend of fishing and hiking.
examples.zh: 我们在湖边扎营，度过了一个钓鱼和徒步的周末。

examples.en: The summer camp offers activities like swimming, arts, and sports for kids.
examples.zh: 夏令营为孩子们提供游泳、艺术和体育等活动。

examples.en: During the war, soldiers were stationed in a military camp near the border.
examples.zh: 战争期间，士兵们驻扎在边境附近的一个军营里。

examples.en: The political candidate's camp is confident about winning the election.
examples.zh: 这位政治候选人的阵营对赢得选举充满信心。

examples.en: I had to scour the internet to find the rare book I was looking for.
examples.zh: 我不得不在网上仔细搜索，寻找那本我想要的稀有书籍。

examples.en: She used a brush to scour the dirty pots and pans until they were spotless.
examples.zh: 她用刷子擦洗那些脏锅脏盘，直到它们一尘不染。

examples.en: The detectives scoured the crime scene for any clues that might lead to the suspect.
examples.zh: 侦探们仔细搜查了犯罪现场，寻找可能指向嫌疑人的线索。

examples.en: We need to scour the area for firewood before it gets dark.
examples.zh: 我们需要在天黑前仔细搜寻这个区域，寻找柴火。

examples.en: His iconoclastic views on traditional education challenged the entire academic establishment.
examples.zh: 他对传统教育的反传统观点挑战了整个学术体系。

examples.en: The artist's iconoclastic approach to painting broke all conventional rules.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家反传统的绘画方法打破了所有常规。

examples.en: She was known for her iconoclastic attitude towards corporate culture.
examples.zh: 她以反传统企业文化态度而闻名。

examples.en: The book presents an iconoclastic interpretation of historical events.
examples.zh: 这本书对历史事件提出了反传统的解读。

examples.en: We need to consult an expert in cybersecurity to protect our system.
examples.zh: 我们需要咨询网络安全专家来保护我们的系统。

examples.en: She is an expert at solving complex mathematical problems.
examples.zh: 她是解决复杂数学问题的专家。

examples.en: The committee consists of experts from various fields.
examples.zh: 该委员会由来自不同领域的专家组成。

examples.en: He gave expert testimony in the court case.
examples.zh: 他在法庭案件中提供了专家证词。

examples.en: She wrinkled her nose at the unpleasant smell.
examples.zh: 她对难闻的气味皱起了鼻子。

examples.en: The dog has an excellent sense of smell in its nose.
examples.zh: 狗的鼻子有极好的嗅觉。

examples.en: He broke his nose playing basketball last week.
examples.zh: 他上周打篮球时摔断了鼻子。

examples.en: The plane's nose pointed upward as it began to climb.
examples.zh: 飞机开始爬升时，机头向上倾斜。

examples.en: I need to buy new running shoes for the marathon.
examples.zh: 我需要为马拉松买新的跑鞋。

examples.en: She carefully polished her leather shoes before the interview.
examples.zh: 她在面试前仔细擦亮了皮鞋。

examples.en: The horse was fitted with special shoes for the race.
examples.zh: 这匹马为比赛配备了特殊的蹄铁。

examples.en: He's in my shoes now, dealing with the same problems I faced.
examples.zh: 他现在处于我的位置，处理着我曾面对的同样问题。

examples.en: The vaccine helps the body produce antibodies against the virus.
examples.zh: 疫苗帮助身体产生对抗病毒的抗体。

examples.en: Doctors tested her blood for specific antibodies.
examples.zh: 医生检测了她的血液以寻找特定抗体。

examples.en: Antibodies play a crucial role in the immune system's defense.
examples.zh: 抗体在免疫系统的防御中起着关键作用。

examples.en: The presence of antibodies indicates past exposure to the disease.
examples.zh: 抗体的存在表明过去曾接触过这种疾病。

examples.en: The police officer kept his gun securely in his holster.
examples.zh: 警察将枪安全地放在枪套里。

examples.en: He wore a leather holster on his belt for quick access.
examples.zh: 他在腰带上佩戴了一个皮制枪套以便快速取用。

examples.en: The holster was designed to prevent accidental discharge.
examples.zh: 这个枪套的设计是为了防止意外走火。

examples.en: She practiced drawing the weapon from her holster repeatedly.
examples.zh: 她反复练习从枪套中拔枪的动作。

examples.en: I usually have a small snack between lunch and dinner.
examples.zh: 我通常在午餐和晚餐之间吃一点小吃。

examples.en: We bought some snacks for the movie night.
examples.zh: 我们为电影之夜买了一些零食。

examples.en: He grabbed a quick snack from the vending machine.
examples.zh: 他从自动售货机里快速拿了点零食。

examples.en: Healthy snacks like fruits and nuts are good alternatives.
examples.zh: 像水果和坚果这样的健康零食是不错的替代选择。

examples.en: The view from the mountaintop was absolutely amazing.
examples.zh: 从山顶看到的景色简直令人惊叹。

examples.en: She has an amazing ability to learn languages quickly.
examples.zh: 她有快速学习语言的惊人能力。

examples.en: We had an amazing time at the concert last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚在音乐会上度过了美妙的时光。

examples.en: It's amazing how technology has changed our lives.
examples.zh: 科技如何改变了我们的生活，这真是令人惊叹。

examples.en: His theory continues to be controverted by other scientists.
examples.zh: 他的理论继续受到其他科学家的反驳。

examples.en: The evidence presented was difficult to controvert.
examples.zh: 提出的证据很难被反驳。

examples.en: She wrote an article to controvert the popular misconception.
examples.zh: 她写了一篇文章来反驳普遍的误解。

examples.en: The lawyer tried to controvert the witness's testimony.
examples.zh: 律师试图反驳证人的证词。

examples.en: She decided to pursue postgraduate studies in biochemistry.
examples.zh: 她决定攻读生物化学的研究生课程。

examples.en: Many postgraduate students work as teaching assistants.
examples.zh: 许多研究生担任助教工作。

examples.en: He completed his postgraduate degree last year.
examples.zh: 他去年完成了研究生学位。

examples.en: The university offers various postgraduate programs.
examples.zh: 这所大学提供各种研究生项目。

examples.en: The crowd at the festival was a motley collection of people from all walks of life.
examples.zh: 节日上的人群形形色色，来自各行各业。

examples.en: He wore a motley assortment of mismatched clothes that caught everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 他穿着一身五颜六色、不搭调的衣服，吸引了所有人的注意。

examples.en: The team's performance was motley, with some brilliant moments and many errors.
examples.zh: 球队的表现参差不齐，既有精彩时刻，也有许多失误。

examples.en: In medieval times, a motley fool entertained the court with jokes and antics.
examples.zh: 中世纪时，小丑穿着杂色服装，用笑话和滑稽动作娱乐宫廷。

examples.en: The fireworks display failed spectacularly, with most of them not igniting at all.
examples.zh: 烟花表演惨败，大部分根本没有点燃。

examples.en: She succeeded spectacularly in her new business venture, doubling her profits in a year.
examples.zh: 她的新商业冒险取得了巨大成功，一年内利润翻了一番。

examples.en: The athlete performed spectacularly, breaking the world record by a large margin.
examples.zh: 这位运动员表现惊人，以很大优势打破了世界纪录。

examples.en: The plan backfired spectacularly, causing more problems than it solved.
examples.zh: 这个计划适得其反，引发的问题比解决的还多。

examples.en: The hurricane had a devastating impact on the coastal communities.
examples.zh: 飓风对沿海社区造成了毁灭性影响。

examples.en: Her criticism was devastating, leaving him speechless and embarrassed.
examples.zh: 她的批评极具杀伤力，让他哑口无言、尴尬不已。

examples.en: The team suffered a devastating defeat in the championship game.
examples.zh: 球队在冠军赛中遭遇了惨败。

examples.en: He made a devastating argument that completely undermined his opponent's position.
examples.zh: 他提出了一个毁灭性的论点，彻底动摇了对手的立场。

examples.en: She placed the book back on the shelf after reading it.
examples.zh: 她读完书后把它放回了书架上。

examples.en: The supermarket shelf was fully stocked with canned goods.
examples.zh: 超市货架上摆满了罐头食品。

examples.en: The project was put on the shelf due to lack of funding.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金，这个项目被搁置了。

examples.en: He built a wooden shelf to display his collection of model cars.
examples.zh: 他做了一个木架子来展示他收藏的模型汽车。

examples.en: The car needs more fuel to complete the long journey.
examples.zh: 汽车需要更多燃料才能完成长途旅行。

examples.en: His harsh words only served to fuel the argument further.
examples.zh: 他尖刻的话语只会进一步激化争论。

examples.en: The rising prices of fuel have affected many households.
examples.zh: 燃料价格上涨影响了许多家庭。

examples.en: Her passion for art fuels her creativity and drives her work.
examples.zh: 她对艺术的热爱激发了她的创造力，并推动着她的工作。

examples.en: The two warring factions agreed to a temporary truce to allow humanitarian aid.
examples.zh: 交战双方同意暂时停火，以便人道主义援助得以进行。

examples.en: After arguing for hours, they called a truce and decided to talk calmly.
examples.zh: 争吵了几个小时后，他们宣布休战，决定冷静地谈谈。

examples.en: The truce between the neighboring countries lasted only a few months before hostilities resumed.
examples.zh: 邻国之间的停战只持续了几个月，敌对行动就恢复了。

examples.en: In the game, players can negotiate a truce to avoid further conflict.
examples.zh: 在游戏中，玩家可以谈判休战，以避免进一步的冲突。

examples.en: As the scion of a wealthy family, he was expected to take over the business.
examples.zh: 作为富家子弟，他被期望接管家族生意。

examples.en: The young scion showed great promise in his early political career.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的贵族子弟在早期的政治生涯中展现出巨大潜力。

examples.en: She is a scion of a famous literary dynasty, continuing the family tradition.
examples.zh: 她出身于一个著名的文学世家，延续着家族传统。

examples.en: In horticulture, a scion is grafted onto a rootstock to produce a new plant.
examples.zh: 在园艺中，接穗被嫁接到砧木上以培育新植株。
