examples.zh: 这部电影基于1995年发生的真实事件。

examples.en: She was surprised by the actual size of the diamond.
examples.zh: 她对钻石的实际大小感到惊讶。

examples.en: She closed the blinds to block out the afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 她拉下百叶窗以遮挡下午的阳光。

examples.en: We installed new blinds in the living room for privacy.
examples.zh: 我们在客厅安装了新的百叶窗以保护隐私。

examples.en: The blinds can be adjusted to control the amount of light.
examples.zh: 百叶窗可以调节以控制光线量。

examples.en: He peeked through the blinds to see who was at the door.
examples.zh: 他从百叶窗的缝隙中窥视看谁在门口。

examples.en: The artist carefully sketched the contour of the mountain against the sky.
examples.zh: 艺术家仔细勾勒出山脉在天空映衬下的轮廓。

examples.en: The contour of the coastline has changed significantly due to erosion.
examples.zh: 由于侵蚀作用，海岸线的轮廓已发生显著变化。

examples.en: She used contour makeup to define her cheekbones.
examples.zh: 她使用修容化妆品来突出颧骨轮廓。

examples.en: The contour lines on the map indicate changes in elevation.
examples.zh: 地图上的等高线表示海拔高度的变化。

examples.en: The company's headquarters serves as the base for all its operations.
examples.zh: 公司总部是其所有业务运营的基地。

examples.en: The soup has a tomato base with added herbs and spices.
examples.zh: 这道汤以番茄为底料，加入了香草和香料。

examples.en: The argument is based on solid evidence and logical reasoning.
examples.zh: 这个论点基于确凿的证据和逻辑推理。

examples.en: He rounded first base and sprinted toward second.
examples.zh: 他绕过一垒，向二垒冲刺。

examples.en: After years of disappointment, he became a misanthrope who avoided social gatherings.
examples.zh: 经历多年失望后，他变成了一个厌恶人类、回避社交聚会的人。

examples.en: The character in the novel is portrayed as a misanthrope who distrusts everyone.
examples.zh: 小说中的这个角色被描绘成一个不信任任何人的厌世者。

examples.en: Her misanthropic views made it difficult for her to form lasting friendships.
examples.zh: 她厌世的人生观使她难以建立持久的友谊。

examples.en: Despite his reputation as a misanthrope, he secretly donated to charity.
examples.zh: 尽管他有厌世者的名声，但他私下里却向慈善机构捐款。

examples.en: The candidate won by only a marginal majority in the election.
examples.zh: 这位候选人在选举中仅以微弱多数获胜。

examples.en: The company decided to discontinue the product due to marginal profits.
examples.zh: 由于利润微薄，公司决定停产该产品。

examples.en: She made some marginal notes in the textbook to help her study.
examples.zh: 她在教科书上做了一些页边笔记以帮助学习。

examples.en: The marginal communities often lack access to basic services.
examples.zh: 边缘社区往往缺乏基本服务的获取途径。

examples.en: She bought a dozen eggs from the grocery store.
examples.zh: 她从杂货店买了一打鸡蛋。

examples.en: There were dozens of people waiting in line for the concert tickets.
examples.zh: 有几十个人在排队等候购买音乐会门票。

examples.en: He has visited Paris a dozen times over the years.
examples.zh: 这些年来他已去过巴黎十几次了。

examples.en: The baker's dozen includes 13 items instead of the usual 12.
examples.zh: 面包师的一打包括13件物品，而不是通常的12件。

examples.en: The company will reimburse you for all travel expenses incurred during the business trip.
examples.zh: 公司将报销您在商务旅行期间产生的所有差旅费用。

examples.en: Please submit your receipts to get reimbursed for the medical costs.
examples.zh: 请提交您的收据以报销医疗费用。

examples.en: The insurance policy reimburses customers for damages up to a certain limit.
examples.zh: 该保险单在特定限额内赔偿客户的损失。

examples.en: He was reimbursed in full after the faulty product was returned.
examples.zh: 退回有缺陷的产品后，他获得了全额退款。

examples.en: The history class meets every Monday and Wednesday at 10 AM.
examples.zh: 历史课每周一和周三上午10点上课。

examples.en: She has a natural class and elegance that impresses everyone.
examples.zh: 她天生具有一种令所有人印象深刻的优雅风度。

examples.en: The new model belongs to a higher class of luxury vehicles.
examples.zh: 这款新车型属于更高档次的豪华汽车类别。

examples.en: In the animal kingdom, mammals form a distinct class.
examples.zh: 在动物界中，哺乳动物构成一个独特的纲。

examples.en: The bright sun made it difficult to see without sunglasses.
examples.zh: 明亮的阳光让人不戴太阳镜难以看清东西。

examples.en: She is a bright student who always excels in her studies.
examples.zh: 她是一个聪明的学生，学业总是出类拔萃。

examples.en: The room was painted in bright colors to create a cheerful atmosphere.
examples.zh: 房间被漆成鲜艳的颜色，以营造欢快的氛围。

examples.en: His future looks bright with all the opportunities ahead.
examples.zh: 随着前方所有机遇的到来，他的未来看起来一片光明。

examples.en: Shakespeare's plays are considered part of the Western literary canon.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚的戏剧被认为是西方文学经典的一部分。

examples.en: The church follows a strict canon of religious texts.
examples.zh: 该教会遵循一套严格的宗教经典文本。

examples.en: In music, the canon is a compositional technique involving imitation.
examples.zh: 在音乐中，卡农是一种涉及模仿的作曲技巧。

examples.en: The new theory challenges the established canon in the field of physics.
examples.zh: 这一新理论挑战了物理学领域既定的准则。

examples.en: The project has been postponed indefinitely due to funding issues.
examples.zh: 由于资金问题，该项目已被无限期推迟。

examples.en: She can stay with us indefinitely until she finds her own place.
examples.zh: 在她找到自己的住处之前，可以无限期地和我们住在一起。

examples.en: The treaty allows for the extension of negotiations indefinitely.
examples.zh: 该条约允许谈判无限期延长。

examples.en: The battery can last indefinitely if properly maintained.
examples.zh: 如果维护得当，电池可以无限期使用。

examples.en: Every spring, I prune the rose bushes to encourage new growth.
examples.zh: 每年春天，我都会修剪玫瑰丛以促进新枝生长。

examples.en: The company decided to prune its workforce to cut costs.
examples.zh: 公司决定裁员以削减成本。

examples.en: You should prune unnecessary details from your report to make it more concise.
examples.zh: 你应该从报告中删减不必要的细节，使其更简洁。

examples.en: He pruned the overgrown branches to let more sunlight into the garden.
examples.zh: 他修剪了过度生长的树枝，让更多阳光照进花园。

examples.en: She has always been interested in international politics and diplomacy.
examples.zh: 她一直对国际政治和外交感兴趣。

examples.en: Office politics can sometimes make the workplace stressful.
examples.zh: 办公室政治有时会让工作环境变得紧张。

examples.en: He entered politics at a young age and quickly rose through the ranks.
examples.zh: 他年轻时进入政界，并迅速晋升。

examples.en: The politics of the situation are complex, involving multiple stakeholders.
examples.zh: 这种情况的政治因素很复杂，涉及多个利益相关者。

examples.en: The brand has become a byword for luxury and quality.
examples.zh: 这个品牌已成为奢华和品质的代名词。

examples.en: In the industry, his name is a byword for innovation.
examples.zh: 在这个行业里，他的名字是创新的同义词。

examples.en: The phrase 'made in Germany' is a byword for precision engineering.
examples.zh: '德国制造'这个短语是精密工程的代名词。

examples.en: Her honesty has made her a byword for integrity in the community.
examples.zh: 她的诚实使她成为社区中正直的代名词。

examples.en: The room was dimly lit, creating a cozy atmosphere.
examples.zh: 房间光线昏暗，营造出一种温馨的氛围。

examples.en: I could only dimly remember the events of that night.
examples.zh: 我只能模糊地记得那天晚上发生的事情。

examples.en: The stars shone dimly through the city's light pollution.
examples.zh: 在城市的光污染下，星星的光芒显得暗淡。

examples.en: He dimly understood the concept after the brief explanation.
examples.zh: 经过简短的解释后，他大致理解了那个概念。

examples.en: We must preserve this historic building for future generations.
examples.zh: 我们必须为后代保护这座历史建筑。

examples.en: She uses a special method to preserve fruits and vegetables.
examples.zh: 她使用一种特殊的方法来保存水果和蔬菜。

examples.en: The national park aims to preserve the natural habitat of wildlife.
examples.zh: 国家公园旨在保护野生动物的自然栖息地。

examples.en: He tried to preserve his dignity during the difficult situation.
examples.zh: 在困难的情况下，他努力维护自己的尊严。

examples.en: The wedding was a joyous occasion filled with laughter and music.
examples.zh: 婚礼是一个充满欢笑和音乐的欢乐场合。

examples.en: She felt joyous when she received the good news.
examples.zh: 当她收到好消息时，她感到非常高兴。

examples.en: The children's joyous shouts echoed through the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子们欢乐的喊声在操场上回荡。

examples.en: The festival is a time for joyous celebration and community gatherings.
examples.zh: 这个节日是欢乐庆祝和社区聚会的时刻。

examples.en: She kept the old letters for sentimental reasons.
examples.zh: 她出于情感原因保留了那些旧信件。

examples.en: The movie was so sentimental that it made many viewers cry.
examples.zh: 这部电影非常煽情，让许多观众落泪。

examples.en: He has a sentimental attachment to his childhood home.
examples.zh: 他对童年的家有着情感上的依恋。

examples.en: Avoid making sentimental decisions in business matters.
examples.zh: 在商业事务中要避免做出感情用事的决定。

examples.en: In your essay, be sure to cite all your sources properly.
examples.zh: 在你的文章中，务必正确引用所有资料来源。

examples.en: The lawyer cited several precedents to support his argument.
examples.zh: 律师引用了几个先例来支持他的论点。

examples.en: She was cited for her outstanding contributions to the field.
examples.zh: 她因在该领域的杰出贡献而受到表彰。

examples.en: The report cites increasing pollution as a major health concern.
examples.zh: 报告引用日益严重的污染作为一个主要的健康问题。

examples.en: The farmer gathered a sheaf of wheat from the field.
examples.zh: 农民从田里收集了一捆小麦。

examples.en: He handed me a sheaf of papers to review before the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在会议前递给我一叠文件审阅。

examples.en: The artist displayed a sheaf of sketches from his travels.
examples.zh: 艺术家展示了他旅行中的一叠素描。

examples.en: She tied the sheaf of documents with a ribbon.
examples.zh: 她用丝带把那叠文件捆了起来。

examples.en: Many families have pets like dogs and cats as companions.
examples.zh: 许多家庭养宠物，如狗和猫，作为伴侣。

examples.en: She pets her cat gently while watching television.
examples.zh: 她看电视时轻轻地抚摸她的猫。

examples.en: The store sells food and supplies for various pets.
examples.zh: 这家商店出售各种宠物的食物和用品。

examples.en: He has a collection of exotic pets, including reptiles and birds.
examples.zh: 他养了一群异国宠物，包括爬行动物和鸟类。

examples.en: The lumbering elephant moved slowly through the forest.
examples.zh: 那头笨重的大象缓慢地穿过森林。

examples.en: The company's lumbering bureaucracy delayed the project.
examples.zh: 公司臃肿的官僚机构延误了项目进度。

examples.en: He walked with a lumbering gait after the long hike.
examples.zh: 长途徒步后，他步履蹒跚地走着。

examples.en: The old truck made a lumbering noise as it started up.
examples.zh: 那辆旧卡车启动时发出笨重的轰鸣声。

examples.en: The new policy will be implemented nationwide next month.
examples.zh: 新政策将于下个月在全国范围内实施。

examples.en: The company conducted a nationwide survey to gather consumer feedback.
examples.zh: 该公司进行了一项全国性调查以收集消费者反馈。

examples.en: The storm caused nationwide power outages.
examples.zh: 这场风暴导致了全国范围的停电。

examples.en: The product launch was promoted with a nationwide advertising campaign.
examples.zh: 该产品上市时通过全国性的广告活动进行推广。

examples.en: His speech contained an allusion to Shakespeare's Hamlet.
examples.zh: 他的演讲中暗指了莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》。

examples.en: The novel makes frequent allusion to Greek mythology.
examples.zh: 这部小说频繁地影射希腊神话。

examples.en: She understood the allusion to their past argument.
examples.zh: 她听懂了那对他们过去争吵的暗示。

examples.en: The painting is an allusion to the artist's childhood memories.
examples.zh: 这幅画暗指了艺术家的童年回忆。

examples.en: The scientist's experimentation led to a groundbreaking discovery.
examples.zh: 这位科学家的实验带来了一项突破性的发现。

examples.en: The chef is known for his experimentation with fusion cuisine.
examples.zh: 这位厨师以他在融合菜系上的实验而闻名。

examples.en: The company encourages experimentation in product development.
examples.zh: 该公司鼓励在产品开发中进行实验。

examples.en: Her artistic experimentation resulted in a unique style.
examples.zh: 她的艺术实验形成了一种独特的风格。

examples.en: We enjoy skiing in the mountains during winter.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢在冬天去山上滑雪。

examples.en: The trees lose their leaves in winter.
examples.zh: 树木在冬天会落叶。

examples.en: They moved to a warmer climate to escape the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 他们搬到了一个更温暖的气候区以躲避严冬。

examples.en: Winter is often associated with holidays and family gatherings.
examples.zh: 冬天常常与假期和家庭聚会联系在一起。

examples.en: Her intention was to help, not to criticize.
examples.zh: 她的意图是帮助，而不是批评。

examples.en: He announced his intention to run for office.
examples.zh: 他宣布了参选的意图。

examples.en: The company has no intention of laying off employees.
examples.zh: 公司没有解雇员工的打算。

examples.en: She acted with good intention, but it backfired.
examples.zh: 她出于好意行事，但结果适得其反。

examples.en: We are planning a family reunion for the holidays.
examples.zh: 我们正在计划一个假期家庭团聚。

examples.en: The high school reunion brought together old friends.
examples.zh: 高中同学聚会让老朋友们重聚。

examples.en: The reunion of the band after ten years excited their fans.
examples.zh: 乐队十年后的重聚让粉丝们兴奋不已。

examples.en: The emotional reunion at the airport brought tears to everyone's eyes.
examples.zh: 机场上感人的团聚让每个人都热泪盈眶。

examples.en: The politician was known as a firebrand for his radical speeches.
examples.zh: 这位政治家因其激进的演讲而被称为煽动者。

examples.en: The firebrand activist inspired many to join the protest.
examples.zh: 这位激进的积极分子激励了许多人加入抗议。

examples.en: He was a firebrand in the labor movement, demanding better conditions.
examples.zh: 他是劳工运动中的煽动者，要求改善条件。

examples.en: The firebrand's words ignited a wave of social change.
examples.zh: 这位煽动者的话语引发了一波社会变革。

examples.en: The dove is a symbol of peace.
examples.zh: 鸽子是和平的象征。

examples.en: The company's logo is a symbol of its brand identity.
examples.zh: 公司的标志是其品牌身份的象征。

examples.en: The ring was a symbol of their eternal love.
examples.zh: 这枚戒指是他们永恒爱情的象征。

examples.en: The national flag is a powerful symbol of patriotism.
examples.zh: 国旗是爱国主义的有力象征。

examples.en: She is an enterprising entrepreneur who started her own business.
examples.zh: 她是一位有进取心的企业家，创办了自己的公司。

examples.en: The enterprising student organized a successful charity event.
examples.zh: 这位有进取心的学生组织了一场成功的慈善活动。

examples.en: His enterprising spirit led him to explore new markets.
examples.zh: 他的进取精神促使他探索新市场。

examples.en: The team's enterprising approach solved the problem quickly.
examples.zh: 团队富有进取心的方法迅速解决了问题。

examples.en: The velocity vector indicates both speed and direction of motion.
examples.zh: 速度矢量表示运动的速度和方向。

examples.en: In computer graphics, vector images can be scaled without losing quality.
examples.zh: 在计算机图形学中，矢量图像可以缩放而不会损失质量。

examples.en: The disease spread through the population like a vector-borne illness.
examples.zh: 这种疾病像媒介传播的疾病一样在人群中蔓延。

examples.en: He used a vector approach to solve the physics problem efficiently.
examples.zh: 他使用矢量方法高效地解决了这个物理问题。

examples.en: His humorous anecdotes always lighten the mood at meetings.
examples.zh: 他幽默的轶事总能活跃会议的气氛。

examples.en: The comedian's humorous take on everyday life resonated with the audience.
examples.zh: 这位喜剧演员对日常生活的幽默解读引起了观众的共鸣。

examples.en: She has a humorous way of dealing with stressful situations.
examples.zh: 她有一种幽默的方式来应对压力大的情况。

examples.en: The book is filled with humorous observations about modern society.
examples.zh: 这本书充满了对现代社会的幽默观察。

examples.en: The baby's chubby cheeks are adorable to everyone who sees them.
examples.zh: 宝宝胖乎乎的脸颊让每个看到的人都觉得可爱。

examples.en: He's a bit chubby, but he's working on losing weight through exercise.
examples.zh: 他有点胖乎乎的，但正在通过锻炼来减肥。

examples.en: The chubby squirrel struggled to climb the thin tree branch.
examples.zh: 那只胖乎乎的松鼠艰难地爬上细树枝。

examples.en: Her chubby fingers made it difficult to type quickly on the keyboard.
examples.zh: 她胖乎乎的手指让她很难在键盘上快速打字。

examples.en: Europe is known for its rich history and diverse cultures.
examples.zh: 欧洲以其丰富的历史和多元的文化而闻名。

examples.en: They plan to travel across Europe by train next summer.
examples.zh: 他们计划明年夏天乘火车穿越欧洲旅行。

examples.en: The European Union plays a key role in global politics and economics.
examples.zh: 欧盟在全球政治和经济中扮演着关键角色。

examples.en: Many famous artists and thinkers have emerged from Europe over the centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，许多著名的艺术家和思想家都出自欧洲。

examples.en: In the orphanage, the children were often served thin gruel for breakfast.
examples.zh: 在孤儿院，孩子们早餐经常吃稀粥。

examples.en: During the famine, people survived on meager rations of gruel.
examples.zh: 在饥荒期间，人们靠少量的稀粥维持生命。

examples.en: The prisoner's diet consisted mainly of bread and gruel.
examples.zh: 囚犯的饮食主要包括面包和稀粥。

examples.en: She made a warm gruel to soothe her sore throat.
examples.zh: 她煮了温热的稀粥来缓解喉咙痛。

examples.en: With foreknowledge of the storm, they evacuated the coastal area in time.
examples.zh: 由于预知了风暴，他们及时疏散了沿海地区。

examples.en: His foreknowledge of market trends helped him make profitable investments.
examples.zh: 他对市场趋势的预知帮助他进行了有利可图的投资。

examples.en: The spy had foreknowledge of the enemy's plans, giving his side an advantage.
examples.zh: 间谍预知了敌人的计划，给了他这一方优势。

examples.en: Lack of foreknowledge about the road closure caused a major traffic jam.
examples.zh: 对道路封闭缺乏预知导致了严重的交通堵塞。

examples.en: Earth is the third planet from the Sun in our solar system.
examples.zh: 地球是太阳系中离太阳第三近的行星。

examples.en: They used rich earth from the garden to plant the new flowers.
examples.zh: 他们用花园里肥沃的土壤来种植新花。

examples.en: The earthquake caused significant damage to the earth's surface in the region.
examples.zh: 地震对该地区的地表造成了重大破坏。

examples.en: She grounded herself by walking barefoot on the earth.
examples.zh: 她赤脚走在土地上，让自己接地气。

examples.en: His chronic insomnia made it hard for him to function during the day.
examples.zh: 他慢性的失眠症让他在白天很难正常工作。

examples.en: Stress at work often leads to temporary insomnia for many people.
examples.zh: 工作压力常常导致许多人暂时性失眠。

examples.en: She tried meditation to combat her insomnia and improve sleep quality.
examples.zh: 她尝试冥想以对抗失眠并改善睡眠质量。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medication to help with his severe insomnia.
examples.zh: 医生开了药来帮助他缓解严重的失眠。

examples.en: It is customary to shake hands when meeting someone for the first time in many cultures.
examples.zh: 在许多文化中，初次见面时握手是惯例。

examples.en: She followed the customary practice of bringing a gift to the host.
examples.zh: 她遵循了给主人带礼物的惯例做法。

examples.en: In some countries, it is customary to remove shoes before entering a home.
examples.zh: 在一些国家，进入家中前脱鞋是惯例。

examples.en: The customary fee for the service is clearly stated on the website.
examples.zh: 这项服务的惯例费用在网站上明确说明。

examples.en: Software piracy is a major issue that costs companies billions annually.
examples.zh: 软件盗版是一个每年让公司损失数十亿美元的主要问题。

examples.en: Modern piracy in the Gulf of Aden poses a threat to international shipping.
examples.zh: 亚丁湾的现代海盗行为对国际航运构成威胁。

examples.en: The film industry suffers significant losses due to online piracy.
examples.zh: 电影行业因在线盗版而遭受重大损失。

examples.en: Authorities are cracking down on music piracy to protect artists' rights.
examples.zh: 当局正在打击音乐盗版以保护艺术家的权利。

examples.en: Imagine a world without poverty, where everyone has enough to live comfortably.
examples.zh: 想象一个没有贫困的世界，在那里每个人都生活富足。

examples.en: I can't imagine why he would make such a reckless decision.
examples.zh: 我无法想象他为何会做出如此鲁莽的决定。

examples.en: Just imagine how beautiful the sunset must be from that mountaintop.
examples.zh: 想象一下从那个山顶看日落会有多美。

examples.en: She asked me to imagine myself in her shoes before judging her actions.
examples.zh: 她让我在评判她的行为之前，先设身处地想象一下她的处境。

examples.en: The serenity of the lake at dawn brought a sense of peace to my mind.
examples.zh: 黎明时分湖面的宁静让我的心灵感到平和。

examples.en: Meditation helps her achieve a state of inner serenity despite the chaos around her.
examples.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱，冥想帮助她达到了内心的宁静状态。

examples.en: The garden was designed to evoke a feeling of serenity and tranquility.
examples.zh: 这个花园的设计旨在唤起宁静与安详的感觉。

examples.en: He found serenity in the simple routines of rural life after retiring from the city.
examples.zh: 从城市退休后，他在乡村生活的简单日常中找到了宁静。

examples.en: He struggled with alcoholic addiction for years before seeking professional help.
examples.zh: 在寻求专业帮助之前，他与酒精成瘾斗争了多年。

examples.en: This cocktail contains non-alcoholic ingredients, making it suitable for all guests.
examples.zh: 这款鸡尾酒含有非酒精成分，适合所有客人饮用。

examples.en: Alcoholic beverages are strictly prohibited in this workplace for safety reasons.
examples.zh: 出于安全原因，工作场所严禁酒精饮料。

examples.en: She avoids alcoholic drinks at social events to stay clear-headed.
examples.zh: 她在社交活动中避免饮酒，以保持头脑清醒。

examples.en: The market was filled with exotic fruits from tropical regions that I had never seen before.
examples.zh: 市场上摆满了来自热带地区的异国水果，我从未见过。

examples.en: They went on an exotic vacation to a remote island in the Pacific.
examples.zh: 他们去太平洋上一个偏远的岛屿进行了一次异国风情的度假。

examples.en: Her exotic appearance, with striking features and colorful attire, caught everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 她异域风情的外貌，鲜明的五官和鲜艳的服饰，吸引了所有人的注意。

examples.en: The restaurant serves exotic dishes that blend flavors from different cultures.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅供应融合不同文化风味的异国菜肴。

examples.en: From a historical perspective, this event marked a turning point in the nation's development.
examples.zh: 从历史的角度来看，这一事件标志着国家发展的一个转折点。

examples.en: Talking to her gave me a new perspective on the issue I had been struggling with.
examples.zh: 与她交谈让我对我一直困扰的问题有了新的视角。

examples.en: Artists often use perspective in paintings to create a sense of depth and realism.
examples.zh: 艺术家常在绘画中使用透视法来创造深度和真实感。

examples.en: It's important to consider multiple perspectives before making a final decision.
examples.zh: 在做最终决定之前，考虑多个视角很重要。

examples.en: The landlord's demand for a 50% rent increase seemed unreasonable to all the tenants.
examples.zh: 房东要求涨租50%，所有租客都觉得不合理。

examples.en: She has an unreasonable fear of flying, even though statistics show it's very safe.
examples.zh: 她对飞行有一种不合理的恐惧，尽管统计数据显示飞行非常安全。

examples.en: It's unreasonable to expect employees to work overtime every day without extra pay.
examples.zh: 期望员工每天无偿加班是不合理的。

examples.en: His unreasonable behavior during the meeting caused a lot of tension among the team.
examples.zh: 他在会议中的不合理行为在团队中引起了很多紧张。

examples.en: The ancient kingdom was known for its rich culture and advanced technology.
examples.zh: 这个古代王国以其丰富的文化和先进的技术而闻名。

examples.en: In biology, the animal kingdom includes all living organisms that are not plants or fungi.
examples.zh: 在生物学中，动物界包括所有非植物或真菌的生物。

examples.en: He built a business empire that became a kingdom in the world of finance.
examples.zh: 他建立了一个商业帝国，在金融界成为了一个王国。

examples.en: The fairy tale tells of a magical kingdom hidden deep in the forest.
examples.zh: 这个童话讲述了一个隐藏在森林深处的魔法王国。

examples.en: The critics raved about the new movie, calling it a masterpiece of modern cinema.
examples.zh: 评论家们对这部新电影赞不绝口，称其为现代电影的杰作。

examples.en: They went to a rave party that lasted all night with loud music and dancing.
examples.zh: 他们参加了一个通宵的锐舞派对，有喧闹的音乐和舞蹈。

examples.en: She couldn't stop raving about the delicious meal she had at the new restaurant.
examples.zh: 她对新餐厅的美餐赞不绝口。

examples.en: The rave scene in the city is known for its vibrant energy and electronic music.
examples.zh: 这个城市的锐舞场景以其充满活力的氛围和电子音乐而闻名。

examples.en: You should lubricate the hinges of the door regularly to prevent them from squeaking.
examples.zh: 你应该定期给门的铰链上油，以防止它们发出吱吱声。

examples.en: The mechanic used oil to lubricate the engine parts for smoother operation.
examples.zh: 机械师用油润滑发动机部件，使其运行更顺畅。

examples.en: Drinking water can help lubricate your throat and reduce dryness.
examples.zh: 喝水可以帮助润滑喉咙，减少干燥感。

examples.en: In industrial settings, special greases are used to lubricate heavy machinery.
examples.zh: 在工业环境中，使用特殊的油脂来润滑重型机械。

examples.en: Over time, their differing political views began to estrange them from each other.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们不同的政治观点开始使他们疏远。

examples.en: He felt estranged from his family after moving to a different country for work.
examples.zh: 因工作搬到另一个国家后，他感到与家人疏远了。

examples.en: The scandal estranged her from many of her former friends and colleagues.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻使她与许多以前的朋友和同事疏远了。

examples.en: A lack of communication can quickly estrange partners in a relationship.
examples.zh: 缺乏沟通会很快使关系中的伴侣疏远。

examples.en: We had to cancel the picnic because a severe thunderstorm was forecasted for the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们不得不取消野餐，因为预报下午会有严重的雷暴天气。

examples.en: The sudden thunderstorm caused a power outage in the entire neighborhood.
examples.zh: 突如其来的雷暴导致整个社区停电。

examples.en: During the thunderstorm, the loud claps of thunder frightened the children.
examples.zh: 雷暴期间，响亮的雷声吓坏了孩子们。

examples.en: The thunderstorm passed quickly, leaving the air fresh and clean.
examples.zh: 雷暴很快过去了，留下了清新干净的空气。

examples.en: Charles Darwin is often considered the progenitor of modern evolutionary theory.
examples.zh: 查尔斯·达尔文通常被认为是现代进化论的先驱。

examples.en: This ancient manuscript is the progenitor of many later literary works.
examples.zh: 这份古老的手稿是许多后来文学作品的源头。

examples.en: The founder of the company is regarded as the progenitor of the entire industry.
examples.zh: 公司的创始人被视为整个行业的鼻祖。

examples.en: In mythology, Zeus is often depicted as the progenitor of many gods and heroes.
examples.zh: 在神话中，宙斯常被描绘为许多神祇和英雄的祖先。

examples.en: He was so miserly that he refused to turn on the heating even in winter.
examples.zh: 他非常吝啬，甚至在冬天也拒绝开暖气。

examples.en: Her miserly habits meant she saved every penny, but had few friends.
examples.zh: 她吝啬的习惯意味着她省下每一分钱，但朋友很少。

examples.en: The miserly landlord charged exorbitant rents for the tiny apartments.
examples.zh: 吝啬的房东对狭小的公寓收取过高的租金。

examples.en: Despite his wealth, he lived a miserly life, never spending on luxuries.
examples.zh: 尽管他很富有，却过着吝啬的生活，从不花钱买奢侈品。

examples.en: The old tramp wandered from town to town with all his belongings in a sack.
examples.zh: 那个老流浪汉背着一个麻袋，从一个城镇流浪到另一个城镇。

examples.en: We could hear the tramp of soldiers' boots as they marched past.
examples.zh: 我们能听到士兵们行军经过时沉重的脚步声。

examples.en: She decided to tramp through the forest to clear her mind.
examples.zh: 她决定徒步穿越森林来理清思绪。

examples.en: The tramp steamer carried cargo between small coastal ports.
examples.zh: 那艘不定期货船在小海港之间运输货物。

examples.en: The university offers research grants to support innovative projects.
examples.zh: 大学提供研究资助金以支持创新项目。

examples.en: The government grants citizenship to those who meet the legal requirements.
examples.zh: 政府授予符合法律要求的人公民身份。

examples.en: She received a grant to study abroad for a year.
examples.zh: 她获得了一笔资助金，用于出国留学一年。

examples.en: The foundation grants permission for the use of its facilities to non-profit organizations.
examples.zh: 该基金会准许非营利组织使用其设施。

examples.en: The city is known for its diverse ethnic communities and cultural festivals.
examples.zh: 这座城市以其多元的种族社区和文化节庆而闻名。

examples.en: Ethnic conflicts have plagued the region for decades.
examples.zh: 种族冲突困扰该地区已有数十年。

examples.en: She wore traditional ethnic clothing to celebrate her heritage.
examples.zh: 她穿着传统的民族服装来庆祝她的文化遗产。

examples.en: The restaurant serves authentic ethnic cuisine from various parts of Asia.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅供应来自亚洲各地的正宗民族美食。

examples.en: She decided to dedicate her life to helping underprivileged children.
examples.zh: 她决定毕生致力于帮助贫困儿童。

examples.en: The book is dedicated to his parents, who always supported him.
examples.zh: 这本书献给他的父母，他们一直支持着他。

examples.en: He dedicated hours each day to practicing the piano.
examples.zh: 他每天花数小时专心练习钢琴。

examples.en: The memorial was dedicated to the victims of the war.
examples.zh: 这座纪念碑是献给战争受害者的。

examples.en: The small village was clannish, with families rarely interacting with outsiders.
examples.zh: 这个小村庄很排外，家庭很少与外人交往。

examples.en: His clannish behavior made it difficult for new employees to integrate into the team.
examples.zh: 他排外的行为使得新员工难以融入团队。

examples.en: The club had a clannish atmosphere, favoring long-time members over newcomers.
examples.zh: 这个俱乐部有一种排外的氛围，偏袒老会员而非新来者。

examples.en: Despite living in a cosmopolitan city, they maintained a clannish lifestyle.
examples.zh: 尽管生活在一个国际化都市，他们仍保持着排外的生活方式。

examples.en: She methodically organized her notes before starting the research paper.
examples.zh: 她有条不紊地整理了笔记，然后才开始写研究论文。

examples.en: The detective methodically examined every piece of evidence at the crime scene.
examples.zh: 侦探有条不紊地检查了犯罪现场的每一件证据。

examples.en: He worked methodically through the list, completing each task in order.
examples.zh: 他有条不紊地处理清单上的事项，按顺序完成每项任务。

examples.en: The chef methodically prepared the ingredients before cooking the complex dish.
examples.zh: 厨师在烹饪这道复杂菜肴前，有条不紊地准备了食材。

examples.en: During the lecture, the professor tended to digress into unrelated anecdotes.
examples.zh: 讲座期间，教授倾向于离题讲一些无关的轶事。

examples.en: Let's not digress from the main topic of our discussion.
examples.zh: 我们不要偏离讨论的主要话题。

examples.en: His speech started well, but he digressed so much that the audience lost interest.
examples.zh: 他的演讲开头很好，但他离题太远，以至于听众失去了兴趣。

examples.en: I apologize for digressing; let me return to the point I was making.
examples.zh: 抱歉我离题了；让我回到我刚才的观点。

examples.en: The cat hid in the bush to escape the dog.
examples.zh: 猫躲在灌木丛里以躲避狗。

examples.en: He's a bush pilot, flying small planes in remote areas.
examples.zh: 他是一名丛林飞行员，在偏远地区驾驶小型飞机。

examples.en: They beat around the bush instead of addressing the issue directly.
examples.zh: 他们拐弯抹角，而不是直接解决问题。

examples.en: The bush telegraph spread the news quickly through the village.
examples.zh: 丛林电报迅速将消息传遍了整个村庄。

examples.en: The apocrypha includes books not accepted as canonical by all Christian denominations.
examples.zh: 伪经包括未被所有基督教派接受为正典的书籍。

examples.en: His stories about the war are considered apocrypha by historians.
examples.zh: 历史学家认为他关于战争的故事是伪经。

examples.en: The apocrypha often contains fascinating but unverified tales.
examples.zh: 伪经通常包含引人入胜但未经证实的故事。

examples.en: Scholars debate the authenticity of the apocrypha in religious texts.
examples.zh: 学者们争论宗教文本中伪经的真实性。

examples.en: He rides his motorbike to work every day to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 他每天骑摩托车上班以避免交通拥堵。

examples.en: The motorbike race attracted thousands of spectators.
examples.zh: 摩托车比赛吸引了数千名观众。

examples.en: She learned to repair motorbikes as a hobby.
examples.zh: 她学会了修理摩托车作为爱好。

examples.en: The motorbike's engine roared as it sped down the highway.
examples.zh: 摩托车在高速公路上飞驰时，引擎轰鸣。

examples.en: The beautiful music enraptured the entire audience.
examples.zh: 美妙的音乐使整个观众为之着迷。

examples.en: He was enraptured by the stunning view from the mountaintop.
examples.zh: 他被山顶的壮丽景色迷住了。

examples.en: Her performance enraptured critics and fans alike.
examples.zh: 她的表演让评论家和粉丝都为之倾倒。

examples.en: The children were enraptured by the magician's tricks.
examples.zh: 孩子们被魔术师的戏法迷住了。

examples.en: Saying 'I'm so hungry I could eat a horse' is a common hyperbole.
examples.zh: 说'我饿得能吃下一匹马'是一个常见的夸张说法。

examples.en: His use of hyperbole made the story more entertaining.
examples.zh: 他使用夸张手法使故事更有趣。

examples.en: Don't take her complaints literally; she often speaks in hyperbole.
examples.zh: 不要从字面上理解她的抱怨；她经常用夸张的方式说话。

examples.en: The advertisement's hyperbole exaggerated the product's benefits.
examples.zh: 广告的夸张手法夸大了产品的优点。

examples.en: This class is designed for beginners with no prior experience.
examples.zh: 这个课程是为没有经验的初学者设计的。

examples.en: Beginners often make mistakes, but that's part of the learning process.
examples.zh: 初学者经常犯错，但这是学习过程的一部分。

examples.en: The book provides simple exercises for beginners in yoga.
examples.zh: 这本书为瑜伽初学者提供了简单的练习。

examples.en: Beginners should start with basic techniques before advancing.
examples.zh: 初学者应该从基本技巧开始，然后再进阶。

examples.en: The river's rapids made the rafting trip thrilling.
examples.zh: 河流的急流使漂流之旅惊险刺激。

examples.en: They navigated the rapids carefully to avoid capsizing.
examples.zh: 他们小心地穿越急流以避免翻船。

examples.en: The rapids are dangerous for inexperienced kayakers.
examples.zh: 急流对经验不足的皮划艇手来说是危险的。

examples.en: The sound of the rapids echoed through the canyon.
examples.zh: 急流的声音在峡谷中回荡。

examples.en: She baked fresh bread for breakfast every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上烤新鲜面包当早餐。

examples.en: Bread and butter is a simple but classic snack.
examples.zh: 面包和黄油是一种简单但经典的小吃。

examples.en: He earns his bread as a freelance writer.
examples.zh: 他靠做自由撰稿人谋生。

examples.en: The breadwinner in the family works hard to provide.
examples.zh: 家里的养家糊口者努力工作以维持生计。

examples.en: The old building collapsed after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 旧建筑在地震后倒塌了。

examples.en: He collapsed from exhaustion after running the marathon.
examples.zh: 跑完马拉松后，他因精疲力竭而倒下。

examples.en: The company's stock price collapsed due to the scandal.
examples.zh: 由于丑闻，公司的股价暴跌。

examples.en: The negotiations collapsed when neither side would compromise.
examples.zh: 当双方都不肯妥协时，谈判破裂了。

examples.en: She wore a raincoat to stay dry during the storm.
examples.zh: 她在暴风雨中穿雨衣以保持干燥。

examples.en: He packed a raincoat in his backpack for the hiking trip.
examples.zh: 他在背包里装了一件雨衣以备徒步旅行之需。

examples.en: The bright yellow raincoat made her easy to spot in the rain.
examples.zh: 亮黄色的雨衣使她在雨中容易被发现。

examples.en: A good raincoat is essential for outdoor activities in wet weather.
examples.zh: 一件好的雨衣对于潮湿天气的户外活动至关重要。

examples.en: The police can detain suspects for up to 24 hours without charge.
examples.zh: 警方可以在不提出指控的情况下拘留嫌疑人长达24小时。

examples.en: He was detained at the airport due to visa issues.
examples.zh: 他因签证问题在机场被扣留。

examples.en: The meeting was detained by lengthy discussions.
examples.zh: 会议因冗长的讨论而被耽搁。

examples.en: She felt detained by her responsibilities at home.
examples.zh: 她感觉被家里的责任所束缚。

examples.en: I need to leave the office early today for a doctor's appointment.
examples.zh: 我今天需要早点离开办公室去看医生。

examples.en: He decided to leave his job and travel the world.
examples.zh: 他决定辞去工作去环游世界。

examples.en: Please leave the door open for some fresh air.
examples.zh: 请把门开着透透气。

examples.en: She left her phone at the restaurant and had to go back for it.
examples.zh: 她把手机忘在餐厅了，不得不回去取。

examples.en: You can reconstitute dried mushrooms by soaking them in water.
examples.zh: 你可以通过将干蘑菇浸泡在水中来复原它们。

examples.en: The committee was reconstituted with new members to improve efficiency.
examples.zh: 委员会重组了，加入了新成员以提高效率。

examples.en: After the merger, the company reconstituted its board of directors.
examples.zh: 合并后，公司重组了董事会。

examples.en: The government plans to reconstitute the old policy to address current issues.
examples.zh: 政府计划重新制定旧政策以解决当前问题。

examples.en: The band decided to disband after their final concert.
examples.zh: 乐队在最后一场音乐会后决定解散。

examples.en: The government ordered the militia to disband immediately.
examples.zh: 政府命令民兵立即解散。

examples.en: The committee was disbanded due to lack of funding.
examples.zh: 委员会因缺乏资金而被解散。

examples.en: They agreed to disband the project team once the task was completed.
examples.zh: 他们同意在任务完成后解散项目团队。

examples.en: The business began to prosper after implementing new marketing strategies.
examples.zh: 实施新的营销策略后，生意开始繁荣起来。

examples.en: With hard work, he prospered in his career and became a manager.
examples.zh: 通过努力工作，他在事业上取得成功并成为经理。

examples.en: The region prospered during the economic boom.
examples.zh: 在经济繁荣时期，这个地区兴旺发达。

examples.en: She hopes her children will prosper in their future endeavors.
examples.zh: 她希望孩子们在未来的努力中能够兴旺发达。

examples.en: Eating too much fatty food can damage your liver.
examples.zh: 吃太多高脂肪食物会损害你的肝脏。

examples.en: Liver is a rich source of iron and is often used in traditional dishes.
examples.zh: 肝脏富含铁质，常用于传统菜肴中。

examples.en: The doctor recommended a liver function test to check for any issues.
examples.zh: 医生建议进行肝功能检查以排查问题。

examples.en: He donated part of his liver to save his sister's life.
examples.zh: 他捐献了部分肝脏来挽救他姐姐的生命。

examples.en: The roof was made of slate, which is durable and weather-resistant.
examples.zh: 屋顶是用石板做的，既耐用又耐候。

examples.en: She wrote her notes on a slate with chalk.
examples.zh: 她用粉笔在石板上写笔记。

examples.en: The new movie is slated for release next month.
examples.zh: 这部新电影计划在下个月上映。

examples.en: He was slated to give a speech at the conference.
examples.zh: 他被安排好在会议上发表演讲。

examples.en: I need to retrieve my files from the cloud storage.
examples.zh: 我需要从云存储中检索我的文件。

examples.en: The dog was trained to retrieve balls during the game.
examples.zh: 这只狗被训练在游戏中捡回球。

examples.en: She managed to retrieve her lost wallet from the lost and found.
examples.zh: 她设法从失物招领处找回了丢失的钱包。

examples.en: The system can quickly retrieve data from the database.
examples.zh: 系统可以快速从数据库中检索数据。

examples.en: Mathematics is a fundamental subject taught in schools worldwide.
examples.zh: 数学是全球学校教授的一门基础学科。

examples.en: She excels in mathematics and often helps her classmates with problems.
examples.zh: 她在数学方面很出色，经常帮助同学解决问题。

examples.en: The application of mathematics in engineering is crucial for design.
examples.zh: 数学在工程中的应用对设计至关重要。

examples.en: He studied advanced mathematics at university to become a researcher.
examples.zh: 他在大学学习高等数学，以成为一名研究员。

examples.en: Keeping a first aid kit in the car is always handy in case of emergencies.
examples.zh: 在车里放一个急救箱，在紧急情况下总是很方便。

examples.en: He's very handy with tools and can fix almost anything around the house.
examples.zh: 他非常擅长使用工具，几乎能修理家里的任何东西。

examples.en: A smartphone is handy for checking emails on the go.
examples.zh: 智能手机在移动中查看电子邮件很方便。

examples.en: She found the map handy when navigating through the unfamiliar city.
examples.zh: 在陌生的城市导航时，她发现地图很实用。

examples.en: We ordered chocolate cake for dessert after the main course.
examples.zh: 主菜之后，我们点了巧克力蛋糕作为甜点。

examples.en: She loves making fruit tarts as a light summer dessert.
examples.zh: 她喜欢制作水果挞作为清爽的夏季甜点。

examples.en: The restaurant's signature dessert is a crème brûlée with caramelized sugar.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅的特色甜点是带有焦糖的焦糖布丁。

examples.en: He skipped dessert to save room for a cup of coffee.
examples.zh: 他跳过了甜点，为喝杯咖啡留点肚子。

examples.en: The Statue of Liberty is an iconic symbol of freedom in New York.
examples.zh: 自由女神像是纽约自由的标志性象征。

examples.en: They erected a bronze statue in the park to honor the local hero.
examples.zh: 他们在公园里竖立了一座青铜雕像，以纪念当地的英雄。

examples.en: The ancient statue was carefully restored by museum experts.
examples.zh: 这座古老的雕像被博物馆专家精心修复了。

examples.en: Tourists often take photos with the statue in the town square.
examples.zh: 游客们经常在镇广场上与雕像合影。

examples.en: He tautened the rope to ensure the tent was secure in the wind.
examples.zh: 他拉紧了绳子，确保帐篷在风中稳固。

examples.en: The sail tautened as the wind picked up, propelling the boat forward.
examples.zh: 随着风力增强，船帆绷紧了，推动船只前进。

examples.en: She tautened her muscles before starting the strenuous exercise.
examples.zh: 在开始剧烈运动前，她绷紧了肌肉。

examples.en: The fabric tautened over the frame to create a smooth surface for painting.
examples.zh: 布料在框架上绷紧，为绘画创造了一个光滑的表面。

examples.en: She gave him a gentle nudge to remind him it was time to leave.
examples.zh: 她轻轻推了他一下，提醒他是时候离开了。

examples.en: A small nudge from the market trends can influence investment decisions.
examples.zh: 市场趋势的轻微推动可以影响投资决策。

examples.en: He nudged the door open with his elbow while carrying boxes.
examples.zh: 他搬着箱子时，用手肘把门推开了。

examples.en: The teacher's encouragement served as a nudge for the student to try harder.
examples.zh: 老师的鼓励推动了学生更加努力尝试。

examples.en: The intractable problem required innovative solutions from the team.
examples.zh: 这个棘手的问题需要团队提供创新的解决方案。

examples.en: He was known for his intractable attitude, refusing to compromise on any issue.
examples.zh: 他以固执的态度闻名，拒绝在任何问题上妥协。

examples.en: The intractable disease has baffled doctors for decades.
examples.zh: 这种难以治愈的疾病几十年来一直困扰着医生们。

examples.en: Negotiations stalled due to the intractable nature of the conflict.
examples.zh: 谈判因冲突的棘手性质而陷入僵局。

examples.en: She added fresh lettuce to the salad for extra crunch.
examples.zh: 她在沙拉里加了新鲜的生菜，增加脆感。

examples.en: Romaine lettuce is often used in Caesar salads.
examples.zh: 长叶生菜常用于凯撒沙拉中。

examples.en: The garden is thriving with lettuce and other leafy greens.
examples.zh: 花园里长满了生菜和其他绿叶蔬菜。

examples.en: He prefers iceberg lettuce for its crisp texture in sandwiches.
examples.zh: 他喜欢冰山生菜，因为它在三明治中有脆脆的口感。

examples.en: Plastic bottles are a major source of environmental pollution.
examples.zh: 塑料瓶是环境污染的主要来源之一。

examples.en: The toy was made of durable plastic that could withstand rough play.
examples.zh: 这个玩具由耐用的塑料制成，能承受粗暴的玩耍。

examples.en: She wrapped the leftovers in plastic wrap to keep them fresh.
examples.zh: 她用保鲜膜包裹剩菜，以保持新鲜。

examples.en: The artist used plastic materials to create a modern sculpture.
examples.zh: 艺术家使用塑料材料创作了一件现代雕塑。

examples.en: Panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm sounded.
examples.zh: 火警响起时，恐慌在人群中蔓延开来。

examples.en: He tried to stay calm and not panic during the emergency.
examples.zh: 在紧急情况下，他试图保持冷静，不惊慌失措。

examples.en: The stock market crash caused widespread panic among investors.
examples.zh: 股市崩盘在投资者中引起了广泛的恐慌。

examples.en: She felt a sudden panic when she realized she had lost her keys.
examples.zh: 当她意识到丢了钥匙时，突然感到一阵恐慌。

examples.en: He used a ribbon as a bookmark to mark his place in the novel.
examples.zh: 他用一条丝带作为书签，标记在小说中的位置。

examples.en: I saved the website as a bookmark for easy access later.
examples.zh: 我把这个网站保存为书签，以便以后轻松访问。

examples.en: The library gave out free bookmarks to promote reading.
examples.zh: 图书馆发放免费书签以推广阅读。

examples.en: She created a digital bookmark to organize her online research.
examples.zh: 她创建了一个数字书签来整理她的在线研究。

examples.en: The athlete cleared the final hurdle to win the race.
examples.zh: 运动员跨过了最后一个跨栏，赢得了比赛。

examples.en: Overcoming financial hurdles was key to starting the business.
examples.zh: 克服财务障碍是创办企业的关键。

examples.en: She faced many hurdles in her career but never gave up.
examples.zh: 她在职业生涯中面临许多障碍，但从未放弃。

examples.en: The new policy aims to reduce bureaucratic hurdles for small companies.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在减少小公司的官僚障碍。

examples.en: It was expedient to take a shortcut through the woods to reach the meeting on time.
examples.zh: 为了准时到达会议，走树林捷径是权宜之计。

examples.en: The company made an expedient decision to cut costs by reducing staff.
examples.zh: 公司做出了一个权宜的决定，通过裁员来削减成本。

examples.en: He found it expedient to agree with his boss to avoid conflict.
examples.zh: 为了避免冲突，他觉得同意老板的意见是权宜之策。

examples.en: The politician's expedient promises were quickly forgotten after the election.
examples.zh: 这位政客的权宜承诺在选举后很快就被遗忘了。

examples.en: The beekeeper carefully inspected the hive for honey production.
examples.zh: 养蜂人仔细检查蜂箱的蜂蜜产量。

examples.en: The office was a hive of activity as everyone prepared for the big project.
examples.zh: 办公室像蜂巢一样忙碌，大家都在为这个大项目做准备。

examples.en: Bees work together in the hive to maintain their colony.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在蜂巢里协同工作以维持它们的群体。

examples.en: She felt like she was in a hive of gossip when she entered the room.
examples.zh: 当她进入房间时，感觉自己置身于一个八卦的蜂巢中。

examples.en: I always carry my laptop with me for work when I travel.
examples.zh: 我旅行时总是带着笔记本电脑工作。

examples.en: The new laptop has a faster processor and longer battery life.
examples.zh: 这台新笔记本电脑有更快的处理器和更长的电池续航。

examples.en: He accidentally spilled coffee on his laptop and it stopped working.
examples.zh: 他不小心把咖啡洒在笔记本电脑上，导致它无法工作了。

examples.en: Students use laptops in class to take notes and access online resources.
examples.zh: 学生在课堂上使用笔记本电脑记笔记和访问在线资源。

examples.en: She sought psychiatric help to deal with her anxiety disorder.
examples.zh: 她寻求精神病学帮助来处理她的焦虑症。

examples.en: The hospital has a dedicated psychiatric ward for mental health patients.
examples.zh: 这家医院有一个专门的精神病病房，为心理健康患者服务。

examples.en: He underwent a psychiatric evaluation as part of the legal process.
examples.zh: 他接受了精神病学评估，作为法律程序的一部分。

examples.en: Psychiatric medications can help manage symptoms of depression.
examples.zh: 精神病药物可以帮助控制抑郁症的症状。

examples.en: The clown at the circus made the children laugh with funny tricks.
examples.zh: 马戏团的小丑用滑稽的把戏逗得孩子们大笑。

examples.en: He felt like a clown when he tripped and fell in front of everyone.
examples.zh: 当他在大家面前绊倒时，感觉自己像个小丑。

examples.en: The party hired a clown to entertain the guests with balloon animals.
examples.zh: 聚会雇了一个小丑，用气球动物来娱乐客人。

examples.en: She dressed up as a clown for Halloween, complete with a red nose and big shoes.
examples.zh: 她在万圣节打扮成小丑，配有红鼻子和大鞋子。

examples.en: We ordered fish and chips for dinner at the British pub.
examples.zh: 我们在英国酒吧点了炸鱼和薯条作为晚餐。

examples.en: He ate a bag of potato chips while watching the movie.
examples.zh: 他看电影时吃了一袋薯片。

examples.en: The computer's motherboard has several microchips that control its functions.
examples.zh: 电脑的主板上有几个微芯片控制其功能。

examples.en: She used poker chips to place her bets during the game.
examples.zh: 她在游戏中使用扑克筹码下注。

examples.en: The artist's paintings are full of whimsy and imaginative creatures.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家的画作充满了奇思妙想和富有想象力的生物。

examples.en: She decorated her room with a touch of whimsy, adding fairy lights and colorful pillows.
examples.zh: 她用一丝奇思妙想装饰房间，添加了仙女灯和彩色枕头。

examples.en: His decision to quit his job and travel the world was driven by pure whimsy.
examples.zh: 他辞职环游世界的决定纯粹是出于一时兴起。

examples.en: The children's book is filled with whimsy, making it a delight to read.
examples.zh: 这本儿童书充满了奇思妙想，读起来令人愉悦。

examples.en: The Egyptian pyramids are one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
examples.zh: 埃及金字塔是古代世界七大奇迹之一。

examples.en: She studied Egyptian hieroglyphics to understand ancient texts.
examples.zh: 她学习埃及象形文字以理解古代文本。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit on Egyptian mummies and their burial practices.
examples.zh: 博物馆有一个关于埃及木乃伊及其埋葬习俗的展览。

examples.en: He ordered Egyptian cotton sheets for their softness and durability.
examples.zh: 他订购了埃及棉床单，因为它们柔软耐用。

examples.en: The Renaissance was a period of great cultural and artistic achievement.
examples.zh: 文艺复兴是一个文化和艺术成就辉煌的时期。

examples.en: She put a period at the end of the sentence to complete it.
examples.zh: 她在句子的末尾加了一个句号来完成它。

examples.en: The doctor asked about her menstrual period to assess her health.
examples.zh: 医生询问了她的月经周期以评估她的健康状况。

examples.en: In history class, we learned about the Victorian period in England.
examples.zh: 在历史课上，我们学习了英国的维多利亚时期。

examples.en: The protest turned into mayhem when the crowd started throwing objects.
examples.zh: 当人群开始投掷物品时，抗议演变成了混乱。

examples.en: The children created mayhem in the living room while playing with toys.
examples.zh: 孩子们在客厅玩玩具时制造了一片混乱。

examples.en: After the earthquake, there was mayhem as people tried to find safety.
examples.zh: 地震后，人们试图寻找安全时，场面一片混乱。

examples.en: The football match descended into mayhem after a controversial referee decision.
examples.zh: 在一次有争议的裁判决定后，足球比赛陷入了混乱。

examples.en: Studying psychology helps us understand human behavior and mental processes.
examples.zh: 学习心理学有助于我们理解人类的行为和心理过程。

examples.en: The psychology behind consumer decisions is a key focus in marketing.
examples.zh: 消费者决策背后的心理学是市场营销的一个关键焦点。

examples.en: She has a degree in clinical psychology and works as a therapist.
examples.zh: 她拥有临床心理学学位，是一名治疗师。

examples.en: Sports psychology techniques can improve an athlete's performance under pressure.
examples.zh: 运动心理学技巧可以提高运动员在压力下的表现。

examples.en: He learned to modulate his voice to sound more confident during presentations.
examples.zh: 他学会了在演讲时调节自己的声音，使其听起来更自信。

examples.en: The radio station modulates the signal to broadcast music clearly.
examples.zh: 广播电台调制信号以清晰地播放音乐。

examples.en: You should modulate your tone when speaking to children to keep them engaged.
examples.zh: 与孩子交谈时，你应该调节语气以保持他们的参与度。

examples.en: The medication helps modulate the patient's immune response to reduce inflammation.
examples.zh: 这种药物有助于调节患者的免疫反应，以减少炎症。

examples.en: The storm is moving eastward and is expected to hit the coast by tomorrow.
examples.zh: 风暴正向东移动，预计明天将袭击海岸。

examples.en: They traveled eastward across the country to reach the sunrise.
examples.zh: 他们向东穿越国家，去迎接日出。

examples.en: The river flows eastward into the sea after passing through several cities.
examples.zh: 这条河向东流经几个城市后汇入大海。

examples.en: Economic growth has been shifting eastward in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近几十年来，经济增长一直在向东转移。

examples.en: Regular dental check-ups are essential for maintaining good oral health.
examples.zh: 定期牙科检查对于保持良好的口腔健康至关重要。

examples.en: She works in a dental clinic as a hygienist, cleaning patients' teeth.
examples.zh: 她在一家牙科诊所担任卫生员，负责清洁患者的牙齿。

examples.en: The dental implant procedure requires several visits to the dentist.
examples.zh: 牙科植入手术需要多次就诊牙医。

examples.en: He experienced dental pain after eating something too cold.
examples.zh: 吃了太冷的东西后，他感到牙痛。

examples.en: It was a drizzly morning, so we decided to stay indoors.
examples.zh: 那是一个细雨蒙蒙的早晨，所以我们决定待在室内。

examples.en: The drizzly weather made the streets slick and dangerous for driving.
examples.zh: 细雨天气使街道湿滑，驾驶变得危险。

examples.en: Despite the drizzly conditions, the hikers continued their trek.
examples.zh: 尽管细雨绵绵，徒步旅行者还是继续了他们的行程。

examples.en: A drizzly fog settled over the city, reducing visibility.
examples.zh: 一层细雨般的雾气笼罩在城市上空，降低了能见度。

examples.en: The road is tapering off as it approaches the mountain pass.
examples.zh: 这条路在接近山口时逐渐变窄。

examples.en: She is tapering her medication under the doctor's supervision to avoid side effects.
examples.zh: 她在医生的监督下逐渐减少药物剂量，以避免副作用。

examples.en: The tapering design of the tower gives it a sleek, modern look.
examples.zh: 塔楼的锥形设计赋予其流畅、现代的外观。

examples.en: Economic growth showed a tapering trend in the last quarter.
examples.zh: 上一季度经济增长呈现出逐渐减缓的趋势。

examples.en: His provident savings allowed him to retire comfortably at an early age.
examples.zh: 他未雨绸缪的储蓄使他能够早早舒适地退休。

examples.en: Being provident, she always keeps an emergency fund for unexpected expenses.
examples.zh: 由于未雨绸缪，她总是为意外开支准备一笔应急基金。

examples.en: The provident farmer stored extra grain for the winter months.
examples.zh: 这位有远见的农民为冬季储存了额外的粮食。

examples.en: Provident planning is key to financial stability in uncertain times.
examples.zh: 在不确定的时期，有远见的规划是财务稳定的关键。

examples.en: The mountebank sold fake elixirs to gullible villagers at the fair.
examples.zh: 这个江湖骗子在集市上向轻信的村民出售假药水。

examples.en: He was exposed as a mountebank after his fraudulent schemes were uncovered.
examples.zh: 在他的欺诈计划被揭露后，他被曝光为一个江湖骗子。

examples.en: In the old days, mountebanks would travel from town to town deceiving people.
examples.zh: 在过去，江湖骗子会从一个城镇到另一个城镇欺骗人们。

examples.en: Don't trust that mountebank; his promises are too good to be true.
examples.zh: 不要相信那个江湖骗子；他的承诺好得令人难以置信。

examples.en: She will initiate the project by sending out the first emails tomorrow.
examples.zh: 她明天将通过发送第一封电子邮件来启动这个项目。

examples.en: The company plans to initiate a new training program for employees next month.
examples.zh: 公司计划下个月为员工启动一个新的培训计划。

examples.en: He was initiated into the secret society after passing several tests.
examples.zh: 通过几次测试后，他被接纳进入这个秘密社团。

examples.en: To initiate the process, you need to press the start button.
examples.zh: 要启动这个过程，你需要按下开始按钮。

examples.en: Please give my regards to your family when you see them.
examples.zh: 当你见到你的家人时，请代我向他们问好。

examples.en: In regards to your inquiry, we will respond within 24 hours.
examples.zh: 关于您的询问，我们将在24小时内回复。

examples.en: She holds him in high regards for his honesty and integrity.
examples.zh: 她因他的诚实和正直而对他评价很高。

examples.en: With kind regards, I look forward to hearing from you soon.
examples.zh: 致以亲切的问候，我期待尽快收到您的回复。

examples.en: She cracked an egg into the frying pan for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她往煎锅里打了一个鸡蛋做早餐。

examples.en: The bird laid a speckled egg in its nest.
examples.zh: 那只鸟在巢里下了一个带斑点的蛋。

examples.en: He has an egg on his forehead from bumping into the door.
examples.zh: 他撞到门上，额头上起了一个包。

examples.en: They egged him on to try the dangerous stunt.
examples.zh: 他们怂恿他去尝试那个危险的特技。

examples.en: She is a consummate professional in her field.
examples.zh: 她是她所在领域里技艺精湛的专业人士。

examples.en: The deal was consummated with a handshake.
examples.zh: 这笔交易以握手的方式最终完成。

examples.en: He consummated his marriage after the wedding ceremony.
examples.zh: 婚礼仪式后，他圆房完成了婚姻。

examples.en: Her performance was a consummate display of skill and artistry.
examples.zh: 她的表演是技巧与艺术性的完美展现。

examples.en: She put the kettle on to boil water for tea.
examples.zh: 她把水壶放上去烧水泡茶。

examples.en: The old kettle whistled when the water reached boiling point.
examples.zh: 水烧开时，旧水壶发出了哨声。

examples.en: That's a fine kettle of fish we've gotten ourselves into.
examples.zh: 我们真是陷入了一个棘手的困境。

examples.en: He cleaned the mineral deposits from inside the kettle.
examples.zh: 他清除了水壶内部的水垢。

examples.en: Cannibalism was practiced by some ancient tribes.
examples.zh: 一些古代部落曾实行食人习俗。

examples.en: The survivors resorted to cannibalism in the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 幸存者在严冬中被迫采取了食人行为。

examples.en: Cannibalism among animals is rare but occurs under stress.
examples.zh: 动物间的同类相食现象罕见，但在压力下会发生。

examples.en: The novel explores themes of cannibalism and survival.
examples.zh: 这部小说探讨了食人与生存的主题。

examples.en: Her hair was in a tangle after the windy walk.
examples.zh: 在风中散步后，她的头发乱成一团。

examples.en: The wires got into a tangle behind the computer.
examples.zh: 电脑后面的电线缠结在了一起。

examples.en: They got into a tangle over the contract details.
examples.zh: 他们在合同细节上发生了争执。

examples.en: He tried to tangle with the bully but was stopped by friends.
examples.zh: 他想和那个恶霸纠缠，但被朋友们拦住了。

examples.en: He chopped a log for the fireplace.
examples.zh: 他劈了一根木头用于壁炉。

examples.en: The captain kept a detailed log of the voyage.
examples.zh: 船长详细记录了航行日志。

examples.en: She logged into her email account.
examples.zh: 她登录了她的电子邮件账户。

examples.en: The company logs all customer complaints for review.
examples.zh: 公司记录所有客户投诉以供审查。

examples.en: She has a passion for equine sports like horse racing.
examples.zh: 她对赛马等马类运动充满热情。

examples.en: The equine anatomy is well-suited for running.
examples.zh: 马的解剖结构非常适合奔跑。

examples.en: He works at an equine veterinary clinic.
examples.zh: 他在一家马兽医诊所工作。

examples.en: The sculpture depicted an equine figure in motion.
examples.zh: 这座雕塑描绘了一匹动态的马的形象。

examples.en: The sun radiates heat and light to the Earth.
examples.zh: 太阳向地球辐射热和光。

examples.en: She radiated confidence during the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在演示中散发出自信。

examples.en: The roads radiate from the city center like spokes.
examples.zh: 道路像轮辐一样从市中心向外辐射。

examples.en: The warmth radiated from the fireplace filled the room.
examples.zh: 从壁炉辐射出的温暖充满了房间。

examples.en: The stock prices plummeted after the bad news.
examples.zh: 坏消息传出后，股价暴跌。

examples.en: The eagle plummeted from the sky to catch its prey.
examples.zh: 老鹰从空中俯冲下来捕捉猎物。

examples.en: Temperatures are expected to plummet overnight.
examples.zh: 预计夜间气温将骤降。

examples.en: His popularity plummeted following the scandal.
examples.zh: 丑闻之后，他的受欢迎度急剧下降。

examples.en: Her familiarity with the software made the task easy.
examples.zh: 她对软件的熟悉使这项任务变得容易。

examples.en: He showed too much familiarity by using her first name without permission.
examples.zh: 他未经允许直呼其名，显得过于随便。

examples.en: Familiarity breeds contempt in some relationships.
examples.zh: 在某些关系中，熟悉会滋生轻视。

examples.en: The tour guide spoke with familiarity about the city's history.
examples.zh: 导游对这座城市的历史了如指掌地讲解。

examples.en: The herpetologist carefully studied the snake's behavior in its natural habitat.
examples.zh: 这位爬虫学家仔细研究了蛇在其自然栖息地中的行为。

examples.en: As a herpetologist, she specialized in the conservation of endangered amphibian species.
examples.zh: 作为一名爬虫学家，她专门从事濒危两栖动物物种的保护工作。

examples.en: The herpetologist's discovery of a new lizard species made headlines in the scientific community.
examples.zh: 这位爬虫学家发现了一种新的蜥蜴物种，在科学界引起了轰动。

examples.en: He became a herpetologist because of his childhood fascination with turtles and frogs.
examples.zh: 他之所以成为一名爬虫学家，是因为童年时对乌龟和青蛙的迷恋。

examples.en: She squeezed fresh orange juice for breakfast every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都会榨新鲜橙汁当早餐。

examples.en: The mechanic said the car's battery needed more juice to start properly.
examples.zh: 机械师说汽车的电池需要更多电力才能正常启动。

examples.en: After the workout, he drank a protein juice to replenish his energy.
examples.zh: 锻炼后，他喝了一杯蛋白质果汁来补充能量。

examples.en: The scandal really juiced up the media coverage of the election.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻确实给选举的媒体报道增添了活力。

examples.en: Learning idiomatic expressions is essential for sounding like a native speaker.
examples.zh: 学习惯用表达对于听起来像母语者至关重要。

examples.en: His translation was too literal and missed the idiomatic meaning of the phrase.
examples.zh: 他的翻译太字面化，没有抓住这个短语的惯用含义。

examples.en: She used an idiomatic expression that confused the non-native listeners.
examples.zh: 她用了一个惯用表达，让非母语的听众感到困惑。

examples.en: The teacher explained the idiomatic usage of 'kick the bucket' in English.
examples.zh: 老师解释了英语中'kick the bucket'的惯用用法。

examples.en: He felt deep humiliation after his public speaking mistake was mocked online.
examples.zh: 他的公开演讲失误被网上嘲笑后，他感到深深的羞辱。

examples.en: The team's defeat was a humiliation that they vowed to avenge next season.
examples.zh: 球队的失败是一种羞辱，他们发誓要在下个赛季复仇。

examples.en: She suffered humiliation when her private emails were leaked to the press.
examples.zh: 当她的私人邮件被泄露给媒体时，她遭受了羞辱。

examples.en: The politician's scandal led to his public humiliation and resignation.
examples.zh: 这位政治家的丑闻导致了他的公开羞辱和辞职。

examples.en: She had hardly finished her meal when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 她刚吃完饭，电话就响了。

examples.en: He could hardly believe his eyes when he saw the surprise party.
examples.zh: 当他看到惊喜派对时，他几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。

examples.en: There's hardly any milk left in the fridge; we need to buy more.
examples.zh: 冰箱里几乎没剩什么牛奶了；我们需要再买一些。

examples.en: The old bridge is hardly safe to cross after the storm damage.
examples.zh: 这座旧桥在风暴损坏后几乎不安全，无法通行。

examples.en: The entrancing melody of the violin captivated the entire audience.
examples.zh: 小提琴迷人的旋律吸引了全场观众。

examples.en: Her entrancing smile made everyone in the room feel at ease.
examples.zh: 她迷人的微笑让房间里的每个人都感到轻松。

examples.en: The entrancing beauty of the sunset over the ocean left them speechless.
examples.zh: 海上日落的迷人美景让他们无言以对。

examples.en: He found the book so entrancing that he read it in one sitting.
examples.zh: 他觉得这本书如此迷人，以至于一口气读完了。

examples.en: I distinctly remember telling you to meet me at 3 PM.
examples.zh: 我清楚地记得告诉过你下午3点见我。

examples.en: The smell of coffee was distinctly noticeable as soon as we entered the café.
examples.zh: 我们一进咖啡馆，咖啡的味道就明显可闻。

examples.en: Her accent is distinctly British, even though she's lived abroad for years.
examples.zh: 她的口音明显是英式的，尽管她在国外生活了多年。

examples.en: The two proposals are distinctly different in their approach to the problem.
examples.zh: 这两个提案在解决问题的方法上明显不同。

examples.en: Generally speaking, people tend to be more productive in the morning.
examples.zh: 一般来说，人们往往在早上更有效率。

examples.en: The weather in this region is generally mild throughout the year.
examples.zh: 这个地区的天气一年四季通常都很温和。

examples.en: He is generally regarded as one of the best scientists in his field.
examples.zh: 他被普遍认为是他所在领域最好的科学家之一。

examples.en: Generally, I prefer tea over coffee, but today I'll make an exception.
examples.zh: 通常，我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡，但今天我会破例。

examples.en: Her altruism was evident when she donated all her savings to charity.
examples.zh: 当她将所有积蓄捐给慈善机构时，她的利他主义显而易见。

examples.en: Altruism is often considered a key component of ethical behavior in society.
examples.zh: 利他主义通常被认为是社会道德行为的关键组成部分。

examples.en: He acted out of pure altruism, without expecting any reward in return.
examples.zh: 他出于纯粹的利他主义行事，不期望任何回报。

examples.en: The organization promotes altruism through volunteer programs and community service.
examples.zh: 该组织通过志愿者项目和社区服务来推广利他主义。

examples.en: They used wax to seal the envelope before mailing the important document.
examples.zh: 他们在邮寄重要文件前用蜡封好了信封。

examples.en: The diver saw a seal swimming gracefully in the cold Arctic waters.
examples.zh: 潜水员看到一只海豹在寒冷的北极水域优雅地游泳。

examples.en: The contract was finalized once both parties agreed to seal the deal with a handshake.
examples.zh: 一旦双方同意握手成交，合同就最终确定了。

examples.en: Make sure to seal the jar tightly to keep the food fresh.
examples.zh: 确保把罐子密封紧，以保持食物新鲜。

examples.en: The baby's premature birth required special care in the neonatal unit.
examples.zh: 婴儿的早产需要在新生儿监护室进行特殊护理。

examples.en: It's premature to celebrate victory before the final results are announced.
examples.zh: 在最终结果公布之前庆祝胜利还为时过早。

examples.en: His premature aging was attributed to years of stress and poor lifestyle.
examples.zh: 他的过早衰老归因于多年的压力和不良生活方式。

examples.en: The company's premature expansion led to financial difficulties.
examples.zh: 公司过早的扩张导致了财务困难。

examples.en: She developed a persistent cough after catching a cold.
examples.zh: 她感冒后出现了持续性咳嗽。

examples.en: Cover your mouth when you cough to prevent spreading germs.
examples.zh: 咳嗽时捂住嘴以防传播细菌。

examples.en: The dry air in the office makes me cough frequently.
examples.zh: 办公室的干燥空气让我频繁咳嗽。

examples.en: He took cough syrup to relieve his throat irritation.
examples.zh: 他服用了止咳糖浆来缓解喉咙不适。

examples.en: The emergency team acted with celerity to save the injured hiker.
examples.zh: 急救团队迅速行动以拯救受伤的徒步者。

examples.en: The project was completed with remarkable celerity, ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 该项目以惊人的速度提前完成。

examples.en: Her celerity in decision-making impressed her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她决策的迅速给同事们留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The company responded with celerity to the customer's complaint.
examples.zh: 公司迅速回应了客户的投诉。

examples.en: His argument was based on sound logic and clear evidence.
examples.zh: 他的论点基于合理的逻辑和清晰的证据。

examples.en: Studying formal logic helps improve critical thinking skills.
examples.zh: 学习形式逻辑有助于提高批判性思维能力。

examples.en: There's no logic in spending so much on something you rarely use.
examples.zh: 在很少使用的东西上花这么多钱毫无逻辑。

examples.en: The computer program follows a strict logic to process data.
examples.zh: 计算机程序遵循严格的逻辑来处理数据。

examples.en: Natation is an essential skill for safety around water.
examples.zh: 游泳是水边安全的一项基本技能。

examples.en: The school offers natation classes for beginners every summer.
examples.zh: 学校每年夏天都为初学者提供游泳课程。

examples.en: His proficiency in natation earned him a spot on the swim team.
examples.zh: 他在游泳方面的熟练程度使他在游泳队中获得了一席之地。

examples.en: The book covers various styles of natation, from freestyle to butterfly.
examples.zh: 这本书涵盖了从自由泳到蝶泳的各种游泳风格。

examples.en: My preference is for tea over coffee in the morning.
examples.zh: 我早上的偏好是茶而不是咖啡。

examples.en: The hotel accommodates dietary preferences upon request.
examples.zh: 酒店根据要求满足饮食偏好。

examples.en: She has a strong preference for classical music.
examples.zh: 她对古典音乐有强烈的偏好。

examples.en: Customer preferences are crucial for product development.
examples.zh: 客户偏好对产品开发至关重要。

examples.en: The accretion of sediment formed a new island over centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，沉积物的堆积形成了一个新岛屿。

examples.en: The company's growth was due to the accretion of small acquisitions.
examples.zh: 公司的增长是由于小规模收购的积累。

examples.en: The accretion of knowledge over time led to scientific breakthroughs.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，知识的积累导致了科学突破。

examples.en: The accretion of ice on the wings posed a danger to the aircraft.
examples.zh: 机翼上冰的积聚对飞机构成了危险。

examples.en: The width of the river makes it difficult to cross without a bridge.
examples.zh: 河的宽度使得没有桥很难穿越。

examples.en: Measure the width of the table to ensure it fits in the room.
examples.zh: 测量桌子的宽度以确保它适合房间。

examples.en: The new highway has increased the width of the lanes for safety.
examples.zh: 新高速公路增加了车道宽度以提高安全性。

examples.en: The width of his shoulders gives him a strong appearance.
examples.zh: 他肩膀的宽度使他看起来很强壮。

examples.en: She has a slim figure from regular exercise and a healthy diet.
examples.zh: 由于定期锻炼和健康饮食，她身材苗条。

examples.en: The sales figures for this quarter exceeded expectations.
examples.zh: 本季度的销售数据超出了预期。

examples.en: He is a prominent figure in the field of environmental science.
examples.zh: 他是环境科学领域的杰出人物。

examples.en: Can you figure out how to solve this math problem?
examples.zh: 你能想出如何解决这个数学问题吗？

examples.en: She sat beside her friend during the movie.
examples.zh: 她在看电影时坐在朋友旁边。

examples.en: The park is located right beside the river.
examples.zh: 公园就在河边。

examples.en: His achievements pale beside those of his predecessor.
examples.zh: 与前任相比，他的成就相形见绌。

examples.en: Beside being a doctor, she is also a talented musician.
examples.zh: 除了是医生，她还是一位有才华的音乐家。

examples.en: In ancient rituals, priests would immolate animals as sacrifices to the gods.
examples.zh: 在古代仪式中，祭司会将动物献祭给神灵。

examples.en: The protesters threatened to immolate themselves if their demands were not met.
examples.zh: 抗议者威胁说，如果他们的要求得不到满足，他们将自焚。

examples.en: She felt like she was immolating her career by taking such a risky stand.
examples.zh: 她觉得自己采取如此冒险的立场是在毁掉自己的职业生涯。

examples.en: The cult leader convinced his followers to immolate their possessions as a sign of devotion.
examples.zh: 邪教头目说服信徒烧毁财产以示虔诚。

examples.en: Potatoes are a common tuber that is widely used in cooking around the world.
examples.zh: 土豆是一种常见的块茎，在世界各地的烹饪中广泛使用。

examples.en: The farmer harvested sweet potatoes, which are nutritious tubers rich in vitamins.
examples.zh: 农民收获了红薯，这是一种富含维生素的营养块茎。

examples.en: In botany, a tuber is a swollen underground stem that stores nutrients for the plant.
examples.zh: 在植物学中，块茎是一种膨大的地下茎，为植物储存养分。

examples.en: Yams and cassava are other examples of edible tubers found in tropical regions.
examples.zh: 山药和木薯是热带地区其他可食用块茎的例子。

examples.en: The kind master decided to manumit his slaves, granting them their freedom.
examples.zh: 仁慈的主人决定解放他的奴隶，给予他们自由。

examples.en: In ancient Rome, it was possible for a slave to be manumitted through legal procedures.
examples.zh: 在古罗马，奴隶可以通过法律程序获得解放。

examples.en: The abolitionist worked tirelessly to manumit all enslaved people in the country.
examples.zh: 废奴主义者不懈努力，以解放该国所有被奴役的人。

examples.en: After years of service, the loyal servant was finally manumitted by his grateful owner.
examples.zh: 经过多年的服务，忠诚的仆人终于被感激的主人解放了。

examples.en: He wore a crisp white shirt to the job interview to make a good impression.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件挺括的白衬衫去参加求职面试，以留下好印象。

examples.en: She lost her shirt in the stock market crash, losing all her savings.
examples.zh: 她在股市崩盘中输得精光，失去了所有积蓄。

examples.en: The team's new shirts feature a bold design with the sponsor's logo.
examples.zh: 球队的新球衣设计大胆，印有赞助商的标志。

examples.en: Keep your shirt on! There's no need to get so angry over a small mistake.
examples.zh: 冷静点！没必要为一个小错误发这么大脾气。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medication to palliate the patient's chronic pain.
examples.zh: 医生开了药来缓解病人的慢性疼痛。

examples.en: His apology did little to palliate the damage caused by his harsh words.
examples.zh: 他的道歉几乎没有减轻他刻薄话语造成的伤害。

examples.en: The government introduced measures to palliate the effects of the economic crisis.
examples.zh: 政府采取措施以减轻经济危机的影响。

examples.en: She tried to palliate her guilt by making a generous donation to charity.
examples.zh: 她试图通过向慈善机构慷慨捐款来减轻自己的内疚感。

examples.en: As a firm believer in hard work, she never gives up on her goals.
examples.zh: 作为勤奋工作的坚定信徒，她从不放弃自己的目标。

examples.en: He is a true believer in the power of positive thinking to change one's life.
examples.zh: 他坚信积极思考的力量可以改变人生。

examples.en: The religious leader inspired thousands of believers with his sermons.
examples.zh: 这位宗教领袖用他的布道激励了成千上万的信徒。

examples.en: She became a believer in alternative medicine after it cured her chronic illness.
examples.zh: 在替代疗法治愈了她的慢性病后，她成为了其信徒。

examples.en: The document had several typographical errors that needed to be corrected before publishing.
examples.zh: 这份文件有几个印刷错误，需要在出版前更正。

examples.en: Good typographical design enhances readability and makes text more appealing.
examples.zh: 良好的印刷设计能提高可读性，使文本更具吸引力。

examples.en: The editor was meticulous about typographical consistency throughout the book.
examples.zh: 编辑对整本书的印刷一致性非常细致。

examples.en: A typographical mistake in the contract led to a costly legal dispute.
examples.zh: 合同中的一个印刷错误导致了一场代价高昂的法律纠纷。

examples.en: Mice and rats are common rodents that can be found in urban areas.
examples.zh: 老鼠是城市地区常见的啮齿动物。

examples.en: The farmer set traps to control the rodent population in his barn.
examples.zh: 农民设置了陷阱来控制谷仓里的啮齿动物数量。

examples.en: Squirrels are also classified as rodents, known for their bushy tails and climbing skills.
examples.zh: 松鼠也被归类为啮齿动物，以其毛茸茸的尾巴和攀爬技能而闻名。

examples.en: Rodents can carry diseases, so it's important to keep them out of homes.
examples.zh: 啮齿动物可能携带疾病，因此将它们挡在屋外很重要。

examples.en: The accident resulted in grievous injuries that required extensive medical treatment.
examples.zh: 事故造成了严重伤害，需要大量医疗救治。

examples.en: He made a grievous error in judgment that cost the company millions.
examples.zh: 他犯了一个严重的判断错误，使公司损失了数百万。

examples.en: The community mourned the grievous loss of their beloved mayor.
examples.zh: 社区哀悼他们敬爱的市长的重大损失。

examples.en: Her words caused grievous harm to their friendship, which was hard to repair.
examples.zh: 她的话对他们的友谊造成了严重伤害，难以修复。

examples.en: The storm is expected to intensify overnight, bringing heavy rain and strong winds.
examples.zh: 预计风暴将在夜间加剧，带来大雨和强风。

examples.en: She decided to intensify her training regimen in preparation for the marathon.
examples.zh: 她决定加强训练计划，为马拉松做准备。

examples.en: The conflict between the two countries has intensified in recent months.
examples.zh: 最近几个月，两国之间的冲突加剧了。

examples.en: To intensify the flavor, add more spices to the soup while it simmers.
examples.zh: 为了增强风味，在汤炖煮时加入更多香料。

examples.en: She often reminisces about the halcyon days of her childhood.
examples.zh: 她常常怀念童年那些宁静美好的时光。

examples.en: The halcyon weather made our beach vacation perfect.
examples.zh: 平静的天气让我们的海滩假期完美无瑕。

examples.en: In halcyon times, the village was known for its peace and prosperity.
examples.zh: 在太平盛世，这个村庄以和平与繁荣而闻名。

examples.en: The artist's halcyon paintings evoke a sense of tranquility.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家宁静的画作唤起了一种平静感。

examples.en: She always dresses in a chic and elegant style.
examples.zh: 她总是穿着时尚优雅的风格。

examples.en: The new café has a very chic interior design.
examples.zh: 这家新咖啡馆的室内设计非常时髦。

examples.en: He managed to look chic even in casual clothes.
examples.zh: 他即使穿着休闲装也显得很别致。

examples.en: The fashion show featured chic outfits from top designers.
examples.zh: 时装秀展示了顶级设计师的时尚服装。

examples.en: In the past, the aristocracy held most of the political power.
examples.zh: 过去，贵族阶层掌握着大部分政治权力。

examples.en: She comes from an old aristocracy family with a long history.
examples.zh: 她出身于一个历史悠久的古老贵族家庭。

examples.en: The aristocracy often lived in grand mansions and estates.
examples.zh: 贵族阶层常常住在宏伟的宅邸和庄园里。

examples.en: During the revolution, the aristocracy lost many of their privileges.
examples.zh: 在革命期间，贵族阶层失去了许多特权。

examples.en: The village held a fete to celebrate the harvest festival.
examples.zh: 村庄举办了一场游园会来庆祝丰收节。

examples.en: We attended a charity fete organized by the local community.
examples.zh: 我们参加了当地社区组织的慈善游园会。

examples.en: The school fete included games, food stalls, and live music.
examples.zh: 学校的游园会包括游戏、小吃摊和现场音乐。

examples.en: They feted the hero with a grand party after his return.
examples.zh: 英雄归来后，他们用盛大的派对款待了他。

examples.en: His success is a testament to his hard work and dedication.
examples.zh: 他的成功是他辛勤工作和奉献的证明。

examples.en: The ancient ruins are a testament to the civilization's advanced engineering.
examples.zh: 这些古代遗迹是该文明先进工程的见证。

examples.en: She left a testament detailing how her assets should be distributed.
examples.zh: 她留下了一份遗嘱，详细说明了她的资产应如何分配。

examples.en: The team's victory was a testament to their strong teamwork.
examples.zh: 团队的胜利是他们强大团队合作的证明。

examples.en: Many farms in the region grow organic vegetables.
examples.zh: 该地区的许多农场种植有机蔬菜。

examples.en: He manages several farms that specialize in dairy production.
examples.zh: 他管理着几家专门从事乳制品生产的农场。

examples.en: The government provides subsidies to support small farms.
examples.zh: 政府提供补贴以支持小型农场。

examples.en: During the summer, we visited local farms to pick fresh fruits.
examples.zh: 夏天时，我们参观了当地农场采摘新鲜水果。

examples.en: Her grandson visits her every weekend.
examples.zh: 她的孙子每个周末都来看望她。

examples.en: He is proud to be the grandson of a war hero.
examples.zh: 他为自己是战争英雄的孙子而感到自豪。

examples.en: The old man told stories to his grandson about his youth.
examples.zh: 老人向他的孙子讲述了他年轻时的故事。

examples.en: She bought a toy for her grandson's birthday.
examples.zh: 她为孙子的生日买了一个玩具。

examples.en: He won the competition outright with a perfect score.
examples.zh: 他以满分彻底赢得了比赛。

examples.en: She rejected the proposal outright without any hesitation.
examples.zh: 她毫不犹豫地断然拒绝了这项提议。

examples.en: The company owns the property outright, with no mortgages.
examples.zh: 公司完全拥有该房产，没有任何抵押贷款。

examples.en: He was accused of lying outright during the investigation.
examples.zh: 他被指控在调查中公然撒谎。

examples.en: Promotions should be based on merit, not seniority.
examples.zh: 晋升应基于功绩，而不是资历。

examples.en: The proposal has considerable merit and deserves further consideration.
examples.zh: 这项提议有相当大的优点，值得进一步考虑。

examples.en: She received an award for her merit in scientific research.
examples.zh: 她因在科学研究中的功绩而获得了一个奖项。

examples.en: The judge will decide the case on its own merits.
examples.zh: 法官将根据案件本身的是非曲直来裁决。

examples.en: The opulent palace was filled with gold and jewels.
examples.zh: 这座豪华的宫殿里到处都是黄金和珠宝。

examples.en: They hosted an opulent banquet for the guests.
examples.zh: 他们为客人们举办了一场奢华的宴会。

examples.en: Her opulent lifestyle included luxury cars and exotic vacations.
examples.zh: 她奢华的生活方式包括豪华汽车和异国度假。

examples.en: The hotel's opulent decor impressed all the visitors.
examples.zh: 酒店豪华的装饰给所有访客留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The documentary was highly instructive, offering valuable insights into ancient civilizations.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片非常有教育意义，提供了关于古代文明的宝贵见解。

examples.en: Her instructive feedback helped me improve my presentation skills significantly.
examples.zh: 她富有启发性的反馈极大地帮助我提升了演讲技巧。

examples.en: The manual provides instructive guidelines for assembling the furniture correctly.
examples.zh: 这本手册提供了组装家具的正确指导性说明。

examples.en: It was an instructive experience to work with such a diverse team.
examples.zh: 与如此多元化的团队合作是一次富有教益的经历。

examples.en: All participants must complete the registration form by Friday.
examples.zh: 所有参与者必须在周五前完成注册表格。

examples.en: She ate all the cookies, leaving none for her siblings.
examples.zh: 她吃掉了所有的饼干，一点都没留给她的兄弟姐妹。

examples.en: After all the hard work, they finally achieved their goal.
examples.zh: 经过所有的努力，他们终于实现了目标。

examples.en: The storm damaged all the windows in the building.
examples.zh: 暴风雨损坏了建筑物里所有的窗户。

examples.en: I have a busy week ahead with meetings every day.
examples.zh: 我接下来的一周会很忙，每天都有会议。

examples.en: They went on vacation for a week to relax by the beach.
examples.zh: 他们去海滩度假一周以放松身心。

examples.en: The project deadline is in two weeks, so we need to hurry.
examples.zh: 项目截止日期还有两周，所以我们需要抓紧。

examples.en: She exercises three times a week to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 她每周锻炼三次以保持健康。

examples.en: He has a strong aversion to public speaking and avoids it whenever possible.
examples.zh: 他对公开演讲有强烈的厌恶感，尽可能避免。

examples.en: Her aversion to spicy food means she never orders anything hot.
examples.zh: 她对辛辣食物的反感意味着她从不点任何辣的东西。

examples.en: Many people have an aversion to snakes due to fear.
examples.zh: 许多人由于恐惧而对蛇有厌恶感。

examples.en: His aversion to conflict makes him a great mediator in disputes.
examples.zh: 他对冲突的厌恶使他成为纠纷中出色的调解人。

examples.en: The staff at the hotel were very friendly and welcoming.
examples.zh: 酒店的员工非常友好和热情。

examples.en: They have a friendly competition going on to see who can sell more.
examples.zh: 他们正在进行一场友好的竞赛，看谁能卖出更多。

examples.en: This software is user-friendly, making it easy for beginners to use.
examples.zh: 这款软件用户友好，让初学者易于使用。

examples.en: She gave me a friendly reminder about the upcoming deadline.
examples.zh: 她友好地提醒我即将到来的截止日期。

examples.en: The contract was declared void due to a legal technicality.
examples.zh: 由于法律技术性问题，合同被宣布无效。

examples.en: After the breakup, she felt a void in her life that was hard to fill.
examples.zh: 分手后，她感到生活中有一个难以填补的空虚。

examples.en: The warranty is void if the product is damaged by misuse.
examples.zh: 如果产品因误用而损坏，保修将失效。

examples.en: He stared into the void of space, feeling small and insignificant.
examples.zh: 他凝视着太空的虚空，感到渺小和无足轻重。

examples.en: The ancient prophecy seemed to foretell the rise of a great leader.
examples.zh: 古老的预言似乎预示了一位伟大领袖的崛起。

examples.en: No one could have foretold the economic crisis that hit the country.
examples.zh: 没有人能预见到袭击该国的经济危机。

examples.en: Her dreams sometimes foretell events that happen in real life.
examples.zh: 她的梦有时会预示现实生活中发生的事件。

examples.en: The dark clouds foretell an approaching storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

examples.en: They built a kennel in the backyard for their dog to sleep in.
examples.zh: 他们在后院建了一个狗窝，让他们的狗在里面睡觉。

examples.en: When going on vacation, they left their pet at a professional kennel.
examples.zh: 去度假时，他们把宠物留在一家专业的犬舍。

examples.en: The kennel provides boarding services for dogs and cats.
examples.zh: 这家犬舍为狗和猫提供寄宿服务。

examples.en: He cleaned the kennel regularly to keep it hygienic for the puppies.
examples.zh: 他定期清洁狗窝，以保持幼犬的卫生。

examples.en: The store offers a wide range of products, from electronics to clothing.
examples.zh: 这家商店提供广泛的产品范围，从电子产品到服装。

examples.en: The temperature can range from freezing to very hot in this region.
examples.zh: 这个地区的温度范围可以从冰点到非常炎热。

examples.en: Her interests range from painting to hiking, making her very versatile.
examples.zh: 她的兴趣范围从绘画到徒步旅行，使她非常多才多艺。

examples.en: The rifle has an effective range of up to 500 meters.
examples.zh: 这把步枪的有效射程可达500米。

examples.en: The children's exuberance was evident as they played in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在公园玩耍时，他们的活力显而易见。

examples.en: Her exuberance for life is contagious and inspires everyone around her.
examples.zh: 她对生活的热情具有感染力，激励着她周围的每个人。

examples.en: The exuberance of the festival was marked by music, dancing, and laughter.
examples.zh: 节日的活力通过音乐、舞蹈和笑声体现出来。

examples.en: After winning the championship, the team celebrated with great exuberance.
examples.zh: 赢得冠军后，团队以极大的热情庆祝。

examples.en: The hotel has comfortable beds for a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 这家酒店有舒适的床铺，能保证良好的睡眠。

examples.en: They planted flowers in the raised beds of their garden.
examples.zh: 他们在花园的抬升花坛里种了花。

examples.en: The river beds were dry after the long drought.
examples.zh: 长时间的干旱后，河床都干涸了。

examples.en: She made the beds every morning as part of her routine.
examples.zh: 她每天早上整理床铺，这是她日常的一部分。

examples.en: The beekeeper carefully inspected the beehive for honey production.
examples.zh: 养蜂人仔细检查蜂箱以了解蜂蜜的产量。

examples.en: Her hair was styled into a beehive, a popular fashion in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 她的头发梳成了蜂窝头，这是20世纪60年代流行的时尚发型。

examples.en: The office was a beehive of activity during the project deadline.
examples.zh: 在项目截止日期期间，办公室像蜂巢一样忙碌。

examples.en: They built a beehive in the backyard to support local pollination.
examples.zh: 他们在后院建了一个蜂箱，以支持当地的授粉。

examples.en: The value of the car will depreciate quickly after purchase.
examples.zh: 这辆车的价值在购买后会迅速贬值。

examples.en: He tends to depreciate his own achievements, even when they are significant.
examples.zh: 他倾向于贬低自己的成就，即使它们很重要。

examples.en: The company's assets are depreciated over their useful life for accounting purposes.
examples.zh: 出于会计目的，公司的资产在其使用寿命内进行折旧。

examples.en: Don't let criticism depreciate your self-worth; stay confident.
examples.zh: 不要让批评贬低你的自我价值；保持自信。

examples.en: She suffers from chronic back pain that requires ongoing treatment.
examples.zh: 她患有慢性背痛，需要持续治疗。

examples.en: Chronic lateness can harm your reputation at work.
examples.zh: 习惯性迟到可能会损害你在工作中的声誉。

examples.en: The region faces chronic water shortages due to climate change.
examples.zh: 由于气候变化，该地区面临长期的水资源短缺。

examples.en: He is a chronic complainer, always finding something to criticize.
examples.zh: 他是个习惯性的抱怨者，总是找东西来批评。

examples.en: The board decided to appoint her as the new CEO.
examples.zh: 董事会决定任命她为新任首席执行官。

examples.en: They appointed a time to meet next week for the discussion.
examples.zh: 他们约定了一个时间下周见面讨论。

examples.en: The government appointed a committee to investigate the issue.
examples.zh: 政府任命了一个委员会来调查这个问题。

examples.en: He was appointed to the position based on his extensive experience.
examples.zh: 基于他丰富的经验，他被任命到这个职位。

examples.en: The incessant rain caused flooding in many areas.
examples.zh: 连绵不断的雨导致许多地区发生洪水。

examples.en: Her incessant talking made it hard to concentrate.
examples.zh: 她不停的说话让人难以集中注意力。

examples.en: The dog's incessant barking kept the neighbors awake all night.
examples.zh: 狗不停的吠叫让邻居们整晚无法入睡。

examples.en: He faced incessant criticism from his peers during the project.
examples.zh: 在项目期间，他面临着来自同行的不断批评。

examples.en: They drove along the scenic coast, enjoying the ocean views.
examples.zh: 他们沿着风景优美的海岸行驶，欣赏海景。

examples.en: After working hard, he decided to coast through the rest of the week.
examples.zh: 努力工作后，他决定轻松度过这周剩下的时间。

examples.en: The ship sailed close to the coast to avoid rough seas.
examples.zh: 船靠近海岸航行，以避开汹涌的海浪。

examples.en: She coasted to victory in the race, as her competitors fell behind.
examples.zh: 在比赛中，她轻松获胜，因为她的竞争对手落后了。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a saline solution to clean the wound.
examples.zh: 医生开了生理盐水来清洗伤口。

examples.en: The lake is saline, making it unsuitable for drinking water.
examples.zh: 这个湖是咸水湖，不适合作为饮用水。
