examples.en: He finished the marathon surprisingly quickly for someone who had just started training.
examples.zh: 对于一个刚开始训练的人来说，他完成马拉松的速度出奇地快。

examples.en: In retrospect, I realize that I should have taken that job offer.
examples.zh: 回想起来，我意识到我应该接受那份工作邀请。

examples.en: The decision seemed right at the time, but in retrospect, it was a mistake.
examples.zh: 这个决定在当时看起来是正确的，但回想起来，这是一个错误。

examples.en: In retrospect, the signs of the economic downturn were clear, but we ignored them.
examples.zh: 回想起来，经济衰退的迹象很明显，但我们忽略了它们。

examples.en: Looking back in retrospect, those years were the happiest of my life.
examples.zh: 回想起来，那些年是我一生中最快乐的时光。

examples.en: The two teams engaged in a fierce competition for the championship title.
examples.zh: 两支队伍为争夺冠军头衔展开了激烈的竞争。

examples.en: She has a fierce determination to succeed, no matter the obstacles.
examples.zh: 她有着强烈的决心要成功，无论遇到什么障碍。

examples.en: The lion gave a fierce roar to warn other animals to stay away.
examples.zh: 狮子发出了一声凶猛的吼叫，警告其他动物远离。

examples.en: There was fierce debate in the parliament over the new policy proposal.
examples.zh: 议会就新政策提案展开了激烈的辩论。

examples.en: He suffered a drug overdose and was rushed to the hospital.
examples.zh: 他因药物过量被紧急送往医院。

examples.en: The documentary warns about the dangers of opioid overdose.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片警示了阿片类药物过量的危险。

examples.en: She accidentally took an overdose of sleeping pills.
examples.zh: 她不小心服用了过量的安眠药。

examples.en: Overdose prevention programs are crucial in public health.
examples.zh: 过量预防项目在公共卫生中至关重要。

examples.en: Water boils at 100 degrees centigrade at sea level.
examples.zh: 在海平面，水在100摄氏度沸腾。

examples.en: The temperature dropped to minus 10 centigrade overnight.
examples.zh: 温度一夜之间降到了零下10摄氏度。

examples.en: Most countries use the centigrade scale for weather reports.
examples.zh: 大多数国家在天气预报中使用摄氏度。

examples.en: Set the oven to 180 degrees centigrade for baking.
examples.zh: 将烤箱设置为180摄氏度进行烘烤。

examples.en: The Russian Federation is the largest country in the world.
examples.zh: 俄罗斯联邦是世界上最大的国家。

examples.en: The sports federation organized the international tournament.
examples.zh: 体育联合会组织了这次国际锦标赛。

examples.en: A federation of states often has a central government.
examples.zh: 联邦制国家通常有一个中央政府。

examples.en: The labor federation negotiated better wages for workers.
examples.zh: 劳工联合会为工人谈判争取了更好的工资。

examples.en: The business venture turned out to be profitless after a year.
examples.zh: 这项商业投资一年后证明是无利可图的。

examples.en: He realized his efforts were profitless and decided to quit.
examples.zh: 他意识到自己的努力徒劳无功，决定放弃。

examples.en: The profitless enterprise was eventually shut down.
examples.zh: 这家无利可图的企业最终被关闭了。

examples.en: She found the argument profitless and changed the topic.
examples.zh: 她觉得争论毫无意义，于是改变了话题。

examples.en: The factory emits harmful gases into the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 这家工厂向大气排放有害气体。

examples.en: The radio tower emits signals for communication.
examples.zh: 无线电塔发射信号用于通信。

examples.en: Fireflies emit light to attract mates at night.
examples.zh: 萤火虫在夜间发光以吸引配偶。

examples.en: The device emits a beeping sound when the battery is low.
examples.zh: 当电池电量低时，设备会发出哔哔声。

examples.en: I need to pay the rent by the end of the month.
examples.zh: 我需要在月底前支付租金。

examples.en: Hard work will pay off in the long run.
examples.zh: 从长远来看，努力工作会有回报。

examples.en: She pays close attention to details in her work.
examples.zh: 她在工作中非常注重细节。

examples.en: The company pays its employees every two weeks.
examples.zh: 公司每两周给员工发一次工资。

examples.en: The crowd began to murmur as the speaker delayed.
examples.zh: 当演讲者延迟时，人群开始低声议论。

examples.en: She murmured a prayer before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 她在睡前低声祈祷。

examples.en: A gentle murmur of the stream could be heard in the distance.
examples.zh: 远处可以听到溪流的轻柔潺潺声。

examples.en: He murmured his apologies and left the room quietly.
examples.zh: 他低声道歉，然后悄悄离开了房间。

examples.en: The blue car is ours, and the red one is theirs.
examples.zh: 蓝色的车是我们的，红色的车是他们的。

examples.en: They claimed the victory as theirs after the match.
examples.zh: 比赛后，他们声称胜利属于他们。

examples.en: The responsibility is theirs to complete the project on time.
examples.zh: 按时完成项目的责任在于他们。

examples.en: The house with the garden is theirs, not ours.
examples.zh: 带花园的房子是他们的，不是我们的。

examples.en: He tried to ease the tension in the room with a joke.
examples.zh: 他试图用一个笑话缓解房间里的紧张气氛。

examples.en: The medicine helped ease her pain quickly.
examples.zh: 药物帮助她迅速缓解了疼痛。

examples.en: She completed the task with great ease and confidence.
examples.zh: 她以极大的轻松和自信完成了任务。

examples.en: The government implemented policies to ease economic pressure.
examples.zh: 政府实施了政策以缓解经济压力。

examples.en: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory while driving in this country.
examples.zh: 在这个国家，开车时系安全带是强制性的。

examples.en: Attendance at the safety training session is mandatory for all employees.
examples.zh: 所有员工都必须参加安全培训课程。

examples.en: The new law makes recycling mandatory in urban areas.
examples.zh: 新法律规定城市地区必须进行回收。

examples.en: A mandatory quarantine was imposed on travelers from high-risk regions.
examples.zh: 对来自高风险地区的旅行者实施了强制隔离。

examples.en: The horror movie was so frightening that I couldn't sleep all night.
examples.zh: 那部恐怖电影太吓人了，我一整晚都睡不着。

examples.en: The sudden loud noise was frightening to the small child.
examples.zh: 突然的巨响让那个小孩感到害怕。

examples.en: The thought of losing her job was a frightening prospect.
examples.zh: 想到可能失业，这是一个令人恐惧的前景。

examples.en: The storm created a frightening scene with lightning and thunder.
examples.zh: 暴风雨带来了闪电和雷鸣，制造了令人惊恐的景象。

examples.en: He wore shorts and a t-shirt to the beach.
examples.zh: 他穿着短裤和T恤去海滩。

examples.en: In summer, many people prefer to wear shorts for comfort.
examples.zh: 夏天，很多人喜欢穿短裤以求舒适。

examples.en: The basketball players wore shorts during the game.
examples.zh: 篮球运动员在比赛中穿着短裤。

examples.en: She bought a new pair of denim shorts for the trip.
examples.zh: 她为这次旅行买了一条新的牛仔短裤。

examples.en: The government decided to ban smoking in public places.
examples.zh: 政府决定在公共场所禁止吸烟。

examples.en: The school has a ban on using mobile phones during classes.
examples.zh: 学校禁止在上课时使用手机。

examples.en: They imposed a ban on plastic bags to reduce pollution.
examples.zh: 他们实施塑料袋禁令以减少污染。

examples.en: The company lifted the ban on casual dress on Fridays.
examples.zh: 公司解除了周五穿便装的禁令。

examples.en: The schism in the church led to the formation of two separate groups.
examples.zh: 教会的分裂导致形成了两个独立的团体。

examples.en: A schism occurred within the political party over policy differences.
examples.zh: 由于政策分歧，政党内部发生了分裂。

examples.en: The schism between the two leaders caused tension in the organization.
examples.zh: 两位领导人之间的分裂导致组织内关系紧张。

examples.en: Historians study the Great Schism that divided Christianity.
examples.zh: 历史学家研究导致基督教分裂的大分裂事件。

examples.en: She used an eraser to correct the mistake in her drawing.
examples.zh: 她用橡皮擦纠正了画中的错误。

examples.en: The teacher handed out pencils and erasers to the students.
examples.zh: 老师向学生分发铅笔和橡皮擦。

examples.en: He bought a new eraser because the old one was worn out.
examples.zh: 他买了一个新橡皮擦，因为旧的已经用坏了。

examples.en: The whiteboard eraser was used to clean the board after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议后用白板擦清洁了白板。

examples.en: I skimmed through the report to get the main points quickly.
examples.zh: 我快速浏览了报告以获取要点。

examples.en: She skimmed the cream off the top of the milk.
examples.zh: 她从牛奶表面撇去了奶油。

examples.en: He skimmed the stones across the surface of the lake.
examples.zh: 他让石头在水面上打水漂。

examples.en: The boat skimmed over the water at high speed.
examples.zh: 小船高速掠过水面。

examples.en: Many families gather for dinner on holidays.
examples.zh: 许多家庭在节假日聚在一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: The school event was open to all families in the community.
examples.zh: 学校活动向社区所有家庭开放。

examples.en: They come from large families with many siblings.
examples.zh: 他们来自有很多兄弟姐妹的大家庭。

examples.en: The government provides support for low-income families.
examples.zh: 政府为低收入家庭提供支持。

examples.en: The hostages were held captive for several days.
examples.zh: 人质被囚禁了好几天。

examples.en: The zoo has a captive audience for its animal shows.
examples.zh: 动物园的动物表演有固定的观众。

examples.en: He felt like a captive in his own home during the lockdown.
examples.zh: 在封锁期间，他感觉像被囚禁在自己家里。

examples.en: The company has a captive market for its unique product.
examples.zh: 这家公司为其独特产品拥有一个垄断市场。

examples.en: The news report was a welter of conflicting information.
examples.zh: 新闻报道是一堆相互矛盾的信息。

examples.en: After the storm, the streets were in a welter of debris.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，街道上一片狼藉。

examples.en: His mind was in a welter of confusion after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后，他的头脑一片混乱。

examples.en: The debate descended into a welter of accusations and counter-accusations.
examples.zh: 辩论陷入了一连串的指责和反指责。

examples.en: The sun scorched the grass during the heatwave.
examples.zh: 热浪期间，太阳晒焦了草地。

examples.en: She accidentally scorched the shirt while ironing.
examples.zh: 她熨衣服时不小心把衬衫烫焦了。

examples.en: The fire scorched the walls of the building.
examples.zh: 大火烧焦了建筑物的墙壁。

examples.en: The desert heat can scorch anything left in the open.
examples.zh: 沙漠的高温可以烤焦任何暴露在外的物体。

examples.en: The movie kept us in suspense until the very end.
examples.zh: 这部电影让我们一直悬着心直到最后一刻。

examples.en: He waited in suspense for the exam results.
examples.zh: 他忐忑不安地等待着考试成绩。

examples.en: The suspense was killing her as she anticipated the news.
examples.zh: 等待消息的悬念让她备受煎熬。

examples.en: The author masterfully builds suspense throughout the novel.
examples.zh: 作者在整部小说中巧妙地营造了悬念。

examples.en: Government agencies are responsible for public safety.
examples.zh: 政府机构负责公共安全。

examples.en: She works for one of the top advertising agencies in the city.
examples.zh: 她在该市一家顶尖的广告公司工作。

examples.en: International aid agencies provide relief during disasters.
examples.zh: 国际援助机构在灾难期间提供救济。

examples.en: The travel agency helped us book our vacation package.
examples.zh: 旅行社帮我们预订了度假套餐。

examples.en: She finished in sixth place in the race.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中获得了第六名。

examples.en: The sixth sense is often referred to as intuition.
examples.zh: 第六感通常被称为直觉。

examples.en: He lives on the sixth floor of the apartment building.
examples.zh: 他住在公寓楼的第六层。

examples.en: The sixth amendment guarantees the right to a speedy trial.
examples.zh: 第六修正案保障了快速审判的权利。

examples.en: He is a nonesuch when it comes to playing the piano.
examples.zh: 在弹钢琴方面，他是无与伦比的。

examples.en: The chef created a nonesuch dish that amazed everyone.
examples.zh: 厨师做了一道无与伦比的菜肴，让所有人都惊叹不已。

examples.en: Her talent is a nonesuch in the world of art.
examples.zh: 她的才华在艺术界是独一无二的。

examples.en: This antique is a nonesuch, with no equal in craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 这件古董是无与伦比的，工艺上无可匹敌。

examples.en: Inasmuch as you have apologized, I will forgive you.
examples.zh: 既然你已经道歉了，我会原谅你。

examples.en: He succeeded inasmuch as he never gave up.
examples.zh: 他之所以成功，是因为他从未放弃。

examples.en: Inasmuch as the weather is bad, we should postpone the trip.
examples.zh: 鉴于天气不好，我们应该推迟旅行。

examples.en: She is qualified inasmuch as she has the necessary experience.
examples.zh: 她是有资格的，因为她具备必要的经验。

examples.en: He pulled the strings behind the scenes to get the deal done.
examples.zh: 他在幕后操纵，促成了这笔交易。

examples.en: The guitar has six strings.
examples.zh: 这把吉他有六根弦。

examples.en: There are no strings attached to this offer.
examples.zh: 这个提议没有任何附加条件。

examples.en: She tied the package with a piece of string.
examples.zh: 她用一根绳子把包裹绑了起来。

examples.en: From this vantage point, you can see the entire valley.
examples.zh: 从这个有利位置，你可以看到整个山谷。

examples.en: The hill provides a good vantage for observing wildlife.
examples.zh: 这座小山是观察野生动物的好地方。

examples.en: He had the vantage of insider information.
examples.zh: 他拥有内幕信息的优势。

examples.en: The camera was placed at a high vantage to capture the scene.
examples.zh: 摄像机被放置在一个高处，以捕捉场景。

examples.en: The soldiers unleashed a fusillade of bullets at the enemy.
examples.zh: 士兵们向敌人发射了一连串的子弹。

examples.en: A fusillade of questions followed his announcement.
examples.zh: 他的声明之后是一连串的问题。

examples.en: The protesters faced a fusillade of tear gas from the police.
examples.zh: 抗议者面临警方发射的一连串催泪瓦斯。

examples.en: The fusillade of criticism left him speechless.
examples.zh: 一连串的批评让他哑口无言。

examples.en: The security guards patrol the perimeter of the building.
examples.zh: 保安人员在大楼周边巡逻。

examples.en: They set up a fence around the perimeter of the property.
examples.zh: 他们在房产周围设置了一道围栏。

examples.en: The perimeter of the garden is 50 meters.
examples.zh: 花园的周长是50米。

examples.en: Police established a perimeter to contain the crowd.
examples.zh: 警方设立了一个警戒线来控制人群。

examples.en: The music built to a powerful crescendo.
examples.zh: 音乐逐渐增强到一个强有力的高潮。

examples.en: The protests reached a crescendo last night.
examples.zh: 抗议活动昨晚达到了高潮。

examples.en: Her voice rose in a crescendo of emotion.
examples.zh: 她的声音在情感的渐强中升高。

examples.en: The argument ended with a crescendo of shouting.
examples.zh: 争论以一阵大喊大叫的高潮结束。

examples.en: The price of gasoline has increased significantly this month.
examples.zh: 这个月汽油的价格大幅上涨了。

examples.en: They are willing to pay any price to achieve their goal.
examples.zh: 他们愿意付出任何代价来实现目标。

examples.en: What's the price tag on that luxury watch?
examples.zh: 那块豪华手表的价格标签是多少？

examples.en: The high price of housing is a major concern for young people.
examples.zh: 高昂的房价是年轻人的主要担忧。

examples.en: There is a good restaurant nearby that we can try.
examples.zh: 附近有一家不错的餐厅我们可以去试试。

examples.en: She lives in a nearby village, just a short drive away.
examples.zh: 她住在附近的一个村庄，开车很快就到。

examples.en: The police searched the nearby area for clues.
examples.zh: 警察在附近区域搜寻线索。

examples.en: We decided to stay at a hotel nearby the airport for convenience.
examples.zh: 为了方便，我们决定住在机场附近的一家酒店。

examples.en: His nonconformity to social norms made him stand out in the crowd.
examples.zh: 他对社会规范的不顺从使他在人群中脱颖而出。

examples.en: The company was fined for nonconformity with safety regulations.
examples.zh: 该公司因不符合安全规定而被罚款。

examples.en: Her artistic style is a celebration of nonconformity and individuality.
examples.zh: 她的艺术风格是对不墨守成规和个性的颂扬。

examples.en: The audit revealed several nonconformities in the production process.
examples.zh: 审计揭示了生产过程中的几处不符合项。

examples.en: The tribal elders gathered to discuss important community matters.
examples.zh: 部落长老们聚集在一起讨论重要的社区事务。

examples.en: She has a deep interest in tribal cultures and traditions.
examples.zh: 她对部落文化和传统有着浓厚的兴趣。

examples.en: The tribal markings on his face signify his status within the group.
examples.zh: 他脸上的部落标记象征着他在群体中的地位。

examples.en: Tribal conflicts in the region have led to widespread displacement.
examples.zh: 该地区的部落冲突导致了广泛的流离失所。

examples.en: The pestilential swamp was avoided by all the villagers.
examples.zh: 所有村民都避开了那个瘟疫般的沼泽地。

examples.en: During the Middle Ages, pestilential diseases like the plague were common.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，像瘟疫这样的传染病很常见。

examples.en: The pestilential odor from the garbage dump was unbearable.
examples.zh: 垃圾堆散发出的有害气味令人难以忍受。

examples.en: He described the corrupt government as a pestilential influence on society.
examples.zh: 他将腐败的政府描述为对社会的一种有害影响。

examples.en: The detective found a crucial clue at the crime scene.
examples.zh: 侦探在犯罪现场发现了一个关键线索。

examples.en: I have no clue what you're talking about; please explain further.
examples.zh: 我完全不知道你在说什么；请进一步解释。

examples.en: She gave me a clue to solve the puzzle by hinting at the answer.
examples.zh: 她通过暗示答案给了我一个解决谜题的线索。

examples.en: The old map provided a clue to the location of the hidden treasure.
examples.zh: 这张旧地图为隐藏宝藏的位置提供了线索。

examples.en: The company uses proprietary software to protect its trade secrets.
examples.zh: 该公司使用专有软件来保护其商业机密。

examples.en: He holds a proprietary interest in several patents for his inventions.
examples.zh: 他对自己的几项发明拥有专有权益。

examples.en: The proprietary blend of herbs is a key ingredient in their health supplement.
examples.zh: 这种专有的草药混合物是他们保健品的关键成分。

examples.en: As the owner, she has proprietary rights over all the assets of the business.
examples.zh: 作为所有者，她对企业的所有资产拥有所有权。

examples.en: She took a moment to admire her beautiful natural surroundings.
examples.zh: 她花了一点时间欣赏周围美丽的自然环境。

examples.en: The children were warned to be aware of their surroundings in the crowded market.
examples.zh: 孩子们被警告在拥挤的市场中要注意周围环境。

examples.en: He felt uncomfortable in his new surroundings and missed home.
examples.zh: 他在新环境中感到不适，想念家乡。

examples.en: The hotel is located in peaceful surroundings, perfect for a relaxing vacation.
examples.zh: 这家酒店位于宁静的环境中，非常适合放松度假。

examples.en: The misshapen fruit was discarded by the farmer as unsellable.
examples.zh: 那个畸形的水果被农民丢弃了，因为它无法出售。

examples.en: After the accident, his leg healed in a misshapen way, causing him pain.
examples.zh: 事故后，他的腿愈合得畸形，导致他疼痛。

examples.en: The artist created a sculpture of a misshapen figure to represent imperfection.
examples.zh: 艺术家创作了一个畸形人物的雕塑来代表不完美。

examples.en: The old tree had a misshapen trunk due to years of harsh weather.
examples.zh: 由于多年的恶劣天气，那棵老树的树干畸形了。

examples.en: The news of the impending storm caused widespread hysteria among the residents.
examples.zh: 即将来临的暴风雨消息在居民中引起了广泛的歇斯底里。

examples.en: During the concert, the fans were in a state of hysteria, screaming and crying.
examples.zh: 在音乐会期间，粉丝们处于歇斯底里的状态，尖叫和哭泣。

examples.en: The media's sensational reporting often fuels public hysteria over minor issues.
examples.zh: 媒体的耸人听闻报道常常助长公众对小问题的歇斯底里。

examples.en: In the 19th century, hysteria was a common diagnosis for women with unexplained symptoms.
examples.zh: 在19世纪，歇斯底里是对有不明症状女性的常见诊断。

examples.en: The onus is on the company to prove the product's safety.
examples.zh: 证明产品安全的责任在于公司。

examples.en: He felt the onus of making the final decision.
examples.zh: 他感到做出最终决定的重担。

examples.en: The onus of proof lies with the accuser.
examples.zh: 举证责任在于原告。

examples.en: There's an onus on parents to teach their children manners.
examples.zh: 父母有责任教导孩子礼仪。

examples.en: The weather is very humid today, making it feel hotter.
examples.zh: 今天天气很潮湿，让人感觉更热。

examples.en: Tropical regions are often humid and rainy.
examples.zh: 热带地区通常潮湿多雨。

examples.en: She used a dehumidifier to reduce the humid air in the basement.
examples.zh: 她使用除湿机来降低地下室的潮湿空气。

examples.en: Humid conditions can cause mold to grow quickly.
examples.zh: 潮湿的环境会导致霉菌快速生长。

examples.en: The main entrance to the building is on the north side.
examples.zh: 大楼的主入口在北侧。

examples.en: Her beautiful singing voice captivated the audience's entrance.
examples.zh: 她美妙的歌声让观众着迷。

examples.en: He made a dramatic entrance at the party, arriving late.
examples.zh: 他在派对上戏剧性地迟到入场。

examples.en: The entrance fee for the museum is $10 per person.
examples.zh: 博物馆的入场费是每人10美元。

examples.en: Be careful when using the pedestrian crossing.
examples.zh: 使用人行横道时要小心。

examples.en: The ship made a smooth crossing of the Atlantic Ocean.
examples.zh: 这艘船顺利横渡了大西洋。

examples.en: There's a railway crossing ahead, so slow down.
examples.zh: 前面有铁路道口，请减速。

examples.en: The crossing of different cultures can lead to new ideas.
examples.zh: 不同文化的交融可以催生新思想。

examples.en: He believed it was his destiny to become a great leader.
examples.zh: 他相信成为伟大领袖是他的命运。

examples.en: The movie explores themes of fate and destiny.
examples.zh: 这部电影探讨了命运和宿命的主题。

examples.en: She felt that meeting him was written in her destiny.
examples.zh: 她觉得遇见他是命中注定的。

examples.en: We shape our own destiny through our choices.
examples.zh: 我们通过选择塑造自己的命运。

examples.en: The team's domination in the league was undeniable.
examples.zh: 这支球队在联赛中的统治地位无可否认。

examples.en: He sought domination over his competitors in the market.
examples.zh: 他寻求在市场上对竞争对手的支配。

examples.en: The country's military domination was challenged by rebels.
examples.zh: 该国的军事统治受到了叛军的挑战。

examples.en: Cultural domination can lead to the loss of local traditions.
examples.zh: 文化支配可能导致当地传统的丧失。

examples.en: Petrology is the study of rocks and their formation.
examples.zh: 岩石学是研究岩石及其形成的学科。

examples.en: She specialized in petrology during her geology degree.
examples.zh: 她在攻读地质学学位期间专攻岩石学。

examples.en: Petrology helps us understand Earth's geological history.
examples.zh: 岩石学帮助我们理解地球的地质历史。

examples.en: Advances in petrology have improved mineral exploration.
examples.zh: 岩石学的进步促进了矿产勘探。

examples.en: The leader denounced the violent acts as unacceptable.
examples.zh: 领导人谴责暴力行为是不可接受的。

examples.en: She publicly denounced the corrupt practices in the government.
examples.zh: 她公开谴责政府中的腐败行为。

examples.en: Many countries denounced the treaty as unfair.
examples.zh: 许多国家谴责该条约不公平。

examples.en: He was denounced by his colleagues for his unethical behavior.
examples.zh: 他因不道德行为被同事谴责。

examples.en: The group consisted of disparate individuals with different backgrounds.
examples.zh: 这个团体由背景各异的个体组成。

examples.en: They tried to unite disparate factions within the organization.
examples.zh: 他们试图团结组织内不同的派系。

examples.en: The report highlighted disparate outcomes in education based on income.
examples.zh: 报告强调了基于收入的教育成果差异。

examples.en: His ideas seemed disparate at first, but later connected into a coherent theory.
examples.zh: 他的想法起初看似不相关，但后来连接成了一个连贯的理论。

examples.en: The sonorous voice of the narrator added depth to the story.
examples.zh: 叙述者洪亮的声音为故事增添了深度。

examples.en: The bell produced a deep, sonorous sound that echoed through the valley.
examples.zh: 钟声发出深沉洪亮的声音，在山谷中回荡。

examples.en: He spoke in a sonorous tone that commanded attention.
examples.zh: 他以洪亮的语调说话，引人注目。

examples.en: The sonorous music filled the concert hall with rich vibrations.
examples.zh: 洪亮的音乐用丰富的振动充满了音乐厅。

examples.en: The farmer stored enough provender in the barn to feed his livestock through the winter.
examples.zh: 农民在谷仓里储存了足够的饲料，以便在冬天喂养他的牲畜。

examples.en: In medieval times, provender was a crucial resource for armies on the move.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，饲料是行军军队的关键资源。

examples.en: The stable hand ensured the horses had fresh provender every morning.
examples.zh: 马夫确保每天早上马匹都有新鲜的饲料。

examples.en: Provender for poultry often includes grains like corn and wheat.
examples.zh: 家禽的饲料通常包括玉米和小麦等谷物。

examples.en: She applied a clean bandage to the cut on her finger to prevent infection.
examples.zh: 她在手指的伤口上贴了一块干净的绷带，以防感染。

examples.en: After the surgery, the doctor wrapped his arm in a tight bandage.
examples.zh: 手术后，医生用绷带紧紧包扎了他的手臂。

examples.en: First aid kits should always include sterile bandages for emergencies.
examples.zh: 急救箱应始终备有无菌绷带，以备紧急情况使用。

examples.en: He removed the old bandage and replaced it with a new one to keep the wound clean.
examples.zh: 他取下旧绷带，换上新绷带以保持伤口清洁。

examples.en: The new government policy provided the impetus for economic growth in the region.
examples.zh: 新政府政策为该地区的经济增长提供了动力。

examples.en: Her success in the competition gave her the impetus to pursue a career in music.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中的成功给了她追求音乐事业的动力。

examples.en: The discovery of oil served as a major impetus for the town's development.
examples.zh: 石油的发现成为该镇发展的主要推动力。

examples.en: Environmental concerns have been the impetus behind many recent technological innovations.
examples.zh: 环境问题一直是许多近期技术创新的推动力。

examples.en: The evidence presented in court was undisputable, leading to a quick verdict.
examples.zh: 法庭上出示的证据无可争议，导致迅速作出裁决。

examples.en: Her talent as a pianist is undisputable, as shown by her numerous awards.
examples.zh: 她作为钢琴家的才华无可争议，这从她获得的众多奖项中可见一斑。

examples.en: It is an undisputable fact that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
examples.zh: 地球围绕太阳转是一个无可争议的事实。

examples.en: The company's success in the market is undisputable, with profits doubling each year.
examples.zh: 该公司在市场上的成功无可争议，利润每年翻倍。

examples.en: She studied dietetics in college to become a registered nutritionist.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习营养学，以成为一名注册营养师。

examples.en: Dietetics involves the science of food and its impact on health and disease.
examples.zh: 营养学涉及食物科学及其对健康和疾病的影响。

examples.en: Hospitals often employ dietetics professionals to plan meals for patients with specific needs.
examples.zh: 医院经常聘请营养学专业人士为有特殊需求的患者规划饮食。

examples.en: The principles of dietetics are essential for managing conditions like diabetes and obesity.
examples.zh: 营养学原理对于管理糖尿病和肥胖等疾病至关重要。

examples.en: International cooperation is vital for addressing global issues like climate change.
examples.zh: 国际合作对于应对气候变化等全球问题至关重要。

examples.en: The project succeeded due to the excellent cooperation between the two teams.
examples.zh: 由于两个团队之间的出色合作，该项目取得了成功。

examples.en: Parents and teachers need to work in cooperation to support children's education.
examples.zh: 家长和老师需要合作以支持孩子的教育。

examples.en: The police asked for the public's cooperation in reporting any suspicious activities.
examples.zh: 警方请求公众合作，报告任何可疑活动。

examples.en: He works as an adjunct professor at the university, teaching one course per semester.
examples.zh: 他在大学担任兼职教授，每学期教授一门课程。

examples.en: The new software is a useful adjunct to our existing data analysis tools.
examples.zh: 新软件是我们现有数据分析工具的有用辅助。

examples.en: In grammar, an adjunct is a word or phrase that adds extra information to a sentence.
examples.zh: 在语法中，附加语是向句子添加额外信息的词或短语。

examples.en: She used meditation as an adjunct to her therapy for stress relief.
examples.zh: 她将冥想作为缓解压力的疗法的辅助手段。

examples.en: The artist used a chromatic palette of vibrant colors to create a lively painting.
examples.zh: 艺术家使用鲜艳的色彩调色板创作了一幅生动的画作。

examples.en: In music, a chromatic scale includes all twelve notes within an octave.
examples.zh: 在音乐中，半音阶包括一个八度内的所有十二个音符。

examples.en: The chromatic aberration in the lens caused the edges of the photo to appear blurry.
examples.zh: 镜头中的色差导致照片边缘显得模糊。

examples.en: Her dress featured a chromatic pattern that shifted from blue to green in the light.
examples.zh: 她的连衣裙带有一种在光线下从蓝色变为绿色的色彩图案。

examples.en: He went crazy with excitement when he won the lottery.
examples.zh: 他中彩票时兴奋得发狂。

examples.en: It's crazy how fast technology is advancing these days.
examples.zh: 如今技术进步的速度真是疯狂。

examples.en: She has a crazy idea to start a business selling homemade cookies online.
examples.zh: 她有一个疯狂的想法，想在网上销售自制饼干创业。

examples.en: The traffic was crazy during rush hour, with cars barely moving.
examples.zh: 高峰时段的交通状况很疯狂，车辆几乎无法移动。

examples.en: The senator faced censure from his colleagues for his unethical behavior.
examples.zh: 这位参议员因其不道德行为面临同事的谴责。

examples.en: The media's censure of the government's policies led to widespread public debate.
examples.zh: 媒体对政府政策的谴责引发了广泛的公众辩论。

examples.en: He received official censure for violating the company's code of conduct.
examples.zh: 他因违反公司行为准则受到正式谴责。

examples.en: The committee voted to censure the member for his inappropriate comments.
examples.zh: 委员会投票谴责该成员的不当言论。

examples.en: The factory uses advanced machines to increase production efficiency.
examples.zh: 这家工厂使用先进的机器来提高生产效率。

examples.en: These vending machines are convenient for quick snacks.
examples.zh: 这些自动售货机方便购买快餐。

examples.en: He is fascinated by the inner workings of complex machines.
examples.zh: 他对复杂机器的内部运作着迷。

examples.en: The gym has various exercise machines for different workouts.
examples.zh: 健身房有各种锻炼机器用于不同的训练。

examples.en: His inspiring speech engendered a sense of hope among the audience.
examples.zh: 他鼓舞人心的演讲在听众中激发了一种希望感。

examples.en: The new policy may engender controversy in the community.
examples.zh: 新政策可能会在社区中引发争议。

examples.en: Kindness often engenders kindness in return.
examples.zh: 善意常常会换来善意。

examples.en: The economic crisis engendered widespread unemployment.
examples.zh: 经济危机导致了广泛的失业。

examples.en: He relaxed in his comfortable armchair after a long day.
examples.zh: 漫长的一天后，他舒服地躺在扶手椅上放松。

examples.en: She placed a decorative cushion on the armchair.
examples.zh: 她在扶手椅上放了一个装饰性的靠垫。

examples.en: The living room features a matching sofa and armchair set.
examples.zh: 客厅有一套配套的沙发和扶手椅。

examples.en: He offered the guest the armchair by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 他请客人坐在壁炉旁的扶手椅上。

examples.en: He wore a warm muffler around his neck in the cold weather.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的天气里，他脖子上围着一条温暖的围巾。

examples.en: The car's muffler reduces engine noise.
examples.zh: 汽车的消声器降低了发动机噪音。

examples.en: She knitted a colorful muffler as a gift for her friend.
examples.zh: 她织了一条色彩鲜艳的围巾作为礼物送给朋友。

examples.en: A faulty muffler can cause excessive exhaust noise.
examples.zh: 故障的消声器会导致排气噪音过大。

examples.en: The fan began to whir softly as it started spinning.
examples.zh: 风扇开始旋转时发出轻柔的嗡嗡声。

examples.en: You could hear the whir of the computer's hard drive.
examples.zh: 你可以听到电脑硬盘的嗡嗡声。

examples.en: The drone's propellers whirred loudly as it took off.
examples.zh: 无人机起飞时，螺旋桨发出响亮的嗡嗡声。

examples.en: The old refrigerator makes a constant whirring sound.
examples.zh: 旧冰箱不断发出嗡嗡声。

examples.en: Please listen carefully to the instructions before starting.
examples.zh: 开始前请仔细听说明。

examples.en: She likes to listen to music while studying.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在学习时听音乐。

examples.en: It's important to listen to feedback from customers.
examples.zh: 倾听客户的反馈很重要。

examples.en: He didn't listen to my advice and regretted it later.
examples.zh: 他没有听我的建议，后来后悔了。

examples.en: The document is attached to the email for your review.
examples.zh: 文件已附在电子邮件中供您审阅。

examples.en: She is deeply attached to her childhood home.
examples.zh: 她深深依恋着她的童年家园。

examples.en: Please find the attached file with more details.
examples.zh: 请查看附件以获取更多详情。

examples.en: The leash is attached to the dog's collar.
examples.zh: 皮带系在狗的项圈上。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful diamond brooch on her dress.
examples.zh: 她在连衣裙上别了一枚漂亮的钻石胸针。

examples.en: The antique brooch was passed down through generations.
examples.zh: 这枚古董胸针代代相传。

examples.en: He gave her a silver brooch as a birthday gift.
examples.zh: 他送给她一枚银胸针作为生日礼物。

examples.en: The brooch added an elegant touch to her outfit.
examples.zh: 胸针为她的着装增添了一丝优雅。

examples.en: Plug the charger into the electrical outlet.
examples.zh: 将充电器插入电源插座。

examples.en: The factory has an outlet store selling discounted products.
examples.zh: 这家工厂有一家直销店销售打折产品。

examples.en: Exercise can be a healthy outlet for stress.
examples.zh: 锻炼可以是缓解压力的健康途径。

examples.en: The river flows into an outlet that leads to the ocean.
examples.zh: 河流流入一个通往海洋的出水口。

examples.en: It was a needless argument that wasted everyone's time.
examples.zh: 这是一场不必要的争论，浪费了大家的时间。

examples.en: Needless to say, safety is our top priority.
examples.zh: 不用说，安全是我们的首要任务。

examples.en: He made a needless comment that offended others.
examples.zh: 他发表了一句不必要的评论，冒犯了他人。

examples.en: Avoiding needless expenses can help save money.
examples.zh: 避免不必要的开支有助于省钱。

examples.en: She has an analytical mind that excels at solving complex problems.
examples.zh: 她具有善于分析问题的头脑，擅长解决复杂问题。

examples.en: The report provides an analytical overview of market trends.
examples.zh: 这份报告提供了对市场趋势的分析性概述。

examples.en: His analytical approach to the data revealed hidden patterns.
examples.zh: 他对数据采用的分析方法揭示了隐藏的模式。

examples.en: The course teaches analytical thinking skills.
examples.zh: 这门课程教授分析性思维技能。

examples.en: The narrow hallway felt constricted and claustrophobic.
examples.zh: 狭窄的走廊让人感到局促和幽闭恐惧。

examples.en: His breathing became constricted during the asthma attack.
examples.zh: 哮喘发作时，他的呼吸变得困难。

examples.en: The tight budget constricted our spending options.
examples.zh: 紧张的预算限制了我们的支出选择。

examples.en: She felt constricted by the rigid rules of the organization.
examples.zh: 她感到被组织的严格规则所束缚。

examples.en: You should insure your car against theft and accidents.
examples.zh: 你应该为你的汽车投保防盗和事故险。

examples.en: The company insures its employees with health insurance.
examples.zh: 公司为员工提供健康保险。

examples.en: To insure success, we need to plan carefully.
examples.zh: 为确保成功，我们需要仔细规划。

examples.en: He insured the package for its full value before shipping.
examples.zh: 他在寄送前为包裹投保了全额价值。

examples.en: We decided to broil the steaks instead of grilling them.
examples.zh: 我们决定用烤炉烤牛排，而不是用烧烤架。

examples.en: The sun broiled the desert sand to an unbearable temperature.
examples.zh: 太阳把沙漠的沙子烤得温度高得难以忍受。

examples.en: They broiled the fish with lemon and herbs.
examples.zh: 他们用柠檬和香草烤鱼。

examples.en: The political debate broiled into a heated argument.
examples.zh: 政治辩论演变成了一场激烈的争吵。

examples.en: The scandal made headlines across the country.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻登上了全国各地的头条新闻。

examples.en: The newspaper's headline announced the election results.
examples.zh: 报纸的头条宣布了选举结果。

examples.en: She will headline the music festival this summer.
examples.zh: 她将在今年夏天的音乐节上担任头条表演者。

examples.en: The article's headline was misleading and sensational.
examples.zh: 这篇文章的标题具有误导性和煽动性。

examples.en: The helicopter hovered above the building before landing.
examples.zh: 直升机在建筑物上方盘旋，然后降落。

examples.en: She hovered near the door, unsure whether to enter.
examples.zh: 她在门附近徘徊，不确定是否要进去。

examples.en: The temperature hovers around 20 degrees Celsius in spring.
examples.zh: 春季气温徘徊在20摄氏度左右。

examples.en: The cursor hovered over the link before clicking.
examples.zh: 光标在链接上悬停，然后点击。

examples.en: The cottage had a homely feel with its cozy fireplace.
examples.zh: 小屋因其舒适的壁炉而有一种家的感觉。

examples.en: She was described as homely, with a plain but kind face.
examples.zh: 她被描述为相貌平平，但面容和善。

examples.en: The restaurant serves homely meals that remind me of home.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供家常菜，让我想起了家。

examples.en: Despite its homely appearance, the hotel was very comfortable.
examples.zh: 尽管外观朴素，这家酒店非常舒适。

examples.en: The thief purloined valuable documents from the office.
examples.zh: 小偷从办公室偷走了有价值的文件。

examples.en: He was accused of purloining company funds for personal use.
examples.zh: 他被指控盗用公司资金供个人使用。

examples.en: The spy purloined classified information from the embassy.
examples.zh: 间谍从大使馆窃取了机密信息。

examples.en: She purloined a few cookies from the jar when no one was looking.
examples.zh: 趁没人注意时，她从罐子里偷拿了几块饼干。

examples.en: The city hosts a music festival every summer.
examples.zh: 这座城市每年夏天都会举办音乐节。

examples.en: We celebrated the Spring Festival with family and friends.
examples.zh: 我们与家人和朋友一起庆祝春节。

examples.en: The film festival showcases independent movies from around the world.
examples.zh: 电影节展示来自世界各地的独立电影。

examples.en: The harvest festival is a time of thanksgiving and feasting.
examples.zh: 丰收节是感恩和盛宴的时刻。

examples.en: She celebrated her seventieth birthday with a big party.
examples.zh: 她举办了一场盛大的派对庆祝七十岁生日。

examples.en: The temperature reached seventy degrees Fahrenheit today.
examples.zh: 今天气温达到了华氏七十度。

examples.en: He scored seventy points in the basketball game.
examples.zh: 他在篮球比赛中得了七十分。

examples.en: The book has seventy chapters in total.
examples.zh: 这本书总共有七十章。

examples.en: The new project is challenging but rewarding.
examples.zh: 这个新项目很有挑战性，但也很有回报。

examples.en: She finds teaching young children challenging.
examples.zh: 她觉得教小孩子很有挑战性。

examples.en: It's challenging to learn a new language as an adult.
examples.zh: 成年人学习一门新语言很有挑战性。

examples.en: The mountain climb was physically challenging.
examples.zh: 这次爬山对身体很有挑战性。

examples.en: The teacher-student ratio in this school is 1:20.
examples.zh: 这所学校的师生比例是1:20。

examples.en: The ratio of men to women in the company is about equal.
examples.zh: 公司里男女比例大致相等。

examples.en: They mixed the ingredients in a 2:1 ratio.
examples.zh: 他们以2:1的比例混合了这些成分。

examples.en: The debt-to-income ratio is important for loan approval.
examples.zh: 债务收入比对贷款审批很重要。

examples.en: He was ineligible for the scholarship due to his age.
examples.zh: 由于年龄原因，他没有资格获得这项奖学金。

examples.en: Players who fail the drug test are ineligible to compete.
examples.zh: 药检不合格的运动员没有资格参赛。

examples.en: The candidate was declared ineligible for the position.
examples.zh: 这位候选人被宣布没有资格担任这个职位。

examples.en: Students with low grades are ineligible for the honor roll.
examples.zh: 成绩低的学生没有资格进入荣誉榜。

examples.en: There are many restaurants around the corner.
examples.zh: 拐角处有很多餐馆。

examples.en: The meeting will start around 3 PM.
examples.zh: 会议将在下午3点左右开始。

examples.en: She looked around the room for her keys.
examples.zh: 她在房间里四处寻找她的钥匙。

examples.en: We need to work around the schedule conflict.
examples.zh: 我们需要解决日程冲突的问题。

examples.en: The school will equip each classroom with new computers.
examples.zh: 学校将为每个教室配备新电脑。

examples.en: He equipped himself with the necessary tools for the job.
examples.zh: 他为自己配备了工作所需的工具。

examples.en: The training will equip you with valuable skills.
examples.zh: 这次培训将为你提供宝贵的技能。

examples.en: The soldiers were equipped with modern weapons.
examples.zh: 士兵们配备了现代化武器。

examples.en: They plan to renovate the old house next year.
examples.zh: 他们计划明年翻新这栋老房子。

examples.en: The museum is closed for renovation.
examples.zh: 博物馆因翻修而关闭。

examples.en: We need to renovate the kitchen to make it more functional.
examples.zh: 我们需要翻新厨房，使其更实用。

examples.en: The company renovated its office to improve the work environment.
examples.zh: 公司翻新了办公室以改善工作环境。

examples.en: The article defamed the politician's reputation.
examples.zh: 这篇文章诽谤了这位政治家的声誉。

examples.en: He sued the newspaper for defaming his character.
examples.zh: 他起诉这家报纸诽谤他的人格。

examples.en: Spreading false rumors can defame someone's good name.
examples.zh: 散布虚假谣言可能会诽谤某人的好名声。

examples.en: The company was accused of defaming its competitor.
examples.zh: 这家公司被指控诽谤其竞争对手。

examples.en: The callow youth made many mistakes due to inexperience.
examples.zh: 这个幼稚的年轻人由于缺乏经验犯了很多错误。

examples.en: His callow behavior showed his lack of maturity.
examples.zh: 他幼稚的行为显示出他缺乏成熟。

examples.en: She was callow when she first started her career.
examples.zh: 她刚开始职业生涯时还很幼稚。

examples.en: The callow recruit needed more training.
examples.zh: 这个幼稚的新兵需要更多训练。

examples.en: The company is in a state of flux due to recent changes.
examples.zh: 由于最近的变化，公司处于不断变化的状态。

examples.en: The political situation is in flux after the election.
examples.zh: 选举后，政治局势处于不断变化中。

examples.en: Technology is always in flux, with new developments constantly emerging.
examples.zh: 技术总是在不断变化，新的发展不断涌现。

examples.en: Her career plans are in flux as she explores different options.
examples.zh: 她的职业计划在不断变化，因为她正在探索不同的选择。

examples.en: The dish is a delicious combination of sweet and sour flavors.
examples.zh: 这道菜是酸甜口味的完美结合。

examples.en: A combination of hard work and talent led to his success.
examples.zh: 努力和天赋的结合促成了他的成功。

examples.en: The safe requires a combination of numbers to open.
examples.zh: 这个保险箱需要一组数字组合才能打开。

examples.en: The team is a good combination of experienced and young players.
examples.zh: 这支队伍是经验丰富和年轻球员的良好组合。

examples.en: He showed great reverence for the ancient traditions of his ancestors.
examples.zh: 他对祖先的古老传统表现出极大的崇敬。

examples.en: The students bowed their heads in reverence during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 学生们在仪式中恭敬地低下头。

examples.en: She spoke of the artist with reverence, admiring his life's work.
examples.zh: 她怀着敬意谈论这位艺术家，钦佩他毕生的作品。

examples.en: In many cultures, elders are treated with reverence and respect.
examples.zh: 在许多文化中，长者受到崇敬和尊重。

examples.en: The secret to his longevity was a balanced diet and regular exercise.
examples.zh: 他长寿的秘诀是均衡饮食和定期锻炼。

examples.en: This company's longevity in the market is due to its innovative products.
examples.zh: 这家公司在市场上的长久存在归功于其创新产品。

examples.en: She wished her grandparents health and longevity on their anniversary.
examples.zh: 她在祖父母周年纪念日上祝愿他们健康长寿。

examples.en: The longevity of the ancient tree amazed all the visitors.
examples.zh: 这棵古树的寿命让所有游客惊叹不已。

examples.en: He was sentenced to three years in gaol for theft.
examples.zh: 他因盗窃罪被判处三年监禁。

examples.en: The old gaol has been converted into a museum.
examples.zh: 这座旧监狱已被改造成博物馆。

examples.en: She visited her brother in gaol every month.
examples.zh: 她每月去监狱探望她的兄弟。

examples.en: Escaping from gaol is considered a serious crime.
examples.zh: 越狱被视为一项严重罪行。

examples.en: The windmill on the hill has been generating electricity for decades.
examples.zh: 山上的风车几十年来一直在发电。

examples.en: Don Quixote famously attacked a windmill, mistaking it for a giant.
examples.zh: 堂吉诃德曾著名地攻击风车，误以为它是巨人。

examples.en: The old windmill is a popular tourist attraction in the countryside.
examples.zh: 这座古老的风车是乡村里一个受欢迎的旅游景点。

examples.en: They built a small windmill to pump water for their farm.
examples.zh: 他们建造了一个小风车来为农场抽水。

examples.en: The doctor checked the patient's pulse to assess his heart rate.
examples.zh: 医生检查了病人的脉搏以评估心率。

examples.en: She could feel the pulse of the city as she walked through the busy streets.
examples.zh: 当她走过繁忙的街道时，她能感受到这座城市的脉搏。

examples.en: The machine emits a pulse of light every second.
examples.zh: 这台机器每秒发射一次光脉冲。

examples.en: He kept his finger on the pulse of the latest technological trends.
examples.zh: 他密切关注最新技术趋势的动向。

examples.en: The cake is baking; in the meantime, let's prepare the frosting.
examples.zh: 蛋糕正在烘烤；与此同时，我们来准备糖霜。

examples.en: She will arrive in an hour; in the meantime, we can set up the room.
examples.zh: 她一小时后到达；在此期间，我们可以布置房间。

examples.en: He is studying for his exams; in the meantime, his friends are planning a party.
examples.zh: 他正在为考试学习；与此同时，他的朋友们在计划一个派对。

examples.en: The repair will take a week; in the meantime, we have to use a temporary solution.
examples.zh: 修理需要一周时间；在此期间，我们必须使用临时解决方案。

examples.en: She decided to delve deeper into the history of the ancient ruins.
examples.zh: 她决定更深入地探究这些古代遗址的历史。

examples.en: The researcher delved into the archives to find original documents.
examples.zh: 研究人员深入档案库寻找原始文件。

examples.en: He loves to delve into philosophical discussions with his friends.
examples.zh: 他喜欢与朋友们深入探讨哲学讨论。

examples.en: The book delves into the complexities of human emotions.
examples.zh: 这本书深入探讨了人类情感的复杂性。

examples.en: She went to the pharmacy to pick up her prescription medication.
examples.zh: 她去药房取她的处方药。

examples.en: The pharmacy is open 24 hours a day for emergencies.
examples.zh: 这家药房全天24小时开放以应对紧急情况。

examples.en: He studied pharmacy at university and now works as a pharmacist.
examples.zh: 他在大学学习药学，现在是一名药剂师。

examples.en: The pharmacy offers a wide range of over-the-counter drugs.
examples.zh: 这家药房提供多种非处方药。

examples.en: After playing in the mud, his clothes were completely dirty.
examples.zh: 在泥地里玩耍后，他的衣服完全脏了。

examples.en: She refused to eat from the dirty plate and asked for a clean one.
examples.zh: 她拒绝从脏盘子里吃东西，要求换一个干净的。

examples.en: He told a dirty joke that made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 他讲了一个下流的笑话，逗得大家都笑了。

examples.en: The politician was accused of playing dirty tricks during the campaign.
examples.zh: 这位政治家被指控在竞选期间耍肮脏手段。

examples.en: She wanted to go to the party; however, she had too much work to do.
examples.zh: 她想去参加派对；然而，她有太多工作要做。

examples.en: The plan seemed perfect; however, it failed due to unexpected circumstances.
examples.zh: 这个计划看起来完美；然而，由于意外情况而失败了。

examples.en: He is very talented; however, he lacks experience in this field.
examples.zh: 他非常有才华；然而，他在这个领域缺乏经验。

examples.en: The weather forecast predicted rain; however, it turned out to be sunny.
examples.zh: 天气预报预测有雨；然而，结果却是晴天。

examples.en: He dozed off during the boring lecture.
examples.zh: 他在无聊的讲座上打瞌睡。

examples.en: The cat dozed in the warm sunlight.
examples.zh: 猫在温暖的阳光下打盹。

examples.en: After lunch, I often doze for a few minutes.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我常常小睡几分钟。

examples.en: She was dozing when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 电话响时她正在打瞌睡。

examples.en: He is a mathematical savant with incredible calculation skills.
examples.zh: 他是一位数学天才，拥有惊人的计算能力。

examples.en: The savant could memorize entire books after reading them once.
examples.zh: 这位学者通读一遍后就能记住整本书的内容。

examples.en: She is considered a savant in the field of linguistics.
examples.zh: 她被公认为语言学领域的专家。

examples.en: The autistic savant displayed extraordinary artistic talent.
examples.zh: 这位自闭症天才展现出非凡的艺术天赋。

examples.en: You can deduct business expenses from your taxable income.
examples.zh: 你可以从应税收入中扣除业务费用。

examples.en: The teacher deducted points for spelling errors.
examples.zh: 老师因拼写错误扣分。

examples.en: From the evidence, we can deduct that he was present at the scene.
examples.zh: 从证据中，我们可以推断出他当时在场。

examples.en: Insurance premiums are deducted directly from my salary.
examples.zh: 保险费直接从我的工资中扣除。

examples.en: The apartment has three bedrooms and two bathroom units.
examples.zh: 这套公寓有三个卧室和两个卫生间单元。

examples.en: The basic unit of currency in Japan is the yen.
examples.zh: 日本的基本货币单位是日元。

examples.en: Each soldier is part of a larger military unit.
examples.zh: 每个士兵都是一个更大军事单位的一部分。

examples.en: The refrigerator comes with a built-in ice-making unit.
examples.zh: 这台冰箱配有内置制冰装置。

examples.en: The training aims to sensitize employees to cultural differences.
examples.zh: 这次培训旨在让员工对文化差异变得敏感。

examples.en: Exposure to sunlight can sensitize the skin to UV rays.
examples.zh: 暴露在阳光下会使皮肤对紫外线敏感。

examples.en: We need to sensitize the public to environmental issues.
examples.zh: 我们需要提高公众对环境问题的敏感度。

examples.en: The chemical sensitizes the material to heat.
examples.zh: 这种化学物质使材料对热敏感。

examples.en: Citizens will elect a new president next month.
examples.zh: 公民下个月将选举新总统。

examples.en: She was elected chairperson of the committee.
examples.zh: 她被选为委员会主席。

examples.en: He chose to elect early retirement.
examples.zh: 他选择提前退休。

examples.en: The board elected to proceed with the merger.
examples.zh: 董事会决定继续进行合并。

examples.en: The manager authorized the purchase of new equipment.
examples.zh: 经理批准购买新设备。

examples.en: You need a password to authorize access to the system.
examples.zh: 你需要密码来授权访问系统。

examples.en: The law authorizes police to search vehicles under certain conditions.
examples.zh: 法律授权警察在一定条件下搜查车辆。

examples.en: I am not authorized to make that decision.
examples.zh: 我无权做出那个决定。

examples.en: The team won the national championship last year.
examples.zh: 这支队伍去年赢得了全国冠军。

examples.en: She is competing in the world swimming championship.
examples.zh: 她正在参加世界游泳锦标赛。

examples.en: His championship of human rights is well-known.
examples.zh: 他对人权的捍卫是众所周知的。

examples.en: The championship game will be held next Sunday.
examples.zh: 冠军赛将在下周日举行。

examples.en: His handwriting is very sloppy and hard to read.
examples.zh: 他的笔迹非常潦草，难以辨认。

examples.en: The report was full of sloppy errors.
examples.zh: 这份报告充满了粗心的错误。

examples.en: She wore sloppy clothes while cleaning the house.
examples.zh: 她打扫房子时穿着邋遢的衣服。

examples.en: The weather turned sloppy with rain and mud.
examples.zh: 天气变得泥泞不堪，下着雨。

examples.en: To his chagrin, he failed the exam despite studying hard.
examples.zh: 令他懊恼的是，尽管努力学习，他还是考试不及格。

examples.en: She felt a sense of chagrin when her idea was rejected.
examples.zh: 当她的想法被拒绝时，她感到一阵懊恼。

examples.en: Much to my chagrin, I arrived late for the meeting.
examples.zh: 令我非常懊恼的是，我开会迟到了。

examples.en: His chagrin was evident when he lost the competition.
examples.zh: 当他输掉比赛时，他的懊恼显而易见。

examples.en: The conspiracy theory about the moon landing being faked has been debunked many times.
examples.zh: 关于登月是伪造的阴谋论已被多次驳斥。

examples.en: He was arrested for his involvement in a conspiracy to defraud the government.
examples.zh: 他因参与诈骗政府的阴谋而被捕。

examples.en: There's a conspiracy of silence among the employees regarding the workplace accident.
examples.zh: 员工们对工作场所事故保持沉默，形成了一种默契。

examples.en: The novel explores a dark conspiracy within the political elite.
examples.zh: 这部小说探讨了政治精英内部的一个黑暗阴谋。

examples.en: How did she react when she heard the surprising news?
examples.zh: 她听到这个令人惊讶的消息时反应如何？

examples.en: The chemical substances react violently when mixed together.
examples.zh: 这些化学物质混合在一起时会剧烈反应。

examples.en: The market reacted positively to the company's new product launch.
examples.zh: 市场对该公司的新产品发布反应积极。

examples.en: He tends to react impulsively without thinking things through.
examples.zh: 他倾向于不经过深思熟虑就冲动地做出反应。

examples.en: She works from a remote village in the mountains.
examples.zh: 她在山区的一个偏远村庄工作。

examples.en: The remote control for the TV is missing.
examples.zh: 电视的遥控器不见了。

examples.en: There's only a remote possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天下雨的可能性微乎其微。

examples.en: The company offers remote work options for its employees.
examples.zh: 该公司为员工提供远程工作选择。

examples.en: The speaker alluded to recent political scandals without naming them directly.
examples.zh: 演讲者间接提到了近期的政治丑闻，但没有直接点名。

examples.en: In his poem, he alludes to ancient Greek mythology.
examples.zh: 在他的诗中，他暗指了古希腊神话。

examples.en: She alluded to her past struggles during the interview.
examples.zh: 她在采访中暗示了自己过去的挣扎。

examples.en: The article alludes to potential changes in company policy.
examples.zh: 这篇文章暗示了公司政策可能的变化。

examples.en: There is a severe shortage of medical supplies in the region.
examples.zh: 该地区医疗用品严重短缺。

examples.en: The factory faced a shortage of skilled workers.
examples.zh: 这家工厂面临熟练工人短缺的问题。

examples.en: Water shortage is a major issue in many arid areas.
examples.zh: 水资源短缺是许多干旱地区的一个主要问题。

examples.en: The shortage of affordable housing has led to rising rents.
examples.zh: 经济适用房的短缺导致租金上涨。

examples.en: The new policy aims to ameliorate the living conditions of low-income families.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在改善低收入家庭的生活条件。

examples.en: Efforts to ameliorate the environmental damage are underway.
examples.zh: 改善环境损害的努力正在进行中。

examples.en: The medication helped ameliorate her symptoms.
examples.zh: 这种药物有助于缓解她的症状。

examples.en: We need to take steps to ameliorate the situation before it worsens.
examples.zh: 我们需要采取措施改善局势，以防恶化。

examples.en: Effective management is crucial for the success of any organization.
examples.zh: 有效的管理对于任何组织的成功都至关重要。

examples.en: She is studying business management at university.
examples.zh: 她正在大学学习商业管理。

examples.en: The management team decided to implement new strategies.
examples.zh: 管理团队决定实施新策略。

examples.en: Good time management can increase productivity.
examples.zh: 良好的时间管理可以提高生产力。

examples.en: The Senate invoked cloture to end the filibuster and proceed to a vote.
examples.zh: 参议院援引终止辩论规则以结束阻挠议事并进行投票。

examples.en: Cloture requires a three-fifths majority vote in the U.S. Senate.
examples.zh: 在美国参议院，终止辩论需要五分之三的多数票。

examples.en: The cloture motion was filed to limit debate on the controversial bill.
examples.zh: 提出终止辩论动议是为了限制对有争议法案的辩论。

examples.en: Without cloture, the filibuster could delay the legislation indefinitely.
examples.zh: 如果没有终止辩论规则，阻挠议事可能会无限期延迟立法。

examples.en: There is a significant variance in test scores between the two groups.
examples.zh: 两组之间的测试分数存在显著差异。

examples.en: The variance in temperature throughout the year is quite extreme.
examples.zh: 全年温度的变化相当极端。

examples.en: Statistical analysis showed a high variance in the data set.
examples.zh: 统计分析显示数据集中的方差很高。

examples.en: The project's actual costs were at variance with the initial budget.
examples.zh: 项目的实际成本与初始预算不符。

examples.en: He flew into a rage when he discovered the mistake.
examples.zh: 当他发现错误时勃然大怒。

examples.en: The storm raged throughout the night, causing widespread damage.
examples.zh: 暴风雨肆虐了一整夜，造成了广泛的破坏。

examples.en: A debate raged over the new policy on social media.
examples.zh: 关于新政策的争论在社交媒体上激烈进行。

examples.en: The fire raged out of control for hours before firefighters contained it.
examples.zh: 大火失控地肆虐了几个小时，消防员才将其控制住。

examples.en: She learned to drive a car when she was 18.
examples.zh: 她18岁时学会了开车。

examples.en: His ambition and determination drive him to succeed.
examples.zh: 他的抱负和决心驱使他取得成功。

examples.en: We went for a scenic drive along the coast.
examples.zh: 我们沿着海岸线进行了一次风景优美的驾车旅行。

examples.en: The company launched a new marketing drive to boost sales.
examples.zh: 公司发起了一场新的营销活动以提升销售额。

examples.en: He twisted his ankle while playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他在打篮球时扭伤了脚踝。

examples.en: She wore a delicate silver chain around her ankle.
examples.zh: 她在脚踝上戴了一条精致的银链。

examples.en: The doctor recommended rest and ice for the swollen ankle.
examples.zh: 医生建议对肿胀的脚踝进行休息和冰敷。

examples.en: High heels can put extra strain on your ankles.
examples.zh: 高跟鞋会给你的脚踝带来额外的压力。

examples.en: The city endured heavy bombardment during the war.
examples.zh: 这座城市在战争期间遭受了猛烈的轰炸。

examples.en: The company faced a bombardment of customer complaints.
examples.zh: 公司面临客户投诉的狂轰滥炸。

examples.en: The media bombardment of negative news affected public morale.
examples.zh: 媒体对负面新闻的密集报道影响了公众士气。

examples.en: The artillery bombardment lasted for hours before the ground assault.
examples.zh: 在地面进攻前，炮击持续了数小时。

examples.en: I was so tired that I literally fell asleep standing up.
examples.zh: 我太累了，简直站着就睡着了。

examples.en: The word 'literally' is often used figuratively in casual speech.
examples.zh: 在口语中，“literally”这个词常被用作比喻义。

examples.en: He literally ran all the way to the station to catch the train.
examples.zh: 他真的是全程跑到车站去赶火车。

examples.en: The book was so good that I literally couldn't put it down.
examples.zh: 这本书太好了，我简直爱不释手。

examples.en: She trained for months to run the New York City Marathon.
examples.zh: 她训练了几个月来参加纽约市马拉松比赛。

examples.en: The meeting turned into a marathon session lasting eight hours.
examples.zh: 会议变成了一场持续八小时的马拉松式会议。

examples.en: Watching all three extended edition Lord of the Rings movies is a marathon.
examples.zh: 观看所有三部加长版的《指环王》电影就像一场马拉松。

examples.en: He completed his first marathon in under four hours.
examples.zh: 他在四小时内完成了他的第一次马拉松。

examples.en: I take the subway to work every day to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 我每天乘地铁上班以避免交通拥堵。

examples.en: The subway system in Tokyo is incredibly efficient and extensive.
examples.zh: 东京的地铁系统极其高效且覆盖面广。

examples.en: We grabbed a quick sandwich at a subway station kiosk.
examples.zh: 我们在地铁站的小卖部买了个三明治当快餐。

examples.en: The new subway line will reduce commute times for thousands of people.
examples.zh: 新的地铁线路将减少数千人的通勤时间。

examples.en: She used an electric mixer to beat the eggs and sugar.
examples.zh: 她用电动搅拌器打匀鸡蛋和糖。

examples.en: The company hosted a mixer to help new employees network.
examples.zh: 公司举办了一场社交聚会，帮助新员工建立人脉。

examples.en: He adjusted the audio mixer to balance the sound levels.
examples.zh: 他调整了调音台以平衡声音电平。

examples.en: A cement mixer was parked outside the construction site.
examples.zh: 一辆水泥搅拌车停在建筑工地外。

examples.en: She used dry leaves to kindle the campfire.
examples.zh: 她用干树叶点燃了篝火。

examples.en: The inspiring speech kindled hope in the audience.
examples.zh: 鼓舞人心的演讲在听众心中点燃了希望。

examples.en: He enjoys reading books on his Kindle e-reader.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在他的Kindle电子阅读器上看书。

examples.en: The teacher's enthusiasm kindled a love for science in her students.
examples.zh: 老师的热情在学生心中点燃了对科学的热爱。

examples.en: Small businesses bore the brunt of the economic downturn.
examples.zh: 小企业承受了经济衰退的主要冲击。

examples.en: The coastal towns took the brunt of the hurricane's force.
examples.zh: 沿海城镇承受了飓风威力的主要冲击。

examples.en: As team leader, she bore the brunt of the criticism for the project's failure.
examples.zh: 作为团队领导，她承受了项目失败的主要批评。

examples.en: The front line soldiers faced the brunt of the enemy attack.
examples.zh: 前线士兵面对了敌人攻击的主要冲击。

examples.en: A sense of gloom settled over the city after the bad news.
examples.zh: 坏消息传来后，一种忧郁感笼罩了这座城市。

examples.en: The room was filled with gloom on that rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 在那个下雨的下午，房间里充满了阴郁的气氛。

examples.en: Economic forecasts cast a gloom over the stock market.
examples.zh: 经济预测给股市蒙上了一层阴影。

examples.en: He couldn't shake off the gloom that had followed him all day.
examples.zh: 他无法摆脱整天跟随他的忧郁情绪。

examples.en: He acted like a complete boor at the dinner party, talking loudly with his mouth full.
examples.zh: 他在晚宴上表现得像个十足的粗人，满嘴食物还大声说话。

examples.en: Don't be such a boor; show some respect for others' opinions.
examples.zh: 别这么粗鲁无礼，要尊重别人的意见。

examples.en: His boorish behavior made everyone at the meeting uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的行为让会议上的每个人都感到不舒服。

examples.en: She was shocked by the boor's insensitive comments about her appearance.
examples.zh: 那个粗人对她外貌的麻木不仁的评论让她震惊。

examples.en: Children are especially vulnerable to online predators.
examples.zh: 儿童尤其容易受到网络捕食者的侵害。

examples.en: The coastal city is vulnerable to hurricanes during the summer months.
examples.zh: 这座沿海城市在夏季容易受到飓风的侵袭。

examples.en: After the breakup, she felt emotionally vulnerable and needed support.
examples.zh: 分手后，她在情感上感到脆弱，需要支持。

examples.en: The company's outdated security system left it vulnerable to cyberattacks.
examples.zh: 公司过时的安全系统使其容易受到网络攻击。

examples.en: Farmers often use pesticides to protect their crops from insects.
examples.zh: 农民经常使用农药来保护庄稼免受昆虫侵害。

examples.en: Excessive use of pesticides can harm the environment and human health.
examples.zh: 过度使用农药会危害环境和人类健康。

examples.en: The government has strict regulations on the sale and use of pesticides.
examples.zh: 政府对农药的销售和使用有严格的规定。

examples.en: Organic farming avoids synthetic pesticides and fertilizers.
examples.zh: 有机农业避免使用合成农药和化肥。

examples.en: She always pays great attention to her appearance before going out.
examples.zh: 她出门前总是非常注重自己的外表。

examples.en: The sudden appearance of the deer on the road caused the driver to brake hard.
examples.zh: 鹿突然出现在路上，导致司机急刹车。

examples.en: Despite his rough appearance, he is actually very kind-hearted.
examples.zh: 尽管他外表粗犷，但实际上非常善良。

examples.en: The appearance of the new product at the trade show attracted a lot of attention.
examples.zh: 新产品在贸易展上的亮相吸引了很多关注。

examples.en: The extraction of oil from the ground is a complex industrial process.
examples.zh: 从地下提取石油是一个复杂的工业过程。

examples.en: Tooth extraction can be painful, but modern dentistry makes it more comfortable.
examples.zh: 拔牙可能会很痛，但现代牙科使其更加舒适。

examples.en: The extraction of data from the database took longer than expected.
examples.zh: 从数据库中提取数据花费的时间比预期要长。

examples.en: Mining involves the extraction of valuable minerals from the earth.
examples.zh: 采矿涉及从地球中提取有价值的矿物。

examples.en: He has an acute sense of hearing, able to detect faint sounds.
examples.zh: 他有敏锐的听觉，能察觉到微弱的声音。

examples.en: The patient was admitted to the hospital with acute abdominal pain.
examples.zh: 病人因急性腹痛被送入医院。

examples.en: There is an acute shortage of affordable housing in the city.
examples.zh: 这座城市经济适用房严重短缺。

examples.en: She showed acute intelligence in solving the complex problem.
examples.zh: 她在解决这个复杂问题时表现出敏锐的智慧。

examples.en: After the long hike, they enjoyed a hearty meal of stew and bread.
examples.zh: 长途徒步后，他们享用了一顿丰盛的炖菜和面包。

examples.en: He gave a hearty laugh when he heard the funny joke.
examples.zh: 听到这个有趣的笑话，他开怀大笑。

examples.en: The team received a hearty welcome from the local community.
examples.zh: 团队受到了当地社区的热烈欢迎。

examples.en: She has a hearty appetite and can eat large portions without gaining weight.
examples.zh: 她胃口很好，能吃很多却不会增重。

examples.en: The weather during our vacation was atrocious, with constant rain and cold.
examples.zh: 我们度假期间的天气糟透了，一直下雨又寒冷。

examples.en: He committed atrocious crimes that shocked the entire nation.
examples.zh: 他犯下了令人发指的罪行，震惊了整个国家。

examples.en: The service at the restaurant was atrocious; we waited over an hour for our food.
examples.zh: 那家餐厅的服务糟透了；我们等了一个多小时才上菜。

examples.en: She has an atrocious sense of fashion, often wearing mismatched clothes.
examples.zh: 她的时尚感极差，经常穿不搭调的衣服。

examples.en: He has a proclivity for taking risks in his business ventures.
examples.zh: 他在商业投资中有冒险的倾向。

examples.en: Children often show a proclivity for imitating their parents' behavior.
examples.zh: 儿童常常表现出模仿父母行为的倾向。

examples.en: Her proclivity for procrastination often leads to last-minute stress.
examples.zh: 她拖延的倾向常常导致最后一刻的压力。

examples.en: The artist has a proclivity for using bright colors in his paintings.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在绘画中有使用鲜艳色彩的倾向。

examples.en: The meeting is over; you can go home now.
examples.zh: 会议结束了；你现在可以回家了。

examples.en: She jumped over the fence to retrieve her ball.
examples.zh: 她跳过篱笆去捡她的球。

examples.en: He has control over the company's financial decisions.
examples.zh: 他掌控着公司的财务决策。

examples.en: They argued over who should pay the bill.
examples.zh: 他们为谁该付账而争论。

examples.en: The monkey swung from branch to branch in the jungle.
examples.zh: 猴子在丛林中从一根树枝荡到另一根树枝。

examples.en: He's such a cheeky monkey, always playing pranks on his friends.
examples.zh: 他真是个淘气鬼，总是对朋友们恶作剧。

examples.en: Stop monkeying around and focus on your homework.
examples.zh: 别胡闹了，专心做你的作业。

examples.en: The children were as noisy as a barrel of monkeys at the party.
examples.zh: 孩子们在派对上吵得像一桶猴子一样。

examples.en: She visits her grandmother every Sunday without fail.
examples.zh: 她每个星期天都雷打不动地去看望祖母。

examples.en: Every student in the class passed the final exam.
examples.zh: 班上的每个学生都通过了期末考试。

examples.en: He checked every nook and cranny for the lost keys.
examples.zh: 他翻遍了每个角落寻找丢失的钥匙。

examples.en: Every cloud has a silver lining, so don't lose hope.
examples.zh: 黑暗中总有一线光明，所以不要失去希望。

examples.en: The little girl was playing with her doll in the garden.
examples.zh: 小女孩正在花园里玩她的洋娃娃。

examples.en: She's a smart girl who always gets top grades in school.
examples.zh: 她是个聪明的女孩，在学校总是取得最高分。

examples.en: The girls' soccer team won the championship last year.
examples.zh: 女子足球队去年赢得了冠军。

examples.en: He's just one of the boys, but she's the girl next door.
examples.zh: 他只是普通男孩中的一个，而她是邻家女孩。

examples.en: He was branded a turncoat for switching political parties before the election.
examples.zh: 他因在选举前转换政党而被贴上了叛徒的标签。

examples.en: The turncoat revealed all the company's secrets to its competitor.
examples.zh: 这个叛徒向竞争对手泄露了公司的所有秘密。

examples.en: In the spy novel, the main character is a turncoat who works for both sides.
examples.zh: 在这部间谍小说中，主角是一个为双方工作的叛徒。

examples.en: Once a loyal friend, he became a turncoat and betrayed their trust.
examples.zh: 他曾是忠诚的朋友，后来却成了叛徒，背叛了他们的信任。

examples.en: She spurned his marriage proposal, saying she wasn't ready for commitment.
examples.zh: 她拒绝了他的求婚，说她还没准备好做出承诺。

examples.en: The company spurned the takeover offer, believing it was undervalued.
examples.zh: 公司拒绝了收购要约，认为其价值被低估了。

examples.en: He felt spurned by his friends when they didn't invite him to the party.
examples.zh: 当朋友们没有邀请他参加派对时，他感到被冷落了。

examples.en: The artist spurned commercial success in favor of creative freedom.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家拒绝了商业成功，选择了创作自由。

examples.en: He was a devoted disciple of the famous philosopher, following his teachings closely.
examples.zh: 他是那位著名哲学家的忠实门徒，紧密追随其教诲。

examples.en: The guru had many disciples who traveled with him to learn meditation.
examples.zh: 这位大师有许多门徒，他们跟随他旅行学习冥想。

examples.en: As a disciple of classical music, she attended every concert in the city.
examples.zh: 作为古典音乐的追随者，她参加了城里的每一场音乐会。

examples.en: The disciples spread the teachings of their master across the region.
examples.zh: 门徒们将大师的教诲传播到了整个地区。

examples.en: The film is a pastiche of 1950s Hollywood musicals, with colorful costumes and dance numbers.
examples.zh: 这部电影是对20世纪50年代好莱坞音乐剧的模仿，有色彩鲜艳的服装和舞蹈场面。

examples.en: His writing style is a pastiche of various literary giants, blending their techniques.
examples.zh: 他的写作风格是对多位文学巨匠的模仿，融合了他们的技巧。

examples.en: The artist created a pastiche that combined elements from Renaissance and modern art.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家创作了一幅融合了文艺复兴和现代艺术元素的模仿作品。

examples.en: The novel is a clever pastiche of detective stories, paying homage to the genre.
examples.zh: 这部小说是对侦探故事的巧妙模仿，向这一体裁致敬。

examples.en: The ship's captain used longitude and latitude to navigate across the ocean.
examples.zh: 船长使用经度和纬度在海洋中导航。

examples.en: Greenwich, England, is located at zero degrees longitude.
examples.zh: 英格兰的格林威治位于零度经线。

examples.en: Accurate measurement of longitude was crucial for early explorers to map new territories.
examples.zh: 精确测量经度对于早期探险家绘制新领土地图至关重要。

examples.en: The GPS device displays both latitude and longitude coordinates for your location.
examples.zh: GPS设备显示您所在位置的纬度和经度坐标。

examples.en: He was a taciturn man who rarely spoke more than a few words at a time.
examples.zh: 他是个沉默寡言的人，一次很少说超过几句话。

examples.en: Despite his taciturn nature, he was a loyal friend who showed care through actions.
examples.zh: 尽管他性格沉默寡言，但他是个忠诚的朋友，通过行动表达关心。

examples.en: The taciturn detective observed the crime scene without saying a word.
examples.zh: 这位沉默寡言的侦探一言不发地观察着犯罪现场。

examples.en: Her taciturn response to the question made everyone in the room feel uneasy.
examples.zh: 她对问题的沉默回应让房间里的每个人都感到不安。

examples.en: They embarked on a long voyage across the Atlantic Ocean to reach the New World.
examples.zh: 他们开始了横渡大西洋到达新世界的漫长航行。

examples.en: The voyage to the remote island took three days by boat.
examples.zh: 乘船前往那个偏远岛屿的航程花了三天时间。

examples.en: His first space voyage was a milestone in human exploration.
examples.zh: 他的首次太空航行是人类探索的一个里程碑。

examples.en: The novel describes a perilous voyage through stormy seas and unknown lands.
examples.zh: 这部小说描述了一次穿越暴风雨海域和未知陆地的危险航行。

examples.en: The two projects have overlapping goals, so we need to coordinate them carefully.
examples.zh: 这两个项目的目标有重叠，所以我们需要仔细协调。

examples.en: The overlapping tiles on the roof prevent leaks during heavy rain.
examples.zh: 屋顶上重叠的瓦片能防止大雨时漏水。

examples.en: Their work schedules are overlapping, which makes it hard to meet.
examples.zh: 他们的工作时间有重叠，这使得很难见面。

examples.en: The overlapping circles in the diagram show the common interests between the groups.
examples.zh: 图表中重叠的圆圈显示了各群体之间的共同利益。

examples.en: His acting was so stagy that it felt unnatural and forced.
examples.zh: 他的表演太做作了，感觉不自然且勉强。

examples.en: The play's dialogue was criticized for being stagy and unrealistic.
examples.zh: 这部剧的对话被批评为做作且不真实。

examples.en: She has a stagy way of speaking that annoys some people.
examples.zh: 她说话的方式很做作，让一些人感到厌烦。

examples.en: The decorations looked stagy, as if they were from a cheap theater set.
examples.zh: 装饰看起来很做作，就像来自廉价的剧院布景。

examples.en: After the big meal, I felt completely satiated and couldn't eat another bite.
examples.zh: 大餐之后，我感到完全饱足，一口也吃不下了。

examples.en: The audience was satiated with the long, boring lecture.
examples.zh: 观众对那场漫长无聊的讲座感到厌腻了。

examples.en: He was satiated with success and started looking for new challenges.
examples.zh: 他对成功感到满足，开始寻找新的挑战。

examples.en: The market is satiated with similar products, so innovation is key.
examples.zh: 市场上充斥着类似的产品，所以创新是关键。

examples.en: The deer forage for food in the forest during the winter.
examples.zh: 鹿在冬天时在森林里觅食。

examples.en: We had to forage for firewood to keep warm in the wilderness.
examples.zh: 我们在荒野中不得不搜寻柴火来取暖。

examples.en: The soldiers foraged the countryside for supplies during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间，士兵们在乡村搜寻补给品。

examples.en: Birds often forage in gardens for insects and seeds.
examples.zh: 鸟类经常在花园里觅食昆虫和种子。

examples.en: The outlying villages have limited access to healthcare services.
examples.zh: 边远村庄的医疗服务有限。

examples.en: We visited some outlying islands during our trip to the coast.
examples.zh: 我们在沿海旅行时参观了一些偏远岛屿。

examples.en: The company has offices in the city center and outlying areas.
examples.zh: 公司在市中心和偏远地区都有办事处。

examples.en: Outlying regions often face challenges with infrastructure development.
examples.zh: 偏远地区常常面临基础设施发展的挑战。

examples.en: Oceania includes countries like Australia, New Zealand, and Fiji.
examples.zh: 大洋洲包括澳大利亚、新西兰和斐济等国家。

examples.en: The climate in Oceania varies from tropical to temperate.
examples.zh: 大洋洲的气候从热带到温带各不相同。

examples.en: Tourism is a major industry in many parts of Oceania.
examples.zh: 旅游业是大洋洲许多地区的主要产业。

examples.en: Oceania is known for its diverse cultures and stunning natural landscapes.
examples.zh: 大洋洲以其多元文化和壮丽的自然景观而闻名。

examples.en: The product launch turned into a fiasco when the software crashed repeatedly.
examples.zh: 产品发布会变成了一场惨败，因为软件反复崩溃。

examples.en: The party was a complete fiasco due to poor planning and bad weather.
examples.zh: 由于计划不周和天气恶劣，派对彻底失败了。

examples.en: His attempt to fix the car ended in a fiasco, making the problem worse.
examples.zh: 他试图修车的努力以惨败告终，使问题变得更糟。

examples.en: The meeting was a fiasco, with everyone arguing and no decisions made.
examples.zh: 会议是一场惨败，大家争吵不休，没有做出任何决定。

examples.en: The nation celebrated its independence day with parades and fireworks.
examples.zh: 这个国家用游行和烟花庆祝独立日。

examples.en: A strong economy is vital for the well-being of the nation.
examples.zh: 强大的经济对国家的福祉至关重要。

examples.en: The president addressed the nation on television during the crisis.
examples.zh: 危机期间，总统在电视上向全国发表讲话。

examples.en: The nation's history is rich with cultural traditions and achievements.
examples.zh: 这个国家的历史充满了文化传统和成就。

examples.en: The bank agreed to waive the fee for the first year of the account.
examples.zh: 银行同意免除账户第一年的费用。

examples.en: He decided to waive his right to a lawyer and represent himself in court.
examples.zh: 他决定放弃请律师的权利，在法庭上为自己辩护。

examples.en: The university may waive the application fee for low-income students.
examples.zh: 大学可能会为低收入学生免除申请费。

examples.en: They waived the usual requirements due to the emergency situation.
examples.zh: 由于紧急情况，他们放弃了通常的要求。

examples.en: Bright lights and loud noises can be overwhelming stimuli for some people.
examples.zh: 明亮的灯光和巨大的噪音对一些人来说可能是压倒性的刺激。

examples.en: The experiment tested how different stimuli affect reaction times.
examples.zh: 这个实验测试了不同刺激如何影响反应时间。

examples.en: Economic stimuli, such as tax cuts, are often used to boost growth.
examples.zh: 经济刺激措施，如减税，常被用来促进增长。

examples.en: Plants respond to environmental stimuli like light and temperature.
examples.zh: 植物对光和温度等环境刺激有反应。

examples.en: The poet delivered a panegyric in honor of the national hero.
examples.zh: 诗人发表了一篇颂词，以纪念这位民族英雄。

examples.en: His speech was a panegyric to the virtues of hard work.
examples.zh: 他的演讲是对勤奋美德的颂扬。

examples.en: The article reads like a panegyric for the company's achievements.
examples.zh: 这篇文章读起来像是对公司成就的赞歌。

examples.en: She wrote a panegyric celebrating her mentor's lifelong contributions.
examples.zh: 她写了一篇颂文，颂扬导师的毕生贡献。

examples.en: The boat sailed into a sheltered inlet to avoid the storm.
examples.zh: 小船驶入一个避风的小海湾以躲避风暴。

examples.en: There's a small fishing village located at the mouth of the inlet.
examples.zh: 在小海湾的入口处有一个小渔村。

examples.en: The coastal map shows several inlets along the shoreline.
examples.zh: 海岸地图显示海岸线沿线有几个小海湾。

examples.en: They anchored their yacht in a quiet inlet for the night.
examples.zh: 他们将游艇停泊在一个安静的小海湾过夜。

examples.en: The truck was laden with fresh produce from the farm.
examples.zh: 卡车上满载着农场的新鲜农产品。

examples.en: She felt laden with guilt after the argument.
examples.zh: 争吵后，她感到内心充满了愧疚。

examples.en: The branches were laden with ripe fruit.
examples.zh: 树枝上挂满了成熟的果实。

examples.en: His voice was laden with emotion as he spoke.
examples.zh: 他说话时声音充满了情感。

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you reveal the secret.
examples.zh: 在任何情况下你都不应该泄露这个秘密。

examples.en: The police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the accident.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查事故的相关情况。

examples.en: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the event has been postponed.
examples.zh: 由于不可预见的情况，活动已被推迟。

examples.en: She managed to succeed despite difficult circumstances.
examples.zh: 尽管处境艰难，她还是设法取得了成功。

examples.en: The new job will entail a lot of travel.
examples.zh: 这份新工作需要经常出差。

examples.en: Buying a house entails significant financial commitment.
examples.zh: 买房意味着重大的财务承诺。

examples.en: The project entails careful planning and execution.
examples.zh: 这个项目需要仔细的规划和执行。

examples.en: What does the contract entail in terms of responsibilities?
examples.zh: 合同在责任方面包含了哪些内容？

examples.en: The lake was still and calm in the morning light.
examples.zh: 湖面在晨光中平静无波。

examples.en: He remained still while the doctor examined him.
examples.zh: 医生检查时，他保持不动。

examples.en: She still hasn't replied to my email.
examples.zh: 她仍然没有回复我的邮件。

examples.en: The old photograph captured a moment frozen in time, still and silent.
examples.zh: 这张旧照片捕捉了一个凝固在时间中的瞬间，静止而寂静。

examples.en: The limner was renowned for his detailed portraits of the aristocracy.
examples.zh: 这位肖像画家以描绘贵族的精细肖像而闻名。

examples.en: In the 18th century, a limner would travel to paint portraits for wealthy families.
examples.zh: 在18世纪，肖像画家会旅行去为富裕家庭画肖像。

examples.en: The museum features works by an anonymous colonial limner.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一位匿名殖民地肖像画家的作品。

examples.en: As a limner, she specialized in capturing the essence of her subjects.
examples.zh: 作为一名肖像画家，她擅长捕捉描绘对象的精髓。

examples.en: He had no qualms about telling the truth, even if it hurt.
examples.zh: 他毫不顾忌地说出真相，即使这会伤害别人。

examples.en: She felt some qualms about accepting the job offer.
examples.zh: 她对接受这份工作邀请感到有些不安。

examples.en: Without any qualms, he signed the controversial agreement.
examples.zh: 他毫无顾忌地签署了这份有争议的协议。

examples.en: Her moral qualms prevented her from participating in the scheme.
examples.zh: 她的道德顾虑使她无法参与这个计划。

examples.en: The pulchritude of the sunset left everyone in awe.
examples.zh: 日落的美丽让所有人都惊叹不已。

examples.en: Her pulchritude was often praised in poetry and art.
examples.zh: 她的美貌经常在诗歌和艺术中被赞美。

examples.en: The garden was renowned for its natural pulchritude.
examples.zh: 这个花园以其自然之美而闻名。

examples.en: He wrote a sonnet celebrating the pulchritude of the landscape.
examples.zh: 他写了一首十四行诗来赞美这片风景的美丽。

examples.en: The company undertook a mammoth project to build the new bridge.
examples.zh: 公司承担了一个庞大的项目来建造新桥。

examples.en: Cleaning up after the festival was a mammoth task.
examples.zh: 节后清理是一项艰巨的任务。

examples.en: They discovered mammoth fossils in the Arctic region.
examples.zh: 他们在北极地区发现了猛犸象化石。

examples.en: The mammoth size of the stadium impressed all the visitors.
examples.zh: 体育场的巨大规模给所有参观者留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The dust particles agglomerate into larger clumps over time.
examples.zh: 灰尘颗粒随时间聚集形成更大的团块。

examples.en: The company plans to agglomerate several small businesses into one corporation.
examples.zh: 公司计划将几家小企业合并成一家公司。

examples.en: In geology, volcanic ash can agglomerate to form rocks.
examples.zh: 在地质学中，火山灰可以聚集形成岩石。

examples.en: The new policy may agglomerate power in the hands of a few officials.
examples.zh: 新政策可能将权力集中在少数官员手中。

examples.en: The train sped along the rail towards the city.
examples.zh: 火车沿着铁轨向城市疾驰而去。

examples.en: He leaned against the rail to watch the sunset over the ocean.
examples.zh: 他靠在栏杆上观看海上的日落。

examples.en: The politician continued to rail against corruption in his speech.
examples.zh: 这位政治家在演讲中继续猛烈抨击腐败。

examples.en: Make sure the curtain rail is securely fixed to the wall.
examples.zh: 确保窗帘轨道牢固地固定在墙上。

examples.en: The two teams clashed in a fierce football match last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末，两支球队在一场激烈的足球比赛中交锋。

examples.en: Her bright red dress clashed with the muted colors of the room.
examples.zh: 她鲜红色的连衣裙与房间柔和的色调不协调。

examples.en: There was a clash of opinions during the meeting, leading to heated arguments.
examples.zh: 会议期间意见冲突，导致了激烈的争论。

examples.en: The clash of cymbals marked the beginning of the musical performance.
examples.zh: 铙钹的撞击声标志着音乐表演的开始。

examples.en: Her winsome smile charmed everyone at the party.
examples.zh: 她迷人的微笑迷住了派对上的每一个人。

examples.en: The child's winsome manner made him a favorite among the neighbors.
examples.zh: 这孩子讨人喜欢的举止使他成为邻居们的宠儿。

examples.en: He has a winsome personality that attracts many friends.
examples.zh: 他性格迷人，吸引了许多朋友。

examples.en: The winsome melody of the song stayed in my mind all day.
examples.zh: 这首歌迷人的旋律一整天都萦绕在我脑海中。

examples.en: The organization provides support for people at risk of suicide.
examples.zh: 该组织为有自杀风险的人提供支持。

examples.en: Committing suicide is a tragic and preventable act.
examples.zh: 自杀是一种悲剧性的、可预防的行为。

examples.en: The soldier's mission was described as a suicide attack.
examples.zh: 这名士兵的任务被描述为一次自杀式袭击。

examples.en: Economic hardship can sometimes lead to thoughts of suicide.
examples.zh: 经济困难有时会导致自杀的念头。

examples.en: She celebrated her fortieth birthday with a big party.
examples.zh: 她举办了一场盛大的派对来庆祝她的四十岁生日。

examples.en: The temperature dropped to forty degrees Fahrenheit overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间，温度降到了华氏四十度。

examples.en: He ran forty miles in preparation for the marathon.
examples.zh: 他为准备马拉松跑了四十英里。

examples.en: The book has forty chapters, each covering a different topic.
examples.zh: 这本书有四十章，每章涵盖一个不同的主题。

examples.en: Maintaining decorum is essential during formal ceremonies.
examples.zh: 在正式仪式中保持得体至关重要。

examples.en: He breached decorum by shouting in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 他在法庭上大喊大叫，违反了礼仪规范。

examples.en: The school enforces strict decorum in its classrooms.
examples.zh: 学校在教室里执行严格的礼仪规范。

examples.en: Her sense of decorum prevented her from making rude comments.
examples.zh: 她的得体感阻止了她发表粗鲁的评论。

examples.en: We had to wade through the shallow river to reach the other side.
examples.zh: 我们不得不涉过浅河到达对岸。

examples.en: He waded into the debate with strong opinions.
examples.zh: 他带着强烈的观点加入了辩论。

examples.en: The children love to wade in the pool on hot days.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在热天里在泳池中涉水玩耍。

examples.en: She waded through piles of paperwork to finish the project.
examples.zh: 她费力处理成堆的文件以完成这个项目。

examples.en: When will you arrive at the airport?
examples.zh: 你什么时候到达机场？

examples.en: I remember when we first met in college.
examples.zh: 我记得我们第一次在大学相遇的时候。

examples.en: Call me when you need help with your homework.
examples.zh: 当你需要帮助做作业时，打电话给我。

examples.en: When it rains, the streets become slippery.
examples.zh: 下雨时，街道会变得湿滑。

examples.en: The company will advertise its new product on television.
examples.zh: 公司将在电视上为其新产品做广告。

examples.en: She advertised her apartment for rent online.
examples.zh: 她在网上发布了公寓出租的广告。

examples.en: It's important to advertise events well in advance to attract attendees.
examples.zh: 提前做好活动宣传以吸引参与者很重要。

examples.en: The job vacancy was advertised in the local newspaper.
examples.zh: 这个职位空缺在当地报纸上登了广告。

examples.en: He had to shoulder the responsibility for the entire project.
examples.zh: 他不得不承担整个项目的责任。

examples.en: She leaned her head on his shoulder and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 她把头靠在他的肩膀上睡着了。

examples.en: The road shoulders were covered with gravel.
examples.zh: 道路的路肩铺满了碎石。

examples.en: He shouldered his way through the crowded room.
examples.zh: 他用肩膀挤过拥挤的房间。

examples.en: The projectionist carefully threaded the film through the projector.
examples.zh: 放映员小心地将胶片穿过放映机。

examples.en: As a projectionist, he worked late nights at the cinema.
examples.zh: 作为一名放映员，他在电影院工作到深夜。

examples.en: The projectionist adjusted the focus to ensure a clear picture.
examples.zh: 放映员调整了焦距以确保画面清晰。

examples.en: Modern cinemas often have automated systems, reducing the need for a projectionist.
examples.zh: 现代电影院通常有自动化系统，减少了对放映员的需求。

examples.en: She painted a beautiful picture of the sunset.
examples.zh: 她画了一幅美丽的日落图画。

examples.en: Let me give you a clear picture of the situation.
examples.zh: 让我给你一个清晰的情况描述。

examples.en: The picture on the TV screen was blurry.
examples.zh: 电视屏幕上的画面很模糊。

examples.en: He's in the picture for the promotion at work.
examples.zh: 他在工作晋升的考虑范围内。

examples.en: We need to discuss the specifics of the contract before signing.
examples.zh: 我们需要在签署前讨论合同的具体细节。

examples.en: The report lacked specifics, making it hard to understand.
examples.zh: 报告缺乏具体细节，让人难以理解。

examples.en: Can you provide more specifics about the project timeline?
examples.zh: 你能提供更多关于项目时间表的具体信息吗？

examples.en: The specifics of the plan are still being finalized.
examples.zh: 计划的具体细节仍在最终确定中。

examples.en: It was a sweltering hot day, with temperatures reaching 40°C.
examples.zh: 那是一个酷热难耐的日子，气温高达40摄氏度。

examples.en: The sweltering heat made it impossible to work outside.
examples.zh: 酷热使得户外工作变得不可能。

examples.en: They sought refuge from the sweltering sun under a tree.
examples.zh: 他们在树下躲避酷热的阳光。

examples.en: The sweltering conditions led to a heatwave warning.
examples.zh: 酷热的条件导致了热浪警告。

examples.en: Some people claim to have clairvoyance and can predict future events.
examples.zh: 有些人声称有千里眼，能预测未来事件。

examples.en: Her clairvoyance helped solve the mysterious case.
examples.zh: 她的千里眼帮助解决了这个神秘案件。

examples.en: Clairvoyance is often associated with psychic abilities.
examples.zh: 千里眼通常与通灵能力相关。

examples.en: He dismissed her claims of clairvoyance as mere coincidence.
examples.zh: 他把她声称有千里眼的话视为仅仅是巧合。

examples.en: The former president gave a speech at the university.
examples.zh: 前总统在大学发表了演讲。

examples.en: Of the two options, I prefer the former.
examples.zh: 在这两个选项中，我更喜欢前者。

examples.en: She is a former employee of the company.
examples.zh: 她是这家公司的前雇员。

examples.en: The former method is more efficient than the latter.
examples.zh: 前一种方法比后一种更高效。

examples.en: Their marriage was just a charade to please their families.
examples.zh: 他们的婚姻只是为了取悦家人的一场伪装。

examples.en: We played a game of charades at the party.
examples.zh: 我们在派对上玩了一场猜字游戏。
